## Reviewer's Guide Synchronizes the NVIDIA provider’s thinking/reasoning payload handling with main, adds several new NVIDIA chat models that support reasoning, and adjusts tests to reflect the updated behavior, while leaving one merge conflict in aiModel type imports that must be resolved before merge. #### Sequence diagram for NVIDIA handlePayload thinking and reasoning conversion ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Client participant NvidiaProvider participant NvidiaAPI Client->>NvidiaProvider: chatCompletion_handlePayload(payload) activate NvidiaProvider NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: extract model, thinking, messages, rest NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: processedMessages = map messages NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: convert assistant.reasoning.content to reasoning_content NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: thinkingFlag = enabled/disabled/undefined NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: usePreservedThinking = supportPreservedThinkingModels.has(model) alt thinkingFlag is defined and usePreservedThinking is true NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: chatTemplateKwargs.enable_thinking = thinkingFlag NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: chatTemplateKwargs.clear_thinking = false else thinkingFlag is defined and usePreservedThinking is false NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: chatTemplateKwargs.thinking = thinkingFlag else thinkingFlag is undefined NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: chatTemplateKwargs is empty end NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: build finalPayload with model, processedMessages, rest NvidiaProvider->>NvidiaProvider: include chat_template_kwargs if not empty NvidiaProvider-->>Client: finalPayload deactivate NvidiaProvider Client->>NvidiaAPI: POST /v1/chat/completions finalPayload activate NvidiaAPI NvidiaAPI-->>Client: response deactivate NvidiaAPI ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Update NVIDIA chatCompletion payload handling to support preserved thinking flags and reasoning->reasoning_content conversion. |
  • Destructure thinking and messages from the payload before processing and leave other properties in a rest object.
  • Map assistant messages that contain a reasoning.content field into messages that instead use a reasoning_content field, per NVIDIA NIM API expectations.
  • Convert thinking.type values into a boolean thinkingFlag, and branch behavior for models that support preserved thinking vs others.
  • Introduce a supportPreservedThinkingModels set for GLM models that should use enable_thinking and clear_thinking instead of the thinking flag.
  • Build chat_template_kwargs conditionally based on whether a thinking flag is present, omitting the field entirely if thinking is not set.
| `packages/model-runtime/src/providers/nvidia/index.ts` | | Align NVIDIA provider tests with new thinking/reasoning behavior, and add coverage for GLM and reasoning conversions. |
  • Rename and clarify existing thinking-related test descriptions to reflect boolean thinking flags derived from thinking.type.
  • Ensure tests no longer expect chat_template_kwargs.thinking when no thinking.type is provided, and ensure it is omitted entirely.
  • Adjust tests so non-thinking models no longer send a thinking parameter at all.
  • Add tests for GLM models that assert enable_thinking and clear_thinking are used when thinking.type is enabled or disabled.
  • Add tests that verify reasoning is converted to reasoning_content for all NVIDIA models, including when combined with thinking for GLM models.
| `packages/model-runtime/src/providers/nvidia/index.test.ts` | | Register additional NVIDIA chat models with reasoning capability in the model bank. |
  • Add MiniMax-M2.1, DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-4.7, GLM-5, and Kimi K2.5 to the NVIDIA chat model list with appropriate metadata (context window, description, maxOutput).
  • Mark the new models as supporting reasoning and functionCall abilities, and set enabled to true.
  • Configure models that support the new reasoning behavior (e.g., DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-4.7, GLM-5, Kimi K2.5) with extendParams: ['enableReasoning'] in their settings.
| `packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/nvidia.ts` | | Introduce and leave unresolved a merge conflict in the AI model type imports that must be fixed. |
  • The aiModel type file shows Git conflict markers around the import from standard-parameters, with one side importing both ModelParamsSchema and VideoModelParamsSchema and the other importing only ModelParamsSchema.
  • The conflict indicates divergence between canary and main branches for how VideoModelParamsSchema is used and must be resolved before merging.
| `packages/model-bank/src/types/aiModel.ts`
`packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/index.ts` | ---

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Fixes MCP tool result rendering so media URLs are correctly resolved and MCP tools use the same custom rendering pipeline as other plugins, while adding guards and tests for content processing. #### Sequence diagram for MCP tool result rendering pipeline ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant UI as ConversationUI participant ToolRender participant CustomRender participant PluginRender participant MCPType participant Processor as contentProcessor User->>UI: Open conversation with MCP tool result UI->>ToolRender: Render tool result ToolRender->>ToolRender: hasCustomRender = getBuiltinRender(identifier, apiName) ToolRender->>ToolRender: isMCP = plugin.type === mcp alt MCP tool ToolRender->>CustomRender: render(content, messageId, plugin, pluginState, toolCallId) CustomRender->>PluginRender: render(content, messageId, plugin, pluginState, toolCallId) PluginRender->>MCPType: render(pluginState, arguments) MCPType->>MCPType: validate pluginState.content is array alt Valid pluginState MCPType->>Processor: contentBlocksToString(content) Processor->>Processor: resolveMediaUrl for image and audio items Processor-->>MCPType: rendered Markdown and resource tags MCPType-->>UI: Inline images and formatted text else Invalid pluginState MCPType-->>UI: Render nothing end else Non MCP tool alt hasCustomRender and showCustomToolRender ToolRender->>CustomRender: render(content, messageId, plugin, pluginState, toolCallId) CustomRender->>PluginRender: render(content, messageId, plugin, pluginState, toolCallId) PluginRender-->>UI: Builtin custom rendering else No custom render ToolRender-->>UI: FallbackArgumentRender with raw JSON end end ``` #### Updated class diagram for MCP content processing and rendering ```mermaid classDiagram class contentProcessor { <> +processContentBlocks(blocks, toolCallId) Promise +contentBlocksToString(blocks) string -resolveMediaUrl(data string) string } class ToolRender { <> +render(showCustomToolRender boolean, content any, messageId string, plugin any, pluginState any, toolCallId string) JSXElement -hasCustomRender boolean -isMCP boolean } class CustomRender { <> +render(content any, messageId string, plugin any, pluginState any, toolCallId string) JSXElement } class PluginRender { <> +render(content any, messageId string, plugin any, pluginState any, toolCallId string) JSXElement } class MCPType { <> +render(pluginState any, arguments any) JSXElement -content any[] } class FallbackArgumentRender { <> +render(content any) JSXElement } ToolRender --> CustomRender : uses when hasCustomRender or isMCP CustomRender --> PluginRender : delegates rendering PluginRender --> MCPType : selects for MCP plugins MCPType --> contentProcessor : uses contentBlocksToString contentProcessor --> resolveMediaUrl : internal helper ToolRender --> FallbackArgumentRender : uses for default plugins ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Prevent double-prefixing of media URLs when converting MCP content blocks to strings. |

  • Extended the condition for showing CustomRender to also trigger for MCP plugins even when getBuiltinRender returns undefined.
| `src/features/Conversation/Messages/AssistantGroup/Tool/Detail/Render/index.tsx` | | Harden MCPType rendering against unexpected pluginState shapes. |
  • Added a guard that returns early unless pluginState.content exists and is an array, preventing render-time crashes.
| `src/features/PluginsUI/Render/MCPType/index.tsx` | | Add unit tests for MCP content URL resolution behavior. |
  • Created contentProcessor.test.ts with coverage for absolute vs relative URLs, http-assets edge cases, null/undefined input, mixed content blocks, and resource blocks.
| `src/server/services/mcp/contentProcessor.test.ts` | ### Possibly linked issues - **#11593**: PR introduces resolveMediaUrl to stop double APP_URL concatenation for MCP images/audio and fixes MCP result rendering.

body:
## Reviewer's Guide Implements an estimated video generation loading progress indicator using per-model average latency, wired from backend latency aggregation and caching through to the video loading UI, while recording task duration for future latency calculations. #### Sequence diagram for estimated video generation progress and latency usage ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant Feed as VideoGenerationFeed participant Router as generationBatchRouter participant LatencySvc as generationLatencyService participant Redis participant DB as PostgresDB participant WebhookAPI participant AsyncTasks participant Browser User->>Feed: Open topic / refresh generation feed Feed->>Router: getGenerationBatches(topicId) Router->>DB: queryGenerationBatchesByTopicIdWithGenerations(topicId) DB-->>Router: GenerationBatches(models) Router->>LatencySvc: getVideoAvgLatency(model) for each unique model LatencySvc->>Redis: get(cacheKey) alt cache hit Redis-->>LatencySvc: avgLatencyMs or null else cache miss LatencySvc->>DB: queryTrimmedAvgLatency(model) DB-->>LatencySvc: latencySamples LatencySvc->>Redis: set(cacheKey, avgLatencyMs, ttl) end LatencySvc-->>Router: avgLatencyMs per model Router-->>Feed: batches with avgLatencyMs loop For each generating video Feed->>Feed: Render VideoLoadingItem(avgLatencyMs) Feed->>Feed: useEstimatedProgress(generationId, latency, isActive) Feed->>Browser: sessionStorage.getItem(startTimeKey) alt no stored start time Browser-->>Feed: null Feed->>Browser: sessionStorage.setItem(startTimeKey, now) end Feed->>Feed: setInterval(update every 1s) Feed->>Feed: update() -> compute progress 0-99% Feed->>User: Show Progress circle with percent alt progress == 99 Feed->>User: Show ElapsedTime below progress circle end end WebhookAPI->>AsyncTasks: load asyncTask by id WebhookAPI->>AsyncTasks: update({ duration: now - createdAt, status: Success }) AsyncTasks-->>DB: persist duration for future latency queries ``` #### Class diagram for latency service and video loading UI types ```mermaid classDiagram class GenerationBatch { +Generation[] generations +GenerationConfig config +Date createdAt +number avgLatencyMs } class VideoLoadingItem { +string aspectRatio +number avgLatencyMs +Generation generation +render(): JSXElement } class useEstimatedProgressHook { +number progress +useEstimatedProgress(generationId: string, avgLatencyMs: number, isActive: boolean): number } class LatencyService { +getVideoAvgLatency(model: string): Promise~number~ +queryTrimmedAvgLatency(model: string): Promise~number~ +getRedis(): Promise~RedisClient~ +getCacheKey(model: string): string } class WebhookRoute { +POST(req: Request, paramsProvider: string): Promise~Response~ +updateAsyncTaskDuration(asyncTaskId: string): Promise~void~ } class AsyncTask { +string id +Date createdAt +Date updatedAt +number duration +AsyncTaskStatus status +AsyncTaskType type } class RedisClient { +get(key: string): Promise~string~ +set(key: string, value: string, options: object): Promise~void~ } class Database { +selectLatencySamples(model: string, days: number): Promise~number[]~ +queryGenerationBatchesByTopicIdWithGenerations(topicId: string): Promise~GenerationBatch[]~ +updateAsyncTaskDuration(asyncTaskId: string, duration: number): Promise~void~ } VideoLoadingItem ..> useEstimatedProgressHook : uses VideoLoadingItem --> GenerationBatch : rendered from useEstimatedProgressHook ..> RedisClient : uses sessionStorage (browser) Vercel build skipping logic, and adds unit tests for the skills execution runtime along with a Vitest config for the package. #### Sequence diagram for execScript command execution flow in SkillsExecutionRuntime ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Caller participant Runtime as SkillsExecutionRuntime participant Service as SkillRuntimeService Caller->>Runtime: execScript(args) alt Service has execScript Runtime->>Service: execScript(args) alt execScript resolves Service-->>Runtime: CommandResult Runtime-->>Caller: success = CommandResult.success else execScript throws error Service--xRuntime: Error Runtime-->>Caller: success = false end else Service has runCommand only Runtime->>Service: runCommand(args) alt runCommand resolves Service-->>Runtime: CommandResult Runtime-->>Caller: success = CommandResult.success else runCommand throws error Service--xRuntime: Error Runtime-->>Caller: success = false end else no execScript and no runCommand Runtime-->>Caller: success = false end ``` #### Class diagram for updated skills market search types and execution runtime ```mermaid classDiagram class SearchSkillParams { +number page +number pageSize +string q +string sort +string order } class MarketSkillItem { +string category +string createdAt +string description +string identifier +number installCount +string name +string repository +string sourceUrl ## Reviewer's Guide Adds a versioned User-Agent header to all Anthropic client calls and introduces tests to verify header behavior while keeping existing header handling intact. #### Sequence diagram for createDefaultAnthropicClient header construction ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Caller participant Factory as createDefaultAnthropicClient participant Env as ProcessEnv participant Anthropic as AnthropicSDK Caller->>Factory: createDefaultAnthropicClient(options) Factory->>Env: read ANTHROPIC_BETA_HEADERS Env-->>Factory: betaHeaders Factory->>Factory: build defaultHeaders Factory->>Factory: set User-Agent = lobe-chat/CURRENT_VERSION Factory->>Factory: merge caller options.defaultHeaders Factory->>Factory: if betaHeaders present Factory->>Factory: add anthropic-beta header Factory->>Anthropic: new AnthropicSDK({ apiKey, defaultHeaders }) Anthropic-->>Caller: client instance with User-Agent header set ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add a versioned User-Agent header to Anthropic client default headers while preserving existing headers. |
  • Extend default headers in the Anthropic client factory to include a User-Agent value derived from the CURRENT_VERSION constant.
  • Ensure caller-provided defaultHeaders are merged so they can coexist with the new User-Agent header.
  • Keep support for ANTHROPIC_BETA_HEADERS by appending it to the merged headers when present.
| `packages/model-runtime/src/core/anthropicCompatibleFactory/index.ts` | | Introduce unit tests to validate Anthropic client header configuration. |
  • Mock the Anthropic SDK and version constant to isolate header behavior.
  • Verify that the User-Agent header is set to the expected versioned value when creating the default client.

/v1/models endpoint and tests modeled after the Nebius provider. #### Sequence diagram for Brainiall chat completion with forced streaming ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant App as LobeChatApp participant Runtime as LobeBrainiallAI participant Payload as handlePayload participant Client as OpenAICompatibleClient participant Brainiall as BrainiallAPI App->>Runtime: chat({ messages, model, stream }) activate Runtime Runtime->>Payload: handlePayload(payload) activate Payload Payload->>Payload: extract model and rest Payload->>Payload: build newPayload with stream = true Payload-->>Runtime: newPayload deactivate Payload Runtime->>Client: chat.completions.create(newPayload) activate Client Client->>Brainiall: POST /chat/completions (stream=true) activate Brainiall Brainiall-->>Client: streaming response (ReadableStream) deactivate Brainiall Client-->>Runtime: ReadableStream deactivate Client Runtime-->>App: streaming tokens deactivate Runtime ``` #### Class Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Fixes command menu search rendering by ensuring groups and items are force-mounted so results and skeletons stay in the DOM while loading, conditionally hiding the empty-state message only when a search is active or has results, and updating the MCP SDK dependency version. #### Sequence diagram for updated command menu search rendering flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CommandMenuContent participant CommandList participant SearchResults participant CommandGroup participant CommandItem User->>CommandMenuContent: typeSearchQuery CommandMenuContent->>CommandMenuContent: update hasSearch and isSearching CommandMenuContent->>CommandList: render alt hasSearch and (isSearching or searchResultsLength_greater_than_0) CommandList-->>CommandList: do_not_render_CommandEmpty else no_search_or_no_activity CommandList-->>CommandList: render_CommandEmpty end CommandMenuContent->>SearchResults: render_with_searchResults_and_isLoading par For_each_result_group SearchResults->>CommandGroup: render_group_with_forceMount CommandGroup-->>CommandItem: render_items_with_forceMount_and_description end opt isLoading_true SearchResults->>CommandGroup: render_loading_group_with_forceMount CommandGroup-->>CommandItem: render_disabled_skeleton_items end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Ensure search result items and groups remain mounted for correct rendering and keyboard navigation during loading and filtering. |
  • Reordered CommandItem props so description is passed after forceMount, matching expected component prop patterns.
  • Added forceMount to all Command.Group instances that render each result category to keep groups mounted even when their visibility is controlled externally.
  • Added forceMount to the loading skeleton Command.Group so skeleton items remain mounted during async search.
| `src/features/CommandMenu/SearchResults.tsx` | | Prevent the "no results" empty state from displaying while a search is in progress or has results, avoiding visual conflicts with content and loading states. |
  • Wrapped Command.Empty in a conditional that only renders when there is no active search or search results, based on hasSearch, isSearching, and searchResults.length.
| `src/features/CommandMenu/index.tsx` | | Update Model Context Protocol SDK to the latest minor version for compatibility and bug fixes. |
  • Bumped @modelcontextprotocol/sdk dependency from ^1.25.3 to ^1.26.0.
| `package.json` |
---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. body:
## Reviewer's Guide Adds the ByteDance Seedream 5 Lite image generation model with preset size options to the Lobehub model bank, and updates the Volcengine image creation logic to accept a direct size parameter while preserving backward-compatible height/width handling. #### Sequence diagram for Volcengine createImage size handling ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Client participant LobehubImageService participant createVolcengineImage as VolcengineCreateImage participant VolcengineAPI Client->>LobehubImageService: requestImageGeneration(modelId, userInput) LobehubImageService->>VolcengineCreateImage: createVolcengineImage(modelId, userInput) alt userInput.size is defined VolcengineCreateImage->>VolcengineCreateImage: log Using direct size parameter else userInput.size is not defined VolcengineCreateImage->>VolcengineCreateImage: read userInput.height and userInput.width alt height and width are defined VolcengineCreateImage->>VolcengineCreateImage: set userInput.size = width x height VolcengineCreateImage->>VolcengineCreateImage: delete userInput.height and userInput.width else missing height or width VolcengineCreateImage->>VolcengineCreateImage: leave size undefined end end VolcengineCreateImage->>VolcengineAPI: call image generation with size VolcengineAPI-->>VolcengineCreateImage: image result VolcengineCreateImage-->>LobehubImageService: image result LobehubImageService-->>Client: image response ``` #### Class diagram for Lobehub image model bank with new Seedream5Lite model ```mermaid classDiagram class AIImageModelCard { +string id +string displayName +string description +boolean enabled +string type +AIImageParameters parameters +AIImagePricing pricing +string releasedAt } class AIImageParameters { +ImageUrlsParameter imageUrls +PromptParameter prompt +SeedParameter seed +SizeParameter size } class ImageUrlsParameter { +string[] default +number maxCount +number maxFileSize } class PromptParameter { +string default } class SeedParameter { +number default } class SizeParameter { +string default +string[] enum } class AIImagePricing { +PricingUnit[] units } class PricingUnit { +string name +number rate +string strategy +string unit } class Seedream5LiteModelCard { +id = seedream-5-0-260128 +displayName = Seedream 5 Lite +description +enabled = true +type = image +releasedAt = 2026-02-24 } class Seedream5LiteParameters { +imageUrls.default = [] +imageUrls.maxCount = 14 +imageUrls.maxFileSize = 10485760 +prompt.default = "" +seed.default = null +size.default = 2048x2048 +size.enum = [ 2048x2048, 2560x1440, 1440x2560, 3072x2048, 2048x3072, 2560x2048, 2048x2560, 3072x1920, 1920x3072 ] } AIImageModelCard "1" *-- "1" AIImageParameters AIImageModelCard "1" *-- "1" AIImagePricing AIImagePricing "1" *-- "*" PricingUnit Seedream5LiteModelCard --|> AIImageModelCard Seedream5LiteParameters --|> AIImageParameters ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce Seedream 5 Lite image model configuration with constrained size presets and pricing metadata. |
  • Register a new image model card entry with id `seedream-5-0-260128` and human-readable display name and description.
  • Define model parameters including prompt, optional seed, imageUrls constraints, and a `size` parameter with a default value and an explicit enum of supported resolutions.
  • Set fixed per-image pricing metadata and release date for the new model.
| `packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/lobehub/image.ts` | | Adjust Volcengine image creation to support direct size input while maintaining legacy height/width behavior. |
  • Check for an existing `size` field on the user input and, if present, log and use it directly.
  • Fallback to deriving `size` from `height` and `width` only when `size` is not provided, preserving the previous conversion behavior.
  • Ensure `height` and `width` are still removed from the payload when translated into `size` to match Volcengine API expectations.
| `packages/model-runtime/src/providers/volcengine/createImage.ts` | ### Possibly linked issues - **#9195**: PR implements the “Add Custom Image Model” task by adding Seedream 5 Lite plus improving Volcengine size handling. ---

## Reviewer's Guide Refactors the memory builtin tool executor to delegate all logic to a new shared MemoryExecutionRuntime, and introduces a server-side MemoryServerRuntimeService and runtime registration so memory tools can run on the server alongside a stub tools-activator runtime. #### Sequence diagram for server searchUserMemory execution ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Caller as ToolExecutionService participant Runtime as MemoryExecutionRuntime participant Service as MemoryServerRuntimeService participant ModelRT as ModelRuntime participant MemoryModel as UserMemoryModel participant DB as LobeChatDatabase Caller->>Runtime: searchUserMemory(params) Runtime->>Service: searchMemory(params) Service->>ModelRT: embeddings(query) ModelRT-->>Service: embeddingVector Service->>MemoryModel: searchWithEmbedding(embeddingVector, limits) MemoryModel->>DB: query user memories DB-->>MemoryModel: memory rows MemoryModel-->>Service: layeredResults Service-->>Runtime: SearchMemoryResult Runtime-->>Caller: BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput (formatted content, state) ``` #### Class diagram for shared MemoryExecutionRuntime and services ```mermaid classDiagram direction LR class MemoryRuntimeService { <> +addActivityMemory(params) +addContextMemory(params) +addExperienceMemory(params) +addIdentityMemory(params) +addPreferenceMemory(params) +removeIdentityMemory(params) +searchMemory(params) +updateIdentityMemory(params) } class MemoryExecutionRuntimeOptions { +MemoryRuntimeService service } class MemoryExecutionRuntime { -MemoryRuntimeService service +MemoryExecutionRuntime(options) +searchUserMemory(params) +addContextMemory(params) +addActivityMemory(params) +addExperienceMemory(params) +addIdentityMemory(params) +addPreferenceMemory(params) +updateIdentityMemory(params) +removeIdentityMemory(params) } class BaseExecutor { } class MemoryExecutor { MemoryExecutionRuntime runtime +MemoryExecutor() +searchUserMemory(params, ctx) +addContextMemory(params, ctx) +addActivityMemory(params, ctx) +addExperienceMemory(params, ctx) +addIdentityMemory(params, ctx) +addPreferenceMemory(params, ctx) +updateIdentityMemory(params, ctx) +removeIdentityMemory(params, ctx) -resolveToolPermission(agentId) -ensureWritable(agentId) -resolveMemoryEffort(agentId) } class MemoryServerRuntimeService { -UserMemoryModel memoryModel -LobeChatDatabase serverDB -string userId -MemoryEffort memoryEffort +MemoryServerRuntimeService(options) +searchMemory(params) +addContextMemory(params) +addActivityMemory(params) +addExperienceMemory(params) +addIdentityMemory(params) +addPreferenceMemory(params) +updateIdentityMemory(params) +removeIdentityMemory(params) } class UserMemoryModel { +UserMemoryModel(serverDB, userId) +searchWithEmbedding(options) +createContextMemory(options) +createActivityMemory(options) +createExperienceMemory(options) +createPreferenceMemory(options) +addIdentityEntry(options) +updateIdentityEntry(options) +removeIdentityEntry(identityId) } class memoryRuntime { +factory(context) +identifier } BaseExecutor <|-- MemoryExecutor MemoryExecutor --> MemoryExecutionRuntime MemoryExecutionRuntime --> MemoryRuntimeService MemoryServerRuntimeService ..|> MemoryRuntimeService MemoryServerRuntimeService --> UserMemoryModel memoryRuntime --> MemoryServerRuntimeService memoryRuntime --> MemoryExecutionRuntime ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Refactor MemoryExecutor to delegate to a shared execution runtime instead of calling userMemoryService directly. |
  • Switch imports to use type-only syntax where appropriate.
  • Instantiate a MemoryExecutionRuntime in the MemoryExecutor constructor using userMemoryService.
  • Replace inline search/add/update/remove implementations with thin wrappers that enforce permissions and forward to corresponding MemoryExecutionRuntime methods.
| `packages/builtin-tool-memory/src/executor/index.ts` | | Expose the new execution runtime from the memory builtin package. |
  • Add a new export path for the ExecutionRuntime module in the package exports map.
| `packages/builtin-tool-memory/package.json` | | Implement server-side memory runtime wiring backed by the database and model runtime so memory tools can execute on the server. |
  • Define helpers for normalizing memory effort, applying search limits, and mapping database search results into SearchMemoryResult.
  • Implement getEmbeddingRuntime and createEmbedder utilities to obtain embeddings from the configured model runtime.
  • Create MemoryServerRuntimeService that implements MemoryRuntimeService using UserMemoryModel and server DB, covering search and all add/update/remove operations with embedding generation.
  • Register memoryRuntime as a ServerRuntimeRegistration that reads per-user memory effort from user settings, constructs UserMemoryModel and MemoryServerRuntimeService, and returns a MemoryExecutionRuntime instance.
| `src/server/services/toolExecution/serverRuntimes/memory.ts` | | Introduce a shared MemoryExecutionRuntime abstraction to encapsulate memory operation behavior common to client and server runtimes. |
  • Define MemoryRuntimeService interface describing the underlying service contract for memory operations.
  • Implement MemoryExecutionRuntime that calls the injected service, formats search results, and standardizes success/error BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput for all memory APIs.
  • Ensure all methods handle service-level failures by returning appropriate content messages and success flags without exposing raw error bodies.
| `packages/builtin-tool-memory/src/ExecutionRuntime/index.ts` | | Register new memory and tools-activator server runtimes so they participate in server tool execution. |
  • Extend the registerRuntimes call to include memoryRuntime and toolsActivatorRuntime alongside existing runtimes.
| `src/server/services/toolExecution/serverRuntimes/index.ts` | | Add a stub server runtime for the tools activator builtin to track activated tools and later resolve manifests. |
  • Implement toolsActivatorRuntime ServerRuntimeRegistration that constructs an in-memory ToolsActivatorRuntimeService.
  • Track activated tool identifiers in memory and expose them via getActivatedToolIds while returning empty manifests as a stub implementation.
  • Wrap the service with ToolsActivatorExecutionRuntime for use by the server runtime registry.
| `src/server/services/toolExecution/serverRuntimes/tools.ts` | ### Possibly linked issues - **#**: The PR implements and registers a server memory runtime, resolving the "lobe-user-memory" not implemented error in subtasks. ---

user initialization payload and registration flow. #### Sequence diagram for user initialization without invite code requirement ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ClientApp participant UserRouter participant UserModel participant MessageModel participant SessionModel participant ReferralService participant BusinessUserService User ->> ClientApp: Open application ClientApp ->> UserRouter: initUser() par Fetch user state UserRouter ->> UserModel: getUserState(getUserKeyVaults) UserModel -->> UserRouter: userState and Count messages UserRouter ->> MessageModel: countUpTo(5) MessageModel -->> UserRouter: messageCount and Check extra sessions UserRouter ->> SessionModel: hasMoreThanN(1) SessionModel -->> UserRouter: hasExtraSession and Get referral status UserRouter ->> ReferralService: getReferralStatus(userId) ReferralService -->> UserRouter: referralStatus and Get subscription plan UserRouter ->> BusinessUserService: getSubscriptionPlan(userId) BusinessUserService -->> UserRouter: subscriptionPlan end UserRouter -->> ClientApp: UserInitializationState (no isInviteCodeRequired) ClientApp ->> ClientApp: useUserStateRedirect(state) alt Needs onboarding ClientApp ->> ClientApp: redirect to /onboarding else Does not need onboarding ClientApp ->> ClientApp: stay on current page end ``` #### Class diagram for updated UserInitializationState and user body:
@sourcery-ai Thanks for the review!

Regarding the first suggestion about `scripts/lint-ts.sh`:

> In `scripts/lint-ts.sh`, the second non-`--fix` ESLint run was removed

This appears to be a false positive. The second ESLint run without `--fix` is **not removed**. The only change I made was replacing the brace expansion glob pattern:

**Before:**
```bash
eslint "{src,tests}/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}" --fix --concurrency=auto --prune-suppressions
eslint "{src,tests}/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}" --concurrency=auto
```

**After:**
```bash
eslint "src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}" "tests/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}" --fix --concurrency=auto --prune-suppressions
eslint "src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}" "tests/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}" --concurrency=auto
```

Both runs are still present. The brace expansion `{src,tests}` doesn't work properly in Docker's shell environment, so I replaced it with explicit path arguments.

---

Regarding the second suggestion about extracting a shared prebuild script - this is a valid point for future refactoring, but I'd prefer to keep this PR focused on the bug fix. We can address the code duplication in a follow-up PR if needed.

## Reviewer's Guide Makes mobile topic and thread action dropdown menus controlled and renders their popups into the active drawer portal container to fix interaction issues on mobile while leaving desktop behavior unchanged. #### Sequence diagram for mobile topic/thread dropdown menu open with drawer portal ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor MobileUser participant Actions participant useServerConfigStore participant DOM participant DropdownMenu MobileUser->>Actions: tap MoreHorizontalIcon Actions->>useServerConfigStore: get isMobile useServerConfigStore-->>Actions: mobile Actions->>Actions: setOpen(true) Actions->>Actions: compute portalContainer (useMemo) Actions->>DOM: querySelectorAll(.ant-drawer-content-wrapper) DOM-->>Actions: NodeList drawerContainers Actions->>Actions: select topDrawerContainer Actions->>DOM: querySelector(.ant-drawer-section) DOM-->>Actions: portalContainer Actions->>DropdownMenu: render with Note over Actions,DropdownMenu: props: items, open, onOpenChange, portalProps{container:portalContainer} MobileUser->>DropdownMenu: tap menu item DropdownMenu-->>Actions: onOpenChange(false) Actions->>Actions: setOpen(false) Actions->>Actions: recompute portalContainer undefined ``` #### Updated class diagram for Actions components controlling mobile dropdown portal ```mermaid classDiagram class Actions { +dropdownMenu DropdownItem[] | function -mobile boolean -open boolean -portalContainer HTMLElement +render(): JSXElement } class useServerConfigStore { +isMobile boolean +getState(selector): any } class DropdownMenu { +items DropdownItem[] | function +open boolean +portalProps object +onOpenChange(nextOpen): void } class ActionIcon { +icon IconType +size string } Actions ..> useServerConfigStore : uses Actions ..> DropdownMenu : renders Actions ..> ActionIcon : renders ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Make topic and thread action dropdown menus controlled and portal them into the active drawer on mobile. |
  • Switch DropdownMenu usage from uncontrolled to controlled by adding local open state and onOpenChange handler.
  • Use useServerConfigStore to detect mobile environment via isMobile.
  • Compute a portal container with useMemo that, on mobile and when open, finds the topmost .ant-drawer-content-wrapper and prefers its .ant-drawer-section as the render target.
  • Pass portalProps.container to DropdownMenu when a drawer container is resolved, falling back to default behavior otherwise.
  • Apply the same controlled + portal behavior consistently across agent and group topic item and thread item action components.

reasoning_content Client->>ChatService: send chat messages (may include reasoning) ChatService->>ModelRuntime: convertOpenAIMessages(messages) activate ModelRuntime Note over ModelRuntime: For each message ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: if content is array ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: convertMessageContent for each part ModelRuntime->>ChatService: messagesWithoutReasoning deactivate ModelRuntime Note over ChatService,DeepSeekProvider: Request to DeepSeek ChatService->>DeepSeekProvider: payload { messagesWithoutReasoning, model } activate DeepSeekProvider DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: chatCompletion.handlePayload(payload) Note over DeepSeekProvider: For each message in payload.messages DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: if message.reasoning.content exists DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: create reasoning_content = reasoning.content DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: remove reasoning field DeepSeekProvider->>ChatService: normalizedPayload { messages, stream } deactivate DeepSeekProvider ChatService->>DeepSeekAPI: normalizedPayload (with reasoning_content only) DeepSeekAPI-->>ChatService: streaming response (content + reasoning) %% Response phase: map back into Responses API items ChatService->>ModelRuntime: convertOpenAIResponseInputs(messages) activate ModelRuntime Note over ModelRuntime: For each message ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: if message.reasoning.content exists ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: push { type: reasoning, summary[] } ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: if role is assistant with tool_calls ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: map to function ResponseFunctionToolCallItem ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: else if role is tool ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: map to function ResponseFunctionToolCallOutputItem ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: else if role is system ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: push item with role = developer ModelRuntime->>ModelRuntime: default push message item (without reasoning) ModelRuntime->>ResponsesAPI: responseInputItems deactivate ModelRuntime ResponsesAPI-->>Client: structured reasoning + chat items ``` #### Sequence diagram for SSRF-safe image URL to base64 conversion ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ChatUI participant Provider as ImageProvider_or_ContextBuilder participant Utils as Utils_imageUrlToBase64 participant SSRFFetch as SSRFSafeFetch participant BrowserFetch as BrowserFetch User->>ChatUI: send message with image URL ChatUI->>Provider: payload with image_url content Note over Provider: Parse data URI or URL Provider->>Provider: parseDataUri(image_url) alt type is base64 Provider->>Provider: use base64 directly else type is url Provider->>Utils: imageUrlToBase64(imageUrl) activate Utils Utils->>Utils: detect isServer (window undefined?) alt isServer (Node) Utils->>SSRFFetch: ssrfSafeFetch(imageUrl) activate SSRFFetch SSRFFetch-->>Utils: Response (after SSRF checks) deactivate SSRFFetch else isBrowser Utils->>BrowserFetch: fetch(imageUrl) activate BrowserFetch BrowserFetch-->>Utils: Response deactivate BrowserFetch end Utils->>Utils: response.blob() -> arrayBuffer alt isServer Utils->>Utils: Buffer.from(arrayBuffer).toString(base64) else isBrowser Utils->>Utils: btoa from Uint8Array end Utils-->>Provider: { base64, mimeType } deactivate Utils Provider->>Provider: attach images[] with base64 end Provider-->>ChatUI: provider-specific payload with images base64 ChatUI-->>User: model output using processed images ``` #### Updated class diagram for chat messages, reasoning, and image utilities ```mermaid classDiagram class OpenAIChatMessage { +string content +UserMessageContentPart[] content +string role +string name +MessageReasoning reasoning +string tool_call_id +MessageToolCall[] tool_calls } class MessageReasoning { +string content +number duration } class ConvertOpenAIMessages { +convertOpenAIMessages(messages) } class ConvertOpenAIResponseInputs { +convertOpenAIResponseInputs(messages) } class DeepSeekParams { +string baseURL +ChatCompletionConfig chatCompletion } class ChatCompletionConfig { +handlePayload(payload) } class LobeOllamaAI { +chat(payload, options) -buildOllamaMessages(messages) -convertContentToOllamaMessage(message) } class OllamaMessage { +string content +string role +string[] images } class ImageUtils { +imageToBase64(options) +imageUrlToBase64(imageUrl) } class SSRFSafeFetch { +ssrfSafeFetch(url, options) } class FetchSSE { +fetchSSE(url, options) +getMessageError(response) } OpenAIChatMessage --> MessageReasoning ConvertOpenAIMessages ..> OpenAIChatMessage : input ConvertOpenAIMessages ..> OpenAIChatMessage : output (normalized) ConvertOpenAIResponseInputs ..> OpenAIChatMessage : input DeepSeekParams --> ChatCompletionConfig ChatCompletionConfig ..> OpenAIChatMessage : transforms messages LobeOllamaAI ..> OpenAIChatMessage : reads LobeOllamaAI --> OllamaMessage : builds LobeOllamaAI ..> ImageUtils : uses imageUrlToBase64 ImageUtils ..> SSRFSafeFetch : server-side FetchSSE <.. ChatService : used by FetchSSE <.. ClientModelRuntime : used by FetchSSE ..> SSRFSafeFetch : error parsing independent ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Normalize OpenAI chat messages and responses to support reasoning metadata (DeepSeek compatibility) while cleaning server-side payloads. |

## Reviewer's Guide Refactors the client agent runtime by inlining the AI streaming logic from the store-level StreamingExecutor into the call_llm agent executor, centralizing streaming/handler behavior around chatService.createAssistantMessageStream, and updating tests and mocks to reflect the new architecture while preserving behavior for streaming, tool calls, grouping, and metadata. #### Sequence diagram for inlined agent runtime streaming with StreamingHandler ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant AgentExecutor as AgentExecutor_call_llm participant ChatStore as ChatStore participant Operation as OperationContext participant StreamingHandler as StreamingHandler participant ChatService as chatService participant FileStore as FileStore participant MessageService as MessageService AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: get() ChatStore-->>AgentExecutor: optimisticUpdateMessageContent, internal_dispatchMessage, internal_toggleToolCallingStreaming AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: get().operations[operationId] ChatStore-->>AgentExecutor: Operation AgentExecutor->>Operation: read context (agentId, subAgentId, groupId, topicId, abortController, metadata.traceId) AgentExecutor->>StreamingHandler: new StreamingHandler(handlerContext, callbacks) AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: get() ChatStore-->>AgentExecutor: startOperation, associateMessageWithOperation, internal_transformToolCalls, completeOperation AgentExecutor->>ChatService: createAssistantMessageStream(params, historySummary, initialContext, stepContext, trace, handlers) loop streaming chunks ChatService-->>AgentExecutor: onMessageHandle(chunk) AgentExecutor->>StreamingHandler: handleChunk(chunk) alt content update StreamingHandler-->>AgentExecutor: onContentUpdate(content, reasoning, contentMetadata) AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: internal_dispatchMessage(updateMessage for content) end alt reasoning update StreamingHandler-->>AgentExecutor: onReasoningUpdate(reasoning) AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: internal_dispatchMessage(updateMessage for reasoning) end alt tools update StreamingHandler-->>AgentExecutor: onToolCallsUpdate(tools) AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: internal_dispatchMessage(updateMessage for tools) end alt grounding update StreamingHandler-->>AgentExecutor: onGroundingUpdate(grounding) AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: internal_dispatchMessage(updateMessage for search) end alt images update StreamingHandler-->>AgentExecutor: onImagesUpdate(images) AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: internal_dispatchMessage(updateMessage for imageList) end alt base64 image upload StreamingHandler->>FileStore: uploadBase64FileWithProgress(data) FileStore-->>StreamingHandler: file(id, url, alt) end end ChatService-->>AgentExecutor: onFinish(content, finishPayload) AgentExecutor->>StreamingHandler: handleFinish(finishPayload) StreamingHandler-->>AgentExecutor: result(content, tools, metadata, usage, toolCalls) AgentExecutor->>MessageService: updateMessage(traceId, observationId, routingContext) AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: optimisticUpdateMessageContent(final content, metadata, { operationId }) AgentExecutor->>StreamingHandler: getIsFunctionCall() AgentExecutor->>StreamingHandler: getOutput() AgentExecutor->>StreamingHandler: getTools() AgentExecutor->>StreamingHandler: getFinishType() AgentExecutor-->>AgentExecutor: use finalUsage and finalToolCalls for next state ChatService-->>AgentExecutor: onErrorHandle(error) AgentExecutor->>ChatStore: optimisticUpdateMessageError(assistantMessageId, error, { operationId }) ``` #### Class diagram for StreamingHandler and agent runtime executor integration ```mermaid classDiagram class AgentExecutorContext { +string operationId +ResolvedAgentConfig agentConfig +function get() } class StreamingHandler { +StreamingHandler(handlerContext, callbacks) +handleChunk(chunk) +handleFinish(finishPayload) Result +getIsFunctionCall() bool +getOutput() string +getTools() ChatToolPayload[] +getTraceId() string +getFinishType() string } class StreamingHandlerContext { +string messageId +string operationId +string agentId +string groupId +string topicId } class StreamingHandlerCallbacks { +onContentUpdate(content, reasoning, contentMetadata) +onReasoningUpdate(reasoning) +onToolCallsUpdate(tools) +onGroundingUpdate(grounding) +onImagesUpdate(images) +onReasoningStart() +onReasoningComplete(operationId) +uploadBase64Image(data) +transformToolCalls(toolCalls) +toggleToolCallingStreaming(enabled) } class ChatStore { +operations Operation[] +startOperation(params) OperationRef +associateMessageWithOperation(messageId, operationId) +completeOperation(operationId) +internal_dispatchMessage(messageAction, meta) +internal_transformToolCalls(toolCalls) +internal_toggleToolCallingStreaming(enabled) +optimisticUpdateMessageContent(messageId, content, metadata, meta) +optimisticUpdateMessageError(messageId, error, meta) } class Operation { +string id +OperationContext context +AbortController abortController +OperationMetadata metadata } class OperationContext { +string agentId +string subAgentId +string groupId +string topicId +string threadId +MessageMapScope scope +string messageId } class OperationMetadata { +string traceId } class ChatService { +createAssistantMessageStream(params) } class FileStore { +uploadBase64FileWithProgress(data) File } class MessageService { +updateMessage(messageId, patch, routingContext) } class Result { +string content +ChatToolPayload[] tools +ResultMetadata metadata +ModelUsage usage +MessageToolCall[] toolCalls } class ResultMetadata { +ResultUsageMetadata usage +ResultPerformanceMetadata performance +string finishType +bool isMultimodal +string reasoning +any search +any imageList } AgentExecutorContext --> ChatStore : uses AgentExecutorContext --> ChatService : uses AgentExecutorContext --> StreamingHandler : creates StreamingHandler o-- StreamingHandlerContext : has StreamingHandler o-- StreamingHandlerCallbacks : has ChatStore --> Operation : manages Operation o-- OperationContext : has Operation o-- OperationMetadata : has StreamingHandlerCallbacks --> ChatStore : dispatches updates StreamingHandlerCallbacks --> FileStore : uploads images ChatService --> StreamingHandler : sends chunks to ChatService --> ChatStore : uses abortController from Operation StreamingHandler --> Result : returns Result o-- ResultMetadata : has MessageService --> OperationContext : uses routing info AgentExecutorContext --> MessageService : updates message metadata ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Inline internal_fetchAIChatMessage streaming logic into the call_llm executor and remove the old method from the StreamingExecutor actions. |
  • Deleted internal_fetchAIChatMessage implementation from the StreamingExecutorActionImpl, including its use of StreamingHandler and StreamChunk types.
  • Reimplemented the streaming flow directly inside createAgentExecutors.call_llm, wiring chatService.createAssistantMessageStream with StreamingHandler callbacks for content, reasoning, tools, grounding, images, and reasoning sub-operations.
  • Derived agentId/groupId/topicId and abortController from the current operation context inside call_llm, including group orchestration behavior (subAgentId vs agentId), and used pre-resolved agentConfig plus history summary for streaming params.
  • On stream finish, updated the assistant message via optimisticUpdateMessageContent with content, tools, metadata (usage, performance, finishType, multimodal, etc.), and persisted traceId/observationId via messageService.updateMessage.
  • Captured model usage and raw toolCalls from the handler to feed back into the executor’s step usage and tool-calling payloads.
| `src/store/chat/slices/aiChat/actions/streamingExecutor.ts`
`src/store/chat/agents/createAgentExecutors.ts` | | Move StreamingHandler into the agents layer and adjust mocks/helpers to work with the new streaming entry point. |
  • Relocated StreamingHandler from the aiChat actions directory into src/store/chat/agents, and updated imports in createAgentExecutors to use the new location and local StreamChunk type.
  • Extended the createMockStore fixture to provide internal_toggleToolCallingStreaming, internal_transformToolCalls (mapping MessageToolCall.function.name into ChatToolPayload), optimisticUpdateMessageError, and removed internal_fetchAIChatMessage from the mock API surface.
  • Removed the expectFetchAIChatMessageCalled assertion helper, since call_llm no longer delegates to internal_fetchAIChatMessage.
| `src/store/chat/agents/StreamingHandler.ts`
`src/store/chat/agents/createAgentExecutors.ts`
`src/store/chat/agents/__tests__/createAgentExecutors/fixtures/mockStore.ts`
`src/store/chat/agents/__tests__/createAgentExecutors/helpers/assertions.ts` | | Shift streaming-focused tests from the aiChat StreamingExecutor tests into call_llm executor tests and mock chatService/messageService appropriately. |
  • Removed the internal_fetchAIChatMessage test suite and associated StreamingHandler tests under StreamingExecutor, and marked a couple of describe blocks in streamingExecutor tests as skipped because the functionality was inlined into call_llm.
  • Added module-level mocks for chatService.createAssistantMessageStream, messageService.updateMessage, topicSelectors, file store, and agent store/selectors in call-llm tests.
  • Introduced a mockStreamResponse helper in call-llm.test.ts to simulate text and tool_calls streaming plus onFinish metadata, and rewired existing tests to use it instead of mocking internal_fetchAIChatMessage.
  • Updated expectations across call-llm tests to assert direct calls to chatService.createAssistantMessageStream (checking params: model, provider, messages filtering, etc.) and to validate behavior for tool-calls, abort vs stop finish types, usage aggregation, message reuse/compression, group orchestration fields (agentId, subAgentId, groupId), and history/session handling.
| `src/store/chat/slices/aiChat/actions/__tests__/streamingExecutor.test.ts`
`src/store/chat/agents/__tests__/createAgentExecutors/call-llm.test.ts` | | Enhance call_llm behavior around group orchestration, supervisor metadata, and message creation flags. |
  • Ensured group orchestration uses subAgentId as the effective agentId for streaming and message context when groupId is present, while falling back to agentId otherwise, and propagated groupId into messages where appropriate.
  • Added support for marking assistant messages with metadata.isSupervisor when the operation context includes isSupervisor, leaving metadata undefined for normal agents.
  • Refined the skipCreateFirstMessage / createAssistantMessage interplay so that a new assistant message is still created when createAssistantMessage is explicitly true (e.g., post-compression), and only skipped on the first call when both flags indicate skipping; added tests verifying first vs subsequent call behavior.
  • Tightened tool-calling payload expectations to only assert presence and non-emptiness of toolsCalling rather than exact structure, since transformation now occurs via internal_transformToolCalls.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Replaces the virtualized model list in the ModelSwitchPanel with a straightforward mapped list, removes scroll-based UI state handling, and ensures the panel container can receive pointer events. #### Sequence diagram for scroll behavior change in ModelSwitchPanel list ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ScrollContainer as ScrollContainer participant List as List participant ListItemRenderer as ListItemRenderer participant MultipleProvidersModelItem as MultipleProvidersModelItem rect rgb(240,240,240) note over User,MultipleProvidersModelItem: Previous implementation with virtualized list and scroll-based state User->>ScrollContainer: Scroll list ScrollContainer->>List: onScroll event List->>List: handleScrollingStateChange(true) List->>ListItemRenderer: render items with isScrolling true ListItemRenderer->>ListItemRenderer: useEffect on isScrolling ListItemRenderer->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: render with isScrolling true MultipleProvidersModelItem->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: useEffect on isScrolling MultipleProvidersModelItem->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: setSubmenuOpen(false) ListItemRenderer->>ListItemRenderer: setDetailOpen(false) end rect rgb(220,255,220) note over User,MultipleProvidersModelItem: New implementation with simple mapped list and no scroll-based closing User->>ScrollContainer: Scroll list ScrollContainer->>List: scroll handled by browser List->>List: compute listHeight List->>ListItemRenderer: map listItems and render (no isScrolling prop) ListItemRenderer->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: render (no isScrolling prop) MultipleProvidersModelItem->>User: Submenus and details remain open while scrolling end ``` #### Updated class diagram for ModelSwitchPanel list components ```mermaid classDiagram class ModelSwitchPanelStyles { +container } class List { +listItems: ListItem[] +panelHeight: number +extraControls(modelId: string, providerId: string): ReactNode +modelProp: string +providerProp: string +render(): JSXElement } class ListItemRenderer { +activeKey: string +extraControls(modelId: string, providerId: string): ReactNode +item: ListItem +newLabel: string +onClose(): void +onModelChange(modelId: string, providerId: string): Promise~void~ } class MultipleProvidersModelItem { +activeKey: string +data: ModelWithProviders +extraControls(modelId: string, providerId: string): ReactNode +newLabel: string +onClose(): void +onModelChange(modelId: string, providerId: string): Promise~void~ } class SingleProviderModelItem { +activeKey: string +data: ModelWithProvider +extraControls(modelId: string, providerId: string): ReactNode +newLabel: string +onClose(): void +onModelChange(modelId: string, providerId: string): Promise~void~ } class ListItem { +type: string } class ModelWithProviders { +model: Model +providers: Provider[] } class ModelWithProvider { +model: Model +provider: Provider } class Model { +id: string +displayName: string } class Provider { +id: string } List --> ListItemRenderer : renders via map(listItems) ListItemRenderer --> MultipleProvidersModelItem : uses when item.type is multiple-providers ListItemRenderer --> SingleProviderModelItem : uses when item.type is single-provider ListItemRenderer --> ListItem : item prop MultipleProvidersModelItem --> ModelWithProviders : data SingleProviderModelItem --> ModelWithProvider : data ModelWithProviders --> Model ModelWithProviders --> Provider ModelWithProvider --> Model ModelWithProvider --> Provider ModelSwitchPanelStyles <.. List : uses container with pointer-events auto ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Replace Virtuoso-based virtualized list with a standard mapped list implementation in the model switch panel. |
  • Remove local isScrolling state and its updater callback from the list component.
  • Replace Virtuoso usage with direct listItems.map rendering of ListItemRenderer components.
  • Compute and apply a fixed list height based on panel and toolbar/footer dimensions.
  • Provide a stable React key for each rendered item using provider/model identifiers or a synthesized fallback key.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/index.tsx` | | Simplify list item components by removing scroll-driven UI behavior that closed details/menus while scrolling. |
  • Remove isScrolling prop from ListItemRenderer and MultipleProvidersModelItem component interfaces and usages.
  • Delete useEffect hooks that watched isScrolling to close detail or submenu state during scroll.
  • Adjust prop passing chain so nested components no longer expect or forward isScrolling.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/ListItemRenderer.tsx`
`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/MultipleProvidersModelItem.tsx` | | Ensure the model switch panel container responds to mouse interactions. |
  • Enable pointer events on the panel container via CSS to fix interaction issues over the panel area.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/styles.ts` |

## Reviewer's Guide Implements progressive tool discovery with the lobe-tools system by wiring tool availability into context engineering, dynamically injecting explicitly activated tools into agent configs, improving web search error handling, and enhancing tool execution and debugger UX across frontend and server runtimes. #### Sequence diagram for progressive tool activation via lobe-tools ## Reviewer's Guide Adds the new 🍌 Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview) chat/image models with extended aspect ratios and 0.5K resolution, wires them into runtime/model whitelists and display-name processing, prefixes all Nano Banana models with the 🍌 emoji, and removes the deprecated Gemini Chinese image warning and related state/UI bits. #### Sequence diagram for image generation without Gemini Chinese warning ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant PromptInputComponent participant UserStore participant ImageStore participant ModelRuntime participant GoogleProvider User->>PromptInputComponent: submitPrompt() PromptInputComponent->>UserStore: isLogin() UserStore-->>PromptInputComponent: loginStatus alt notLoggedIn PromptInputComponent->>User: redirectToLogin() else loggedIn PromptInputComponent->>ImageStore: createImage() ImageStore->>ModelRuntime: generateImage(prompt, modelId) ModelRuntime->>GoogleProvider: callImageModel(modelId, parameters) GoogleProvider-->>ModelRuntime: imageResult ModelRuntime-->>ImageStore: imageResult ImageStore-->>PromptInputComponent: updateImageState(imageResult) PromptInputComponent-->>User: showGeneratedImage() end ``` #### Class diagram for Nano Banana 2 model cards and parameters ```mermaid classDiagram class ModelParamsSchema { } class NanoBananaParameters { aspectRatio: string[] imageUrls: string[] prompt: string resolution: string } class NanoBanana2Parameters { NANO_BANANA_2_ASPECT_RATIOS: string[] aspectRatio.default: string aspectRatio.enum: string[] imageUrls.default: any[] prompt.default: string resolution.default: string resolution.enum: string[] } class AIImageModelCard { id: string displayName: string description: string enabled: boolean parameters: ModelParamsSchema pricing.approximatePricePerImage: number pricing.units: PricingUnit[] releasedAt: string type: string } class AIChatModelCard { id: string displayName: string description: string enabled: boolean abilities.imageOutput: boolean abilities.reasoning: boolean abilities.search: boolean abilities.vision: boolean contextWindowTokens: number maxOutput: number pricing.approximatePricePerImage: number pricing.units: PricingUnit[] releasedAt: string settings.searchImpl: string settings.searchProvider: string type: string } class PricingUnit { name: string rate: number strategy: string unit: string } class LobehubImageModels { lobehubImageModels: AIImageModelCard[] } class GoogleChatModels { googleChatModels: AIChatModelCard[] } class NanoBanana2ImageModelCard { id = gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview:image displayName = "🍌 Nano Banana 2" description enabled = true parameters = nanoBanana2Parameters pricing.approximatePricePerImage = 0.067 pricing.units[imageOutput] rate = 60 pricing.units[textInput] rate = 0.25 pricing.units[textOutput] rate = 1.5 releasedAt = 2026-02-26 type = image } class NanoBanana2ChatModelCard { id = gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview displayName = "🍌 Nano Banana 2" description abilities.imageOutput = true abilities.reasoning = true abilities.search = true abilities.vision = true contextWindowTokens = 163840 maxOutput = 32768 pricing.approximatePricePerImage = 0.067 pricing.units[imageOutput] rate = 60 pricing.units[textInput] rate = 0.25 pricing.units[textOutput] rate = 1.5 releasedAt = 2026-02-26 settings.searchImpl = params settings.searchProvider = google type = chat } class ModelProcessor { processDisplayName(displayName: string) string } class PostProcessModelList { IMAGE_GENERATION_MODEL_WHITELIST: string[] } class GoogleProviderRuntime { modelsWithModalities: Set } class SystemStatus { groupAgentBuilderPanelWidth?: number hidePWAInstaller?: boolean hideThreadLimitAlert?: boolean hideTopicSharePrivacyWarning?: boolean } ModelParamsSchema <|-- NanoBananaParameters ModelParamsSchema <|-- NanoBanana2Parameters PricingUnit "1" -- "*" AIImageModelCard : pricing.units PricingUnit "1" -- "*" AIChatModelCard : pricing.units LobehubImageModels "1" o-- "*" AIImageModelCard GoogleChatModels "1" o-- "*" AIChatModelCard NanoBanana2Parameters <.. NanoBanana2ImageModelCard : parameters NanoBanana2ImageModelCard ..> AIImageModelCard : implements NanoBanana2ChatModelCard ..> AIChatModelCard : implements ModelProcessor ..> AIChatModelCard : processDisplayName PostProcessModelList ..> AIImageModelCard : whitelistIds GoogleProviderRuntime ..> AIChatModelCard : modelsWithModalities SystemStatus ..> GoogleProviderRuntime ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview) as both chat and image models with pricing and parameters wired up. |
  • Add a new google chat model card for gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview with multimodal abilities, pricing, and metadata.
  • Add a new image model card gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview:image with its own parameters and pricing.
  • Define nanoBanana2Parameters including extended aspect ratios and 0.5K/1K/2K/4K resolution options.
| `packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/lobehub/chat/google.ts`
`packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/lobehub/image.ts`
`packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/lobehub/utils.ts` | | Wire Nano Banana 2 into runtime/model selection and display-name processing. |
  • Add gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview and its free variant to IMAGE_GENERATION_MODEL_WHITELIST.
  • Include gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview in the Google provider modelsWithModalities set.
  • Extend processDisplayName to map Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview → 🍌 Nano Banana 2 and update existing mapping for Gemini 2.5.

`packages/model-runtime/src/providers/google/index.ts`
`packages/model-runtime/src/utils/modelParse.ts` | | Standardize Nano Banana model display names with the 🍌 prefix in chat and image model banks. |
  • Update Nano Banana Pro chat/image cards to include the 🍌 prefix in displayName.
  • Update Nano Banana (2.5) chat/image cards to include the 🍌 prefix in displayName.
| `packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/lobehub/chat/google.ts`
`packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/lobehub/image.ts`

  • Remove useGeminiChineseWarning usage from the image PromptInput flow so image creation no longer shows or blocks on the warning.
  • Delete the i18n strings for the Gemini Chinese warning from common locale files.
  • Drop the hideGemini2_5FlashImagePreviewChineseWarning field from SystemStatus and INITIAL_STATUS and remove the hook implementation file.

config/schema/resolver/UI, and introduces a MiniMax-M2.5 Qwen chat model plus minor formatting fixes. #### Sequence diagram for resolving Nano Banana 2 extend params ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ControlsForm participant AgentConfigStore participant ModelParamsResolver participant GoogleModelClient User->>ControlsForm: Adjust ImageResolution2Slider and ThinkingLevel4Slider ControlsForm->>AgentConfigStore: Update imageResolution2, thinkingLevel4 in LobeAgentChatConfig User->>ControlsForm: Send message with Nano Banana 2 model ControlsForm->>AgentConfigStore: Read LobeAgentChatConfig ControlsForm->>ModelParamsResolver: resolveModelExtendParams(ctx) ModelParamsResolver->>ModelParamsResolver: Check model.settings.extendParams ModelParamsResolver->>ModelParamsResolver: Map thinkingLevel4 -> extendParams.thinkingLevel ModelParamsResolver->>ModelParamsResolver: Map imageResolution2 -> extendParams.imageResolution ModelParamsResolver-->>ControlsForm: ModelExtendParams with thinkingLevel, imageResolution ControlsForm->>GoogleModelClient: Call gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview with extendParams GoogleModelClient-->>ControlsForm: Image response ControlsForm-->>User: Display generated image ``` #### Class diagram for extended chat config and model params ```mermaid classDiagram class LobeAgentChatConfig { +imageResolution: string ("1K"|"2K"|"4K") +imageResolution2: string ("512px"|"1K"|"2K"|"4K") +thinkingLevel: string ("minimal"|"low"|"medium"|"high") +thinkingLevel2: string ("low"|"high") +thinkingLevel3: string ("low"|"medium"|"high") +thinkingLevel4: string ("minimal"|"high") } class AgentChatConfigSchema { +imageResolution: schema +imageResolution2: schema +thinkingLevel: schema +thinkingLevel2: schema +thinkingLevel3: schema +thinkingLevel4: schema } class AiModelSettings { +extendParams: ExtendParamsType[] +searchImpl: string +searchProvider: string } class ExtendParamsType { <> thinkingLevel thinkingLevel2 thinkingLevel3 thinkingLevel4 imageAspectRatio imageResolution imageResolution2 urlContext } class ModelParamsResolver { +resolveModelExtendParams(ctx: ModelParamsContext): ModelExtendParams } class GoogleChatModelCard { +id: string +displayName: string +settings: AiModelSettings } class GoogleImageModelCard { +id: string +displayName: string +parameters: ModelParamsSchema } class ModelParamsSchema { +aspectRatio: object +imageUrls: object +prompt: object +resolution: object } LobeAgentChatConfig <.. AgentChatConfigSchema : validates ExtendParamsType <.. AiModelSettings : uses AiModelSettings <.. GoogleChatModelCard : has ModelParamsSchema <.. GoogleImageModelCard : uses LobeAgentChatConfig <.. ModelParamsResolver : reads AiModelSettings <.. ModelParamsResolver : reads ModelParamsResolver ..> ExtendParamsType : filters ``` #### Class diagram for new slider components ```mermaid classDiagram class createLevelSliderComponent { <> +createLevelSliderComponent(levels: T[], configKey: string, defaultValue: T): SliderComponent } class ImageResolution2Slider { +ImageResolution2SliderProps props } class ThinkingLevel4Slider { +ThinkingLevel4SliderProps props } class ControlsForm { +render(): JSXElement } class ExtendParamsSelect { +render(): JSXElement } ImageResolution2Slider ..> createLevelSliderComponent : createdWith ThinkingLevel4Slider ..> createLevelSliderComponent : createdWith ControlsForm --> ImageResolution2Slider : renders ControlsForm --> ThinkingLevel4Slider : renders ExtendParamsSelect --> ImageResolution2Slider : previews ExtendParamsSelect --> ThinkingLevel4Slider : previews ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) chat and image models with dedicated parameters and pricing. |
  • Register Nano Banana 2 as a chat model with reasoning, search, vision, image output abilities and pricing metadata.
  • Define extended aspect ratios for Nano Banana 2 and a dedicated nanoBanana2Parameters schema including 512px+ resolutions.
  • Register Nano Banana 2 as an image model using nanoBanana2Parameters and matching pricing/description metadata.
| `packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/google.ts` | | Introduce MiniMax-M2.5 to the Qwen model bank and normalize minor formatting. |
  • Add MiniMax-M2.5 chat model card with reasoning, search, functionCall abilities and CNY pricing.
  • Normalize trailing commas in existing Qwen model ability objects.
| `packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/qwen.ts` | | Add new extend params thinkingLevel4 and imageResolution2 end-to-end (types, schema, resolver, and UI controls). |
  • Extend LobeAgentChatConfig and AgentChatConfigSchema with imageResolution2 and thinkingLevel4 enums.
  • Update model extendParams type/enum to include thinkingLevel4 and imageResolution2.
  • Map thinkingLevel4 and imageResolution2 from chat config into generic extendParams in modelParamsResolver.
  • Expose thinkingLevel4 and imageResolution2 as selectable extend params in CreateNewModel modal, including preview metadata and default previews.
  • Add localized hints/labels for imageResolution2 and thinkingLevel4 in modelProvider locale files.
| `packages/types/src/agent/chatConfig.ts`
`packages/model-bank/src/types/aiModel.ts`
`src/services/chat/mecha/modelParamsResolver.ts`

`src/locales/default/modelProvider.ts`
`locales/en-US/modelProvider.json`
`locales/zh-CN/modelProvider.json` | | Add UI controls for Nano Banana 2 thinking level and extended image resolution, including reusable slider components. |
  • Add ThinkingLevel4Slider and ImageResolution2Slider components using createLevelSliderComponent.
  • Wire ThinkingLevel4Slider and ImageResolution2Slider into the chat ControlsForm extend params list for models that enable them.

body:
Thanks for the review @sourcery-ai! Addressing both points:

**1. `chatModels: []` in provider card** — This is the standard pattern. All providers (including DeepSeek, Groq, Mistral, etc.) have `chatModels: []` in their provider card. The actual models are registered separately through `LOBE_DEFAULT_MODEL_LIST` in `packages/model-bank/src/aiModels/index.ts`, which picks up the models from `aiModels/avian.ts`. No change needed here.

**2. `ENABLED_AVIAN` env mapping** — Using `!!process.env.AVIAN_API_KEY` follows the same pattern as DeepSeek, Perplexity, Minimax, OpenRouter, Fireworks, and most other third-party providers. The `process.env.ENABLED_X !== '0'` pattern is only used by built-in providers (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic) that are enabled by default. No change needed.

participant ControlsForm as ControlsForm participant AgentStore as useAgentStore participant UpdateConfig as useUpdateAgentConfig User->>ModelSwitch: click current model avatar ModelSwitch->>ModelSwitchPanel: open dropdown with model list User->>ModelSwitchPanel: select a model ModelSwitchPanel->>ModelSwitch: onModelChange callback ModelSwitch->>AgentStore: updateAgentConfigById(agentId, model, provider) AgentStore-->>ModelSwitch: config updated ModelSwitch->>AiInfraStore: get state ModelSwitch->>AiModelSelectors: isModelHasExtendParams(model, provider) AiModelSelectors-->>ModelSwitch: boolean hasExtendParams alt hasExtendParams is true ModelSwitch-->>User: render SettingsAction next to model avatar else ModelSwitch-->>User: SettingsAction hidden end ModelDetailPanel->>AgentStore: read enabled models via useEnabledChatModels ModelDetailPanel-->>User: show model details accordion alt hasExtendParams is true ModelDetailPanel->>ControlsForm: render in config accordion section User->>ControlsForm: adjust sliders and selects ControlsForm->>UpdateConfig: updateAgentConfig(agentId, extendParams) UpdateConfig->>AgentStore: persist new extended params ## Reviewer's Guide Adds per-agent memory enablement and effort controls, wires them through chat config, UI, and chat service, and introduces selectors and tests to support the new behavior alongside i18n updates. #### Sequence diagram for message send with per-agent memory settings ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant UI as ChatInput participant MemoryAction as MemoryActionBar participant AgentStore participant ChatService participant UserStore User->>UI: Type message User->>MemoryAction: Open memory popover MemoryAction->>AgentStore: select isMemoryEnabledById(agentId) AgentStore-->>MemoryAction: isEnabled alt user toggles memory User->>MemoryAction: Click enable or disable MemoryAction->>AgentStore: updateAgentChatConfig(memory.enabled) AgentStore-->>MemoryAction: memory updated end User->>UI: Press send UI->>ChatService: sendChat(agentId, message) ChatService->>AgentStore: getChatConfigById(agentId) AgentStore-->>ChatService: AgentMemoryChatConfig ChatService->>UserStore: getUserStoreState UserStore-->>ChatService: UserStoreState ChatService->>UserStore: SettingsSelectors.memoryEnabled(state) UserStore-->>ChatService: globalMemoryEnabled ChatService->>UserStore: SettingsSelectors.currentMemorySettings(state) UserStore-->>ChatService: UserMemorySettings ChatService->>ChatService: agentMemoryEnabled = chatConfig.memory.enabled ?? false ChatService->>ChatService: enableUserMemories = globalMemoryEnabled && agentMemoryEnabled ChatService->>ChatService: effectiveMemoryEffort = chatConfig.memory.effort ?? userMemorySettings.effort ?? medium ChatService-->>UI: Stream reply (respecting enableUserMemories and effectiveMemoryEffort) UI-->>User: Display assistant response ``` #### Class diagram for updated agent memory chat configuration and selectors ```mermaid classDiagram class AgentMemoryChatConfig { +memory MemoryConfig~optional~ } class MemoryConfig { +effort UserMemoryEffort~optional~ +enabled boolean~optional~ +toolPermission MemoryToolPermission~optional~ } class UserMemoryEffort { <> low medium high } class MemoryToolPermission { <> read_only read_write } class ChatConfigByIdSelectors { +getChatConfigById(agentId string) AgentMemoryChatConfig +getMemoryConfigById(agentId string) MemoryConfig +isMemoryEnabledById(agentId string) boolean +getMemoryEffortById(agentId string) UserMemoryEffort +getSearchFCModelById(agentId string) string +getSearchModeById(agentId string) SearchMode +getUseModelBuiltinSearchById(agentId string) boolean +getEnableHistoryCountById(agentId string) number +getHistoryCountById(agentId string) number +isEnableSearchById(agentId string) boolean } class SettingsSelectors { +memoryEnabled(state UserStoreState) boolean +currentMemorySettings(state UserStoreState) UserMemorySettings } class UserMemorySettings { +effort UserMemoryEffort~optional~ } class ChatService { +sendChat(options ChatOptions) void -computeEnableUserMemories(chatConfig AgentMemoryChatConfig) boolean -computeEffectiveMemoryEffort(chatConfig AgentMemoryChatConfig, userMemorySettings UserMemorySettings) UserMemoryEffort } AgentMemoryChatConfig "1" o-- "0..1" MemoryConfig : memory MemoryConfig --> UserMemoryEffort : effort MemoryConfig --> MemoryToolPermission : toolPermission ChatService --> AgentMemoryChatConfig : uses ChatService --> SettingsSelectors : uses SettingsSelectors --> UserMemorySettings : returns ChatConfigByIdSelectors --> AgentMemoryChatConfig : selects ChatConfigByIdSelectors --> MemoryConfig : selects ChatConfigByIdSelectors --> UserMemoryEffort : derives ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce agent-level memory configuration ABS->>CS: post(renderStart()) CS-->>ABS: SentMessage progressMessage ABS->>AAS: execAgent(agentId, appContext, botContext, prompt, stream=false, stepCallbacks) AAS->>ARS: createOperation(..., stepCallbacks, stream=false, ...) loop For each step ARS-->>ARS: Execute step ARS-->>ABS: callbacks.onAfterStep(StepPresentationData) ABS->>CS: progressMessage.edit(renderStepProgress(...)) end ARS-->>AAS: onComplete(finalState,reason) AAS-->>ABS: onComplete callback alt success ABS-->>ABS: Extract final assistant content ABS->>CS: progressMessage.edit(renderFinalReply(...)) else error ABS->>CS: progressMessage.edit(renderError(...)) end ABS->>CS: removeReaction eyes CS-->>D: Send updated message(s) D-->>DU: Deliver bot reply and progress edits ``` #### ER diagram for new configurable streaming behavior for bot integrations. |
  • Extend AgentRuntimeService step completion path to derive content, reasoning, tool calls/results, and per-step usage metrics from stepResult/nextContext.
  • Introduce StepPresentationData and broaden StepLifecycleCallbacks.onAfterStep to receive detailed per-step and cumulative token/cost stats, step type, and tool metadata.
  • Add optional stream flag to OperationCreationParams/InternalExecAgentParams and thread it into runtime executors and AiAgentService so LLM calls can be toggled between streaming and non-streaming modes.

## Reviewer's Guide This PR translates all non-English (Chinese) comments in the MCP feature module to clear English while preserving code behavior and overall comment structure, touching JSDoc blocks, inline comments, and UI-mode annotations across score calculation, score display, install flow, and settings components. ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Standardized English documentation and inline comments around score calculation and grading logic. |
  • Translated interface descriptions for score-related types (ScoreListItem, ScoreDataInput, ScoreFlags, ScoreCalculationInput) into English.
  • Updated comments explaining DEFAULT_WEIGHTS semantics, especially required fields and weight importance.
  • Rewrote JSDoc for calculateScoreFlags, getGradeColor, getGradeStyleClass, sortItemsByPriority, calculateScore, and createScoreItems to English while matching the original meaning.
  • Adjusted inline comments in calculateScore to describe required-item handling and grade thresholds in English.
  • Clarified list-page usage comments for installationMethods and isClaimed fields.
| `src/features/MCP/calculateScore.ts` | | Aligned score display component comments with the new English terminology and clarified data-shaping logic. |
  • Renamed comments describing list-page support and raw data properties to English in ScoresProps.
  • Translated guidance comments around how calculateScoreFlags is invoked, including handling of deploymentOptions mapping and default values for connection and url.
  • Updated inline comment that indicates where score calculation occurs in the Scores component.
| `src/features/MCP/Scores.tsx` | | Updated settings UI comments to English for connection modes and environment configuration sections. |
  • Translated comments describing retrieval of installed plugin information.
  • Renamed preview/edit mode comments in the connection section to English.
  • Updated JSX block comments for environment-variable configuration (stdio only) and HTTP-type notices.
| `src/features/MCP/MCPSettings/index.tsx` | | Refined comments for the score list hook to explain behavior in English. |
  • Expanded the hook’s header comment to describe DetailContext usage and return value in English.
