Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Ensures newly created, uploaded, or duplicated pages are immediately reflected and selectable in the page explorer by refreshing the documents list, broadening which pages appear in the list, and making the internal reducer more resilient when replacing temp pages with real ones. #### Sequence diagram for page creation and duplication sidebar refresh ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant PageExplorerPlaceholder participant PageEditorHeaderMenu participant FileStore participant PageStore participant CrudActionImpl participant DocumentsReducer participant SidebarPageList %% Flow A: Upload or create page from PageExplorerPlaceholder User->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: Upload file or create blank page PageExplorerPlaceholder->>FileStore: uploadAndParseFile FileStore-->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: parsedDocument PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: replaceTempPageWithReal(tempPageId, realPage) PageStore->>DocumentsReducer: internal_dispatchDocuments addDocument DocumentsReducer-->>PageStore: updatedDocuments PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: fetchDocuments PageStore-->>SidebarPageList: refreshedDocuments PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: setSelectedPageId(parsedDocument.id) %% Flow B: Duplicate page from editor header menu User->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: Click duplicate page PageEditorHeaderMenu->>FileStore: duplicateDocument(documentId) FileStore-->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: duplicatedDocument PageEditorHeaderMenu->>PageStore: fetchDocuments PageStore-->>SidebarPageList: refreshedDocuments SidebarPageList-->>User: New duplicated page visible and selectable ``` #### Flow diagram for allowed page visibility in page list ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Incoming page] --> B{Is sourceType in ALLOWED_PAGE_SOURCE_TYPES} B -->|No| Z[Page hidden from page list] B -->|Yes| C{Does page have fileType} C -->|No fileType| Y[Page shown in page list] C -->|Has fileType| D{Is fileType in ALLOWED_PAGE_FILE_TYPES} D -->|No| Z D -->|Yes| Y subgraph ALLOWED_PAGE_SOURCE_TYPES E[editor] F[file] G[api] end subgraph ALLOWED_PAGE_FILE_TYPES H[custom/document] I[application/pdf] J[markdown] K[article] L[note] M[report] end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Adjust page placeholder behavior after file upload/parse so the sidebar list re-syncs from the server and the correct page is selected without manually rewriting the URL. |
  • After successful upload/parse, refresh the documents list via fetchDocuments instead of manually setting selected ID and manipulating history state.
  • Update selected page ID using the full parsed document ID after the list refresh.
  • Remove identifier standardization and URL rewriting logic from the placeholder component, delegating navigation/selection to store-driven behavior.
| `src/features/PageExplorer/PageExplorerPlaceholder.tsx` | | Expand which plugin- or file-generated pages are eligible to show in the page list. |
  • Extend allowed page file MIME/type list beyond custom/document and application/pdf to include markdown, article, note, and report types.
  • Keep the allowed page source types unchanged while relaxing the file type filter to support more page creation flows.
| `src/store/page/slices/list/action.ts` | | Ensure new editor-created pages are immediately reflected in the global page list by refreshing documents after creation. |
  • Normalize title property shorthand when constructing the new editor page object.
  • Dispatch the addDocument internal action, then trigger a full documents refresh so global list state is up-to-date before returning the new page.
| `src/store/page/slices/crud/action.ts` | | Refresh the page list after duplicating a document so the duplicate appears correctly in the sidebar. |
  • Read fetchDocuments from the page store in the page editor header menu hook.
  • After a successful duplicateDocument call, invoke fetchDocuments before completing the action and leaving success messaging as-is.
| `src/features/PageEditor/Header/useMenu.tsx` | | Make the internal documents reducer robust when replacing temp documents by inserting the real document if the temp one is not found. |
  • When handling replaceDocumentId, still replace the document in-place if the old ID exists.
  • If the old ID is not found (e.g., list was refreshed and temp removed), prepend the new document to the document list as a fallback so it is still visible.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide This PR adjusts how SPA HTML templates are loaded to better support dev start scripts, updates the @lobehub/icons dependency, and tweaks the Vite dev server configuration to be accessible on all network interfaces. #### Sequence diagram for SPA HTML template loading with dynamic import ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Browser participant RouteHandler participant getTemplate participant spaHtmlTemplates Browser->>RouteHandler: Request SPA page RouteHandler->>getTemplate: getTemplate(isMobile) activate getTemplate alt Using Vite dev server getTemplate-->>RouteHandler: HTML from Vite with rewritten asset URLs else Using prebuilt templates getTemplate->>spaHtmlTemplates: dynamic import('./spaHtmlTemplates') spaHtmlTemplates-->>getTemplate: desktopHtmlTemplate, mobileHtmlTemplate getTemplate-->>RouteHandler: isMobile ? mobileHtmlTemplate : desktopHtmlTemplate end deactivate getTemplate RouteHandler-->>Browser: Return SPA HTML response ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Switch SPA HTML template import to a dynamic import inside the request handler to avoid static import issues in the dev environment. |
  • Remove top-level static import of desktop and mobile HTML templates in the SPA route handler.
  • Introduce an async dynamic import of the SPA HTML templates within getTemplate so they are only loaded when needed.
  • Keep the mobile vs desktop template selection logic unchanged aside from the new import style.
| `src/app/spa/[variants]/[[...path]]/route.ts` | | Align dependencies and dev server settings to fix and improve local dev startup. |
  • Bump @lobehub/icons to version ^4.9.0, likely to resolve compatibility or build warnings during dev.
  • Add host: true to Vite server configuration so the dev server binds to all interfaces, improving accessibility for dev start scripts and external devices.

You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. ## Reviewer's Guide Ensures pages created or duplicated from various sources immediately appear and are correctly selected in the Page Explorer, broadening which page types are listed and tightening synchronization between CRUD actions, the sidebar list, and selection state. #### Sequence diagram for file-based page creation and sidebar synchronization ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant PageExplorerPlaceholder participant PageStore participant DocumentsReducer User->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: uploadAndParseFile() PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: addTempPage(tempPage) PageStore->>DocumentsReducer: internal_dispatchDocuments(addDocument tempPage) DocumentsReducer-->>PageStore: tempPage added PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: replaceTempPageWithReal(tempPageId, realPage) PageStore->>DocumentsReducer: internal_dispatchDocuments(replaceTempPageWithReal) DocumentsReducer-->>PageStore: tempPage replaced or realPage inserted PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: setSelectedPageId(parsedDocumentId) PageStore-->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: selection updated PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: fetchDocuments() alt fetchDocuments succeeds PageStore-->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: updatedDocumentList else fetchDocuments fails PageStore-->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: error PageExplorerPlaceholder-->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: console.warn("Failed to fetch documents after upload") end ``` #### Sequence diagram for page duplication and list refresh ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant PageEditorHeaderMenu participant FileStore participant PageStore User->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: duplicateCurrentPage() PageEditorHeaderMenu->>FileStore: duplicateDocument(pageId) alt duplication succeeds FileStore-->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: duplicatedDocument PageEditorHeaderMenu->>PageStore: fetchDocuments() alt fetchDocuments succeeds PageStore-->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: updatedDocumentList else fetchDocuments fails PageStore-->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: error PageEditorHeaderMenu-->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: console.warn("Failed to refresh page list after duplication") end else duplication fails FileStore-->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: error PageEditorHeaderMenu-->>PageEditorHeaderMenu: console.error("Failed to duplicate page") end ``` #### Sequence diagram for duplicatePage CRUD action and background refresh ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant CrudActionImpl participant PageStore participant DocumentsReducer CrudActionImpl->>CrudActionImpl: duplicatePage(originalPage) CrudActionImpl->>CrudActionImpl: buildEditorPageMetadata(title, timestamps) CrudActionImpl->>PageStore: internal_dispatchDocuments(addDocument editorPage) PageStore->>DocumentsReducer: documentsReducer(addDocument) DocumentsReducer-->>PageStore: editorPage added CrudActionImpl->>PageStore: refreshDocuments() alt refreshDocuments succeeds PageStore-->>CrudActionImpl: ok else refreshDocuments fails PageStore-->>CrudActionImpl: error CrudActionImpl-->>CrudActionImpl: console.warn("[duplicatePage] Failed to refresh documents") end CrudActionImpl-->>Caller: newPage ``` #### Class diagram for updated page store actions and document filtering ```mermaid classDiagram class PageStore { +fetchDocuments() Promise~void~ +refreshDocuments() Promise~void~ +setSelectedPageId(pageId string) +internal_dispatchDocuments(payload DocumentsPayload) } class CrudActionImpl { -getFn() PageStore +createBlankPage(title string) Promise~Page~ +duplicatePage(originalPage Page) Promise~Page~ } class DocumentsReducer { +documentsReducer(state PageList, payload DocumentsPayload) PageList +handleReplaceTempPageWithReal(draft PageList, oldId string, document Page) } class PageListAction { -ALLOWED_PAGE_SOURCE_TYPES Set~string~ -ALLOWED_PAGE_FILE_TYPES Set~string~ +shouldDisplayInPageList(source string, sourceType string, fileType string) boolean } class Page { +id string +title string +metadata any +source string +sourceType DocumentSourceType +totalCharCount number +totalLineCount number +updatedAt string } class DocumentSourceType { <> EDITOR FILE API } CrudActionImpl ..> PageStore : uses PageStore ..> DocumentsReducer : dispatchesTo DocumentSourceType <.. Page DocumentsReducer o-- Page : manages PageListAction ..> Page : filters PageListAction : ALLOWED_PAGE_FILE_TYPES = { PageListAction : custom/document, PageListAction : application/pdf, PageListAction : markdown, PageListAction : article, PageListAction : note, PageListAction : report PageListAction : } DocumentsReducer : handleReplaceTempPageWithReal DocumentsReducer : - findIndex(doc.id == oldId) DocumentsReducer : - if not found, findIndex(doc.id == document.id) DocumentsReducer : - if still not found, unshift(document) ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Ensure parsed/uploaded pages appear in the explorer and are selected via store updates and a post-upload list refresh. |

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Fixes several resource/document handling bugs: batch deletion now correctly distinguishes between document and file resources even when resourceMap misses entries, document-based cascaded file deletion is restricted to API-imported documents, editor-generated documents are tagged with a distinct sourceType, and knowledge queries filter document joins by source_type to avoid duplicate file rows and unintended original file deletions. #### Sequence diagram for resource batch deletion and guarded file cascading ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant UI as ResourceUI participant Store as ResourceActionImpl participant API as ResourceAPI participant DocSvc as DocumentService participant FileModel User->>UI: Select resources and click delete UI->>Store: deleteResources(ids) Store->>Store: Get state {resourceMap, resourceList, fileList} loop For each id Store->>Store: resource = resourceMap.get(id) Store->>Store: if not resource then find in fileList by id alt resource.sourceType == document Store->>API: DELETE /documents/{id} API->>DocSvc: deleteDocument(documentId) DocSvc->>DocSvc: Load document alt document.fileId exists and document.sourceType == api DocSvc->>FileModel: delete(fileId) else document.sourceType != api DocSvc-->>FileModel: Skip file deletion end else resource is file or other Store->>API: DELETE /files/{id} end end ``` #### Entity relationship diagram for files, documents, and knowledge base joins ```mermaid erDiagram files { uuid id uuid user_id uuid parent_id string url } documents { uuid id uuid file_id string source_type } knowledge_base_files { uuid id uuid knowledge_base_id uuid file_id } files ||--o{ documents : file_documents files ||--o{ knowledge_base_files : knowledge_links %% In queries, documents are joined with condition d.source_type = file to avoid duplicates %% and to only treat raw uploaded files as file-backed documents ``` #### Class diagram for DocumentService, ResourceActionImpl, and KnowledgeRepo changes ```mermaid classDiagram class DocumentService { - FileModel fileModel - DocumentModel documentModel deleteDocument(documentId: string): Promise~void~ parseDocument(file: File, fileDocument: Document, title: string): Promise~Document~ } class FileModel { delete(fileId: string): Promise~void~ } class DocumentModel { findById(documentId: string): Promise~Document~ } class Document { string id string fileId string sourceType string metadata string parentId string source string title number totalCharCount number totalLineCount } class ResourceActionImpl { - Map~string, Resource~ resourceMap - Resource[] resourceList - Resource[] fileList deleteResources(ids: string[]): Promise~void~ } class Resource { string id string sourceType } class KnowledgeRepo { - string userId listUserFiles(): Promise~File[]~ listKnowledgeBaseFiles(knowledgeBaseId: string): Promise~File[]~ searchFiles(): Promise~File[]~ } class File { string id string userId string parentId string url } %% Relations reflecting logic changes DocumentService --> FileModel : deletes_file_when_sourceType_api DocumentService --> DocumentModel : loads_document_for_deletion DocumentService --> Document : creates_editor_sourceType ResourceActionImpl --> Resource : uses_sourceType_for_batch_deletion KnowledgeRepo --> File : queries_files_with_document_source_type_filter KnowledgeRepo --> Document : joins_on_file_id_and_source_type_file ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Ensure document-to-file JOINs only consider file-origin documents to prevent duplicate rows and incorrect file associations. |

## Reviewer's Guide Scopes agent evaluation benchmarks and bot provider records by user, introduces per-agent external bot provider configuration with encrypted credentials, and wires user-aware access control into benchmark CRUD while extending agent types and schema for agency configuration. #### Sequence diagram for webhook handling using agent bot providers ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Platform as ExternalPlatform participant WebhookAPI as WebhookAPI participant DB as LobeChatDatabase participant Model as AgentBotProviderModel participant Agent as AgentHandler Platform->>WebhookAPI: POST webhook(platform, applicationId, payload) WebhookAPI->>DB: createAgentBotProviderModel(userId) DB-->>WebhookAPI: AgentBotProviderModel instance WebhookAPI->>Model: findEnabledByApplicationId(platform, applicationId) Model->>DB: select from agent_bot_providers DB-->>Model: AgentBotProviderItem Model->>Model: decryptRow(row) Model-->>WebhookAPI: DecryptedBotProvider WebhookAPI->>Agent: dispatchMessage(agentId, payload, credentials) Agent-->>WebhookAPI: response WebhookAPI-->>Platform: 200 OK ``` #### ER diagram for updated agent eval benchmarks and new agent bot providers schema ```mermaid erDiagram users { text id PK } agents { text id PK jsonb agency_config } agent_eval_benchmarks { uuid id PK text identifier text user_id FK boolean is_system jsonb metadata } agent_bot_providers { uuid id PK text agent_id FK text user_id FK varchar platform varchar application_id text credentials boolean enabled timestamptz accessed_at timestamptz created_at timestamptz updated_at } users ||--o{ agents : owns users ||--o{ agent_eval_benchmarks : scoped_by users ||--o{ agent_bot_providers : scoped_by agents ||--o{ agent_eval_benchmarks : evaluated_by agents ||--o{ agent_bot_providers : bound_to agent_eval_benchmarks { unique identifier_user_id index user_id_idx } agent_bot_providers { unique platform_application_id index platform_idx index agent_id_idx index user_id_idx } ``` #### Class diagram for AgentEvalBenchmarkModel user scoping and AgentBotProviderModel ```mermaid classDiagram class AgentEvalBenchmarkModel { - string userId - LobeChatDatabase db + AgentEvalBenchmarkModel(db LobeChatDatabase, userId string) + create(params NewAgentEvalBenchmark) Promise~AgentEvalBenchmarkItem~ + delete(id string) Promise~unknown~ + query(includeSystem boolean) Promise~AgentEvalBenchmarkItem[]~ + findById(id string) Promise~AgentEvalBenchmarkItem \| null~ + findByIdentifier(identifier string) Promise~AgentEvalBenchmarkItem \| null~ + update(id string, value Partial_AgentEvalBenchmarkItem_) Promise~AgentEvalBenchmarkItem \| null~ } class AgentBotProviderModel { - string userId - LobeChatDatabase db - GateKeeper gateKeeper + AgentBotProviderModel(db LobeChatDatabase, userId string, gateKeeper GateKeeper) + create(params NewAgentBotProviderParams) Promise~AgentBotProviderItem~ + delete(id string) Promise~unknown~ + query(params QueryParams) Promise~DecryptedBotProvider[]~ + findById(id string) Promise~DecryptedBotProvider \| null~ + findByAgentId(agentId string) Promise~DecryptedBotProvider[]~ + update(id string, value UpdateParams) Promise~unknown~ + findEnabledByApplicationId(platform string, applicationId string) Promise~DecryptedBotProvider \| null~ + static findByPlatformAndAppId(db LobeChatDatabase, platform string, applicationId string) Promise~AgentBotProviderItem \| null~ + static findEnabledByPlatform(db LobeChatDatabase, platform string, gateKeeper GateKeeper) Promise~DecryptedBotProvider[]~ - encrypt(credentials Record_string_string_) Promise~string~ - decryptRow(row AgentBotProviderItem) Promise~DecryptedBotProvider~ } class GateKeeper { + decrypt(ciphertext string) Promise~DecryptResult~ + encrypt(plaintext string) Promise~string~ } class DecryptedBotProvider { + string id + string agentId + string userId + string platform + string applicationId + Record_string_string_ credentials + boolean enabled + Date accessedAt + Date createdAt + Date updatedAt } class AgentBotProviderItem { + string id + string agentId + string userId + string platform + string applicationId + string credentials + boolean enabled + Date accessedAt + Date createdAt + Date updatedAt } class NewAgentBotProviderParams { + string agentId + string platform + string applicationId + Record_string_string_ credentials } class QueryParams { + string agentId + string platform } class UpdateParams { + string agentId + string platform + string applicationId + Record_string_string_ credentials + boolean enabled } class DecryptResult { + string plaintext } AgentBotProviderModel o--> GateKeeper AgentBotProviderModel --> AgentBotProviderItem AgentBotProviderModel --> DecryptedBotProvider AgentBotProviderModel --> NewAgentBotProviderParams AgentBotProviderModel --> QueryParams AgentBotProviderModel --> UpdateParams AgentEvalBenchmarkModel --> LobeChatDatabase AgentBotProviderModel --> LobeChatDatabase ``` #### Class diagram for new agent agency configuration types ```mermaid classDiagram class LobeAgentAgencyConfig { + DiscordBotConfig discord + SlackBotConfig slack } class DiscordBotConfig { + string applicationId + string botToken + boolean enabled + string publicKey } class SlackBotConfig { + string botToken + boolean enabled + string signingSecret } class LobeAgentConfig { + LobeAgentAgencyConfig agencyConfig + string avatar + string backgroundColor } class AgentItem { + LobeAgentAgencyConfig agencyConfig + string avatar + string backgroundColor } LobeAgentAgencyConfig --> DiscordBotConfig LobeAgentAgencyConfig --> SlackBotConfig LobeAgentConfig --> LobeAgentAgencyConfig AgentItem --> LobeAgentAgencyConfig ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Scope agent eval benchmark CRUD operations by user and support shared system benchmarks via schema and model changes. |

## Reviewer's Guide Adds several new NVIDIA NIM chat models (MiniMax, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen) to the model bank and refines how “thinking/reasoning” parameters are mapped to provider-specific flags, including special handling for GLM preserved thinking and Qwen’s enable_thinking + thinking_budget, with tests updated accordingly. #### Sequence diagram for NVIDIA chat request with model-specific thinking flags ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ClientApp participant LobeNvidiaAI participant NvidiaParams as NvidiaParamsBuilder participant NIM as NvidiaNIMAPI User ->> ClientApp: Configure model and thinking options ClientApp ->> LobeNvidiaAI: createChatCompletion(model, messages, thinking) LobeNvidiaAI ->> NvidiaParams: buildChatParams(model, messages, thinking) alt GLM preserved thinking model NvidiaParams ->> NvidiaParams: detect model in supportPreservedThinkingModels NvidiaParams ->> NvidiaParams: compute thinkingFlag from thinking.type NvidiaParams ->> LobeNvidiaAI: params with enable_thinking, clear_thinking=false else Qwen enable_thinking + thinking_budget model NvidiaParams ->> NvidiaParams: detect model in enableThinkingModels NvidiaParams ->> NvidiaParams: compute thinkingFlag and thinkingBudget NvidiaParams ->> LobeNvidiaAI: params with enable_thinking and thinking_budget else Other NVIDIA models NvidiaParams ->> NvidiaParams: compute thinkingFlag NvidiaParams ->> LobeNvidiaAI: params with thinking flag end LobeNvidiaAI ->> NIM: POST /chat/completions with model-specific thinking params NIM -->> LobeNvidiaAI: Chat completion response LobeNvidiaAI -->> ClientApp: Normalized chat response ClientApp -->> User: Display model output ``` #### Class diagram for NVIDIA provider thinking configuration ```mermaid classDiagram class NvidiaModelCard { +string id } class ThinkingConfig { +string type +int budget_tokens } class NvidiaParamsBuilder { -Set~string~ supportPreservedThinkingModels -Set~string~ enableThinkingModels +buildChatParams(modelId string, messages any[], thinking ThinkingConfig) Record~string, any~ -getThinkingFlag(thinking ThinkingConfig) bool -getThinkingBudget(thinking ThinkingConfig) int } class ChatTemplateKwargs { +bool enable_thinking +bool clear_thinking +bool thinking +int thinking_budget } NvidiaParamsBuilder --> NvidiaModelCard : uses model id NvidiaParamsBuilder --> ThinkingConfig : reads thinking NvidiaParamsBuilder --> ChatTemplateKwargs : populates ``` #### Flow diagram for NVIDIA thinking parameter mapping logic ```mermaid flowchart TD ## Reviewer's Guide Adds support for auto aspect ratio for Nano Banana image models and integrates Google image search results into grounding metadata and search tools, updating Google/Vertex streaming transforms, search tooling, and tests accordingly. #### Sequence diagram for GoogleGenerativeAIStream grounding with image search ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant GoogleAPIStream participant GoogleGenerativeAIStream participant transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream participant SSEClient GoogleAPIStream->>GoogleGenerativeAIStream: ReadableStream loop for each chunk GoogleGenerativeAIStream->>transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream: candidate.groundingMetadata activate transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream->>transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream: Extract groundingChunks, webSearchQueries, imageSearchQueries transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream->>transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream: Split webChunks = filter(web) transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream->>transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream: Split imageChunks = filter(image) alt has webChunks transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream->>SSEClient: event grounding Note over transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream,SSEClient: data.citations = map(webChunks) end alt has imageChunks transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream->>SSEClient: event grounding Note over transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream,SSEClient: data.imageResults = map(imageChunks) end alt has imageSearchQueries transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream->>SSEClient: event grounding Note over transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream,SSEClient: data.imageSearchQueries end transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream-->>GoogleGenerativeAIStream: text + grounding events deactivate transformGoogleGenerativeAIStream end GoogleGenerativeAIStream-->>SSEClient: usage + stop events ``` #### Sequence diagram for VertexAIStream grounding with image search ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant VertexAPIStream participant VertexAIStream participant transformVertexAIStream participant SSEClient VertexAPIStream->>VertexAIStream: ReadableStream loop for each chunk VertexAIStream->>transformVertexAIStream: candidate.groundingMetadata activate transformVertexAIStream transformVertexAIStream->>transformVertexAIStream: Extract groundingChunks, webSearchQueries, imageSearchQueries transformVertexAIStream->>transformVertexAIStream: Split webChunks = filter(web) transformVertexAIStream->>transformVertexAIStream: Split imageChunks = filter(image) alt has webChunks transformVertexAIStream->>SSEClient: event grounding with citations end alt has imageChunks transformVertexAIStream->>SSEClient: event grounding with imageResults end alt has imageSearchQueries transformVertexAIStream->>SSEClient: event grounding with imageSearchQueries end transformVertexAIStream-->>VertexAIStream: text + grounding events deactivate transformVertexAIStream end VertexAIStream-->>SSEClient: usage + stop events ``` #### Class diagram for updated GroundingSearch and image citation types ```mermaid classDiagram class CitationItem { +string favicon +string title +string url } class ImageCitationItem { +string domain +string imageUri +string sourceUri +string title } class GroundingSearch { +CitationItem[] citations +ImageCitationItem[] imageResults +string[] imageSearchQueries +string[] searchQueries } class GoogleGenerativeAIStream { +ReadableStream rawStream +GoogleGenerativeAIStream(rawStream) } class VertexAIStream { +ReadableStream rawStream +VertexAIStream(rawStream) } class LobeGoogleAI { +Set modelsWithModalities +Set modelsWithImageSearch +chat(payload) +buildGoogleToolsWithSearch(tools) } GroundingSearch "0..*" --> CitationItem : uses GroundingSearch "0..*" --> ImageCitationItem : uses GoogleGenerativeAIStream --> GroundingSearch : emits_grounding_events VertexAIStream --> GroundingSearch : emits_grounding_events LobeGoogleAI --> GroundingSearch : parses_grounding_metadata ``` #### Flow diagram for building Google search tools with optional image search ```mermaid flowchart TD A_start[Start buildGoogleToolsWithSearch] --> B_hasSearch{hasSearch?} B_hasSearch -- No --> Z_returnTools[Return function/urlContext tools only] B_hasSearch -- Yes --> C_hasUrlContext{hasUrlContext?} C_hasUrlContext -- Yes --> D_modelSupportsImageSearch{model in modelsWithImageSearch?} C_hasUrlContext -- No --> G_modelSupportsImageSearch2{model in modelsWithImageSearch?} D_modelSupportsImageSearch -- Yes --> E_toolsUrlAndImageSearch["tools = [{ urlContext: {} }, { googleSearch: { searchTypes: { imageSearch: {}, webSearch: {} } } }]"] D_modelSupportsImageSearch -- No --> F_toolsUrlAndWebSearch["tools = [{ urlContext: {} }, { googleSearch: {} }]"] G_modelSupportsImageSearch2 -- Yes --> H_toolsImageSearchOnly["tools = [{ googleSearch: { searchTypes: { imageSearch: {}, webSearch: {} } } }]"] G_modelSupportsImageSearch2 -- No --> I_toolsWebSearchOnly["tools = [{ googleSearch: {} }]"] E_toolsUrlAndImageSearch --> J_done[Return tools] F_toolsUrlAndWebSearch --> J_done H_toolsImageSearchOnly --> J_done I_toolsWebSearchOnly --> J_done Z_returnTools --> J_done ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Emit structured image search results from Google and Vertex streams in grounding events, alongside existing web citations. |
  • Extend GroundingSearch and its Zod schema to support imageResults and imageSearchQueries fields.
  • Update GoogleGenerativeAIStream and VertexAIStream transforms to split groundingChunks into web and image chunks, building citations only from web chunks and imageResults only from image chunks.
  • Include imageSearchQueries when present, omit citations/imageResults/imageSearchQueries when corresponding data is absent, and keep searchQueries mapped from webSearchQueries.
  • Add tests for GoogleGenerativeAIStream and VertexAIStream to verify grounding payloads for mixed web+image results and image-only results and to ensure usage events remain unchanged.

Redis provider tests. #### Sequence diagram for Redis pipeline chaining and execution ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor App participant Provider as IoRedisRedisProvider participant Client as IoRedisClient participant Pipe as RedisPipeline participant Server as RedisServer App->>Provider: pipeline() Provider->>Provider: ensureClient() Provider->>Client: pipeline() Client-->>Provider: Pipe App->>Pipe: expire(key2, 200) Pipe-->>Pipe: buffer EXPIRE key2 200 App->>Pipe: exec() Pipe->>Client: send buffered commands Client->>Server: INCR key1, EXPIRE key1 100, INCR key2, EXPIRE key2 200 (single round trip) Server-->>Client: results array Client-->>Pipe: results array Pipe-->>App: Promise resolves with results array ``` #### Class diagram for RedisPipeline and   • Add RedisPipeline interface describing chainable Redis commands that buffer operations and execute via exec()
  • Extend RedisClient interface to include a pipeline() method returning RedisPipeline
  • Update IoRedisRedisProvider to implement pipeline() by delegating to the underlying ioredis client pipeline() and casting to RedisPipeline

## Reviewer's Guide Refactors the Next.js build/config setup to remove custom webpack hooks, centralize Vercel/Docker tracing rules, and simplify the Docker image by dropping desktop export handling, plus a minor fix to video temp file path handling. #### Flow diagram for environment-specific Next.js config composition ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Start next.config.ts"] --> B["Read VERCEL_ENV"] B --> C{isVercel?} C -->|true| D["Create vercelConfig outputFileTracingExcludes['*'] set outputFileTracingIncludes['/api/webhooks/video/*'] set"] C -->|false| E["Use empty base config"] D --> F["Call defineConfig(vercelConfig)"] E --> F["Call defineConfig({})"] subgraph defineConfig["defineConfig function"] F --> G["Compute isProd, buildWithDocker, isTest"] G --> H["Build standaloneConfig output: standalone outputFileTracingIncludes['*'] contains public/**/* .next/static/**/* public/spa/** dist/desktop/** dist/mobile/** packages/database/migrations/** native bindings"] H --> I["Merge user config into base NextConfig"] end I --> J["Export nextConfig"] J --> K["Next.js build uses merged config"] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Remove custom webpack configuration from the shared Next config helper and drop React Scan integration. |
  • Delete webpack-related typings and the optional webpack hook from the custom config interface.
  • Remove import and usage of the ReactComponentName plugin driven by REACT_SCAN_MONITOR_API_KEY.
  • Drop all custom webpack() logic (experiments, shikiji rule, canvas alias, epub2 fallback, worker asset rule, and user-provided config chaining) from the shared config.
| `src/libs/next/config/define-config.ts` | | Restrict Vercel-specific output tracing rules to Vercel deployments and simplify next.config.ts. |
  • Extract Vercel-only outputFileTracingExcludes/outputFileTracingIncludes into a vercelConfig object.
  • Always define the tracing rules inside vercelConfig (no env-guard inside the object itself).
  • Pass vercelConfig into defineConfig only when VERCEL_ENV is present, avoiding Vercel-specific config on non-Vercel builds.
  • Remove the webpack cache-disabling override from next.config.ts.
| `next.config.ts` | | Simplify Docker build by removing desktop/Electron export handling and explicitly copying static Next.js assets. |
  • Remove the step that copies Next export output into apps/desktop/dist/next during the build stage.
  • Remove copying of the desktop Next export directory into the final image.
  • Add an explicit COPY of .next/static from the builder stage into the runtime image.
  • Keep SPA assets and DB migration copies intact.
| `Dockerfile` | | Harden video generation file I/O by ensuring fs.readFile is given string paths for temp files. |
  • Wrap tempVideoPath in String() when passed to fs.readFile for the main video buffer read.
  • Wrap tempCoverPath in String() when passed to fs.readFile for the cover image read.
| `src/server/services/generation/video.ts` | ---

## Reviewer's Guide Ensures pages created or duplicated through the editor, file parsing, or server-side imports are immediately visible and correctly synced in the Page Explorer, with more robust list updates and broader support for page types. #### Sequence diagram for file upload page creation and explorer sync ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant PageExplorerPlaceholder participant PageStore participant DocumentService participant ServerDB User->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: Select file and confirm upload PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: addTempPage(tempPage) PageExplorerPlaceholder->>DocumentService: uploadAndParseFile(file) DocumentService->>ServerDB: createDocumentFromFile ServerDB-->>DocumentService: persistedDocument DocumentService-->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: parsedDocument PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: replaceTempPageWithReal(tempPageId, realPage) PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: setSelectedPageId(parsedDocument.id) PageExplorerPlaceholder->>PageStore: fetchDocuments() PageStore->>DocumentService: getDocumentsList() DocumentService-->>PageStore: documents[] PageStore->>PageStore: internal_dispatchDocuments(addDocument or updateDocument) PageStore-->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: updated documents list User->>PageExplorerPlaceholder: View sidebar PageExplorerPlaceholder-->>User: Newly created page visible and selected ``` #### Sequence diagram for duplicating a page and refreshing the page list ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant PageEditorHeader participant FileStore participant PageStore participant CrudActionImpl participant DocumentService User->>PageEditorHeader: Click duplicate page PageEditorHeader->>FileStore: duplicateDocument(currentPageId) FileStore->>CrudActionImpl: duplicatePage(pageId) CrudActionImpl->>DocumentService: createDocumentFromExisting(pageId) DocumentService-->>CrudActionImpl: newPage CrudActionImpl->>PageStore: internal_dispatchDocuments(addDocument with editorPage) CrudActionImpl->>PageStore: refreshDocuments() (fire and forget) PageStore->>DocumentService: getDocumentsList() DocumentService-->>PageStore: documents[] PageStore->>PageStore: internal_dispatchDocuments(addDocument or updateDocument per item) FileStore-->>PageEditorHeader: duplicateDocument resolved PageEditorHeader->>PageStore: fetchDocuments() PageStore->>DocumentService: getDocumentsList() DocumentService-->>PageStore: documents[] PageStore-->>PageEditorHeader: updated list PageEditorHeader-->>User: Sidebar list shows duplicated page ``` #### Class diagram for updated page CRUD and document list handling ```mermaid classDiagram class CrudActionImpl { +duplicatePage(pageId) +createPageFromFile(fileId) +createPageFromEditor(initialData) -get() } class PageStore { +internal_dispatchDocuments(payload) +refreshDocuments() +fetchDocuments() +setSelectedPageId(pageId) +updatePageOptimistically(page) +useFetchPageDetail(pageId) } class DocumentsReducer { +handleReplaceTempDocument(oldId, document) +handleAddDocument(document) +handleUpdateOrInsertDocument(document) } class PageExplorerPlaceholder { +handleUploadFile(file) +handleParsedDocument(parsedDocument, tempPageId) } class PageExplorer { +renderWithPage(pageId) } class DocumentService { +createDocumentFromFile(fileId) +createDocumentFromExisting(pageId) +getDocumentsList() } CrudActionImpl --> PageStore : uses CrudActionImpl --> DocumentService : calls PageStore --> DocumentsReducer : uses PageExplorerPlaceholder --> PageStore : updates PageExplorer --> PageStore : reads and fetches detail DocumentService --> PageStore : returns documents class DocumentListFilter { +ALLOWED_PAGE_SOURCE_TYPES +ALLOWED_PAGE_FILE_TYPES +shouldDisplayInPageList(document) } class Document { +id +title +source +sourceType +fileType +metadata +totalCharCount +totalLineCount } DocumentListFilter --> Document : evaluates PageStore --> Document : stores DocumentService --> Document : creates and returns ``` #### Flow diagram for document visibility in Page Explorer ```mermaid flowchart TD A[New document created via editor, file upload, or agent skill] --> B[Set sourceType and fileType] B --> C{sourceType in ALLOWED_PAGE_SOURCE_TYPES: editor, file, api} C -->|No| H[Excluded from Page Explorer] C -->|Yes| D{fileType in ALLOWED_PAGE_FILE_TYPES: custom/document, application/pdf, markdown, article, note, report} D -->|No| H D -->|Yes| E[Passes filter shouldDisplayInPageList] E --> F[PageStore.internal_dispatchDocuments addDocument or updateDocument] F --> G[PageExplorer selector reads filtered documents] G --> I[Sidebar shows page immediately after creation or duplication] subgraph SourceTypeNormalization J[Server DocumentService createDocumentFromFile] J --> K[Set document.sourceType = api] K --> B end subgraph ListRefreshPaths L[CrudActionImpl.duplicatePage] L --> M[PageStore.refreshDocuments fire and forget] M --> F N[PageEditorHeader.useMenu after duplicate] N --> O[PageStore.fetchDocuments] O --> F P[PageExplorerPlaceholder after file parse] P --> Q[PageStore.fetchDocuments] Q --> F end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Ensure parsed/uploaded documents appear immediately in the sidebar and rely on list refetch instead of manual URL manipulation. |
  • Change parsed document sourceType default from 'file' to 'api' so documents are not filtered out by the explorer selector.
  • After replacing a temporary page with the real one, set the selected page ID and then re-fetch the document list, logging a warning on failure.
  • Remove client-side URL rewriting logic that attempted to standardize and strip document IDs from the path.
| `src/features/PageExplorer/PageExplorerPlaceholder.tsx` | | Expand which page documents are considered valid for the Page Explorer list. |
  • Keep allowed page source types as 'editor', 'file', and 'api'.
  • Extend allowed file types to include markdown and several semantic types used by Agent/Skill-generated content so they appear in the explorer.
| `src/store/page/slices/list/action.ts` | | Refresh the page list and handle missing entries when duplicating or updating documents so the explorer stays in sync. |
  • After duplicating a page in CRUD actions, trigger a non-blocking refreshDocuments call with defensive logging on failure.
  • When updating documents from the API, add a fallback branch that inserts the document if the old ID is not found in the current list.
  • In the reducer, if the optimistic document cannot be replaced by oldId, try matching by the new ID, otherwise unshift the new document to the list to guarantee visibility.
| `src/store/page/slices/crud/action.ts`
`src/store/page/slices/internal/reducer.ts` | | Trigger a sidebar refresh after duplicating a page from the editor menu. |
  • Inject fetchDocuments from the page store into the page editor header menu hook.
  • After a successful duplicateDocument call, explicitly re-fetch documents and log a warning if the refresh fails; on duplication error, short-circuit further processing.
| `src/features/PageEditor/Header/useMenu.tsx` | | Align server-side document creation from files with client-side expectations so parsed documents show up in the explorer. |
  • Change server-created documents from file uploads to use sourceType 'api' instead of 'file' to match explorer filters.
  • Update the corresponding DocumentService test to assert the new sourceType value.
| `src/server/services/document/index.ts`
`src/server/services/document/__tests__/index.test.ts` | | Fetch page details independently so deeply paginated or newly created pages can be rendered correctly in the explorer. |
  • Expose useFetchPageDetail from the page store and invoke it inside the PageExplorer component whenever a pageId is provided, independent of list pagination.
  • Keep using pageSelectors.getDocumentById for the actual render while the detail hook ensures data is loaded.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adjusts batch resource deletion to fall back to fileList when a resource ID is missing from resourceMap, ensuring correct classification of file vs document IDs during bulk delete operations. #### Sequence diagram for batch resource deletion with resourceMap and fileList fallback ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ResourcePage participant ResourceStore as ResourceActionImpl participant LocalState as LocalState(resourceMap,fileList) participant Backend as BackendAPI User ->> ResourcePage: Select all resources and click delete ResourcePage ->> ResourceStore: deleteResources(ids) ResourceStore ->> LocalState: #get() LocalState -->> ResourceStore: resourceMap, resourceList, fileList ResourceStore ->> ResourceStore: build fileListMap from fileList loop For each id in ids ResourceStore ->> ResourceStore: resource = resourceMap.get(id) alt resource missing in resourceMap ResourceStore ->> ResourceStore: resource = fileListMap.get(id) end alt resource.sourceType == document ResourceStore ->> ResourceStore: documentIds.push(id) else ResourceStore ->> ResourceStore: fileIds.push(id) end end par Delete documents ResourceStore ->> Backend: deleteDocuments(documentIds) Backend -->> ResourceStore: success and Delete files ResourceStore ->> Backend: deleteFiles(fileIds) Backend -->> ResourceStore: success end ResourceStore -->> ResourcePage: deletion result ResourcePage -->> User: Resources deleted successfully ``` #### Class diagram for updated ResourceActionImpl batch deletion logic ```mermaid classDiagram class ResourceActionImpl { - resourceMap : Map~string, Resource~ - resourceList : Resource[] - fileList : FileResource[] - #get() MapState + deleteResources(ids : string[]) void } class MapState { + resourceMap : Map~string, Resource~ + resourceList : Resource[] + fileList : FileResource[] } class Resource { + id : string + sourceType : string } class FileResource { + id : string + sourceType : string } class DeleteResourcesFlow { + fileListMap : Map~string, FileResource~ + fileIds : string[] + documentIds : string[] + classifyIds(ids : string[]) void } ResourceActionImpl ..> MapState : uses ResourceActionImpl ..> DeleteResourcesFlow : uses DeleteResourcesFlow ..> Resource : classifies DeleteResourcesFlow ..> FileResource : falls_back_via_fileListMap ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Fix batch deletion classification by resolving resources from fileList when missing in resourceMap. |
  • Extend store selector to also retrieve fileList alongside resourceMap and resourceList.
  • Construct a Map from fileList keyed by ID for quick lookup during deletion processing.
  • Update the deletion loop to fall back to the fileList-backed map when resourceMap has no entry for a given ID, preserving document vs file routing.
| `src/store/file/slices/resource/action.ts` | ### Assessment against linked issues | Issue | Objective | Addressed | Explanation | | ------ | ------- | ----- | ----- | | https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/issues/12448 | Fix the batch deletion logic in the Resource section so that selecting all and deleting files actually deletes all selected resources (including those missing from resourceMap), thereby correctly freeing up file quota. | ✅ | | ### Possibly linked issues - **#Fail to Delete Files in Resource**: PR fixes faulty batch resource deletion logic, which likely caused the reported inability to free space for uploads. - **#12448**: PR corrects batch deletion selection logic using fileList when resourceMap misses IDs, preventing unintended deletions - **#12448**: They both fix the same batch file deletion failure by correcting resource lookup during select-all deletion.

Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. ## Reviewer's Guide Updates release and CI workflows to align with a forked/upstream-sync model, switch Docker image publishing to GHCR, and gate the provider settings UI behind a feature flag, while adding configurability to the web crawler and cleaning up unused workflows/S3 update logic. #### Sequence diagram for scheduled rebase of main onto upstream-main ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Cron as Scheduler participant GH as GitHub_Actions participant Repo as lunan-org/lobehub participant Git as Git_CLI participant PR as PR_Service participant Issues as Issues_Service Cron->>GH: Trigger rebase-main-onto-upstream.yml GH->>Repo: Checkout branch main GH->>Git: git fetch origin upstream-main:upstream-main GH->>Git: git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream-main main alt upstream-main already in main Git-->>GH: exit 0 (no update) GH->>GH: Mark job skipped else upstream-main has new commits GH->>Git: Configure bot identity GH->>Git: Create branch sync/rebase- GH->>Git: git rebase upstream-main --committer-date-is-author-date GH->>Git: git push origin sync/rebase- GH->>PR: Create PR base=main head=sync/rebase- end opt Rebase fails with conflicts GH->>Issues: Create issue "Patch rebase failed (conflicts)" end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Refactor desktop stable release workflow to trigger on tags, drop S3 publishing, and tighten stable detection and permissions. |
  • Change trigger from GitHub Releases to tag push and manual input; treat versions with '-' as non-stable and skip downstream jobs.
  • Simplify version & release-notes detection, using GITHUB_REF_NAME for tags and clearing release body usage.
  • Remove S3-related secrets, UPDATE_SERVER_URL usage, and the publish-s3 job; retain only GitHub Releases upload when stable and not explicitly skipped.
  • Adjust build matrix generation (mac runners) and add conditions so merge/publish jobs run only for stable builds with appropriate permissions.
  • Use github.ref_name when publishing releases and ensure default workflow permissions are read-only with write granted only where needed.
| `.github/workflows/release-desktop-stable.yml` | | Adjust monorepo release workflow to avoid auto-publishing and instead just generate docs as artifacts. |
  • Grant packages: write permission for potential future package publishing.
  • Stop using a custom GH_TOKEN for checkout and rely on default token with full history via fetch-depth=0.
  • Comment out semantic-release (bun run release) and auto-commit/push steps, effectively disabling automated releases and doc commits.
  • Add an upload-artifact step to persist generated README/docs for inspection instead of committing them.
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | | Switch Docker image publishing (main and PR builds) from Docker Hub to GitHub Container Registry and adjust triggers and permissions. |
  • Change Docker release workflow trigger from release/workflow_dispatch to tag push on v*.*.*.
  • Set REGISTRY to ghcr.io and REGISTRY_IMAGE to ghcr.io/lunan-org/lobehub in both release and PR Docker workflows.
  • Update Docker login steps to use GHCR with github.actor and GITHUB_TOKEN instead of Docker Hub credentials.
  • For PR builds, stop pushing built images (push=false) while still creating manifests/tags for inspection and comments, and update PR comment URLs to point to GHCR.
  • Grant packages: write permission to workflows that interact with GHCR.
| `.github/workflows/release-docker.yml`
`.github/workflows/pr-build-docker.yml` | | Gate the Provider settings tab visibility behind a server config feature flag. |
  • Extend featureFlagsSelectors usage to include a showProvider flag from the server config store.
  • Wrap the Provider tab CategoryItem in a conditional expression so the tab only appears when showProvider is true.
| `src/app/[variants]/(main)/settings/hooks/useCategory.tsx` | | Tighten PR desktop build release tagging to avoid cluttering tags/releases. |
  • Change PR desktop build GitHub Release tag_name from a version-based v tag to pr- to avoid generating many version-like tags/releases.
  • Keep the release name and body logic intact while improving tag hygiene.
| `.github/workflows/pr-build-desktop.yml` | | Make Browserless crawler request rejection pattern configurable via environment variable. |
  • Wrap the existing regular expression for REJECT_REQUEST_PATTERN with a process.env override so deployments can customize allowed/blocked resource types without code changes.
| `packages/web-crawler/src/crawImpl/browserless.ts` | | Introduce automated upstream sync and rebase workflows for keeping fork branches up-to-date with upstream main/canary. |
  • Add sync-upstream-main and sync-upstream-canary workflows that periodically sync upstream main/canary into local upstream-main/upstream-canary branches using Fork-Sync-With-Upstream-action and create issues on failure.
  • Add a rebase-main-onto-upstream workflow that checks if upstream-main has new commits, creates a sync branch, rebases main onto upstream-main, pushes the branch, and opens a PR back to main; if the job fails, it opens an issue for manual intervention.
| `.github/workflows/rebase-main-onto-upstream.yml`
`.github/workflows/sync-upstream-canary.yml`
`.github/workflows/sync-upstream-main.yml` | | Clean up unused or upstream-only GitHub workflows to simplify CI configuration for the fork. |
  • Remove a set of automation workflows related to i18n, tags, bundle analysis, Claude AI tooling, issue automation, desktop beta/canary/nightly releases, and sync workflows not needed in this fork.

You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

## Reviewer's Guide Translates all Chinese comments in the memory module to concise English while preserving code behavior and comment placement, primarily in the 3D RoleTagCloud canvas and list-view pages for contexts, experiences, preferences, identities, plus the memory layout styles. ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Update TagCloudCanvas 3D visualization comments from Chinese to English without altering logic or JSX structure. |
  • Translate configuration constant descriptions (connection ratios, lifetimes, particle counts, spawn probabilities, update interval).
  • Translate memoization and re-render condition comments for Word and FlowingParticle components.
  • Translate animation and visual-effect comments for flowing particles, fade-in/fade-out lifecycle, glow effects, and gradient line creation.
  • Translate comments describing connection management (random connection generation, initialization, periodic updates, expiration filtering, and auto-rotation).
  • Translate JSX block comments for rendering main lines, glow layers, flowing particles, center avatar, connection lines, and tags.
| `src/app/[variants]/(main)/memory/(home)/features/RoleTagCloud/TagCloudCanvas.tsx` | | Update list page comments in memory submodules (contexts, experiences, preferences, identities) to English while keeping hooks and effects intact. |
  • Translate comments explaining sort value conversion where capturedAt maps to undefined for backend defaults.
  • Translate comments describing when lists are reset based on search, sort, view mode, or type filters.
  • Translate comments noting SWR data-fetch hooks usage for paginated lists.
  • Translate comments explaining loading state conditions for initial load vs search/reset.
| `src/app/[variants]/(main)/memory/contexts/index.tsx`
`src/app/[variants]/(main)/memory/experiences/index.tsx`
`src/app/[variants]/(main)/memory/preferences/index.tsx`
`src/app/[variants]/(main)/memory/identities/index.tsx` | | Translate layout styles comment in memory module to English. |

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Ensures Better Auth sessions are still persisted in the primary database even when Redis is configured as secondary storage, so that missing Redis keys don’t immediately invalidate user sessions. #### Sequence diagram for session resolution with Redis miss and DB fallback ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant Browser participant AppServer participant RedisCache participant PrimaryDB User->>Browser: Navigate to authenticated endpoint Browser->>AppServer: HTTP request with session cookie AppServer->>RedisCache: getSession(sessionId) alt Redis hit RedisCache-->>AppServer: Session data AppServer-->>Browser: 200 OK (session valid) else Redis miss RedisCache-->>AppServer: Session not found AppServer->>PrimaryDB: loadSessionFromDatabase(sessionId) alt Session found in DB PrimaryDB-->>AppServer: Session data AppServer-->>Browser: 200 OK (session valid via DB fallback) else Session not found in DB PrimaryDB-->>AppServer: Not found AppServer-->>Browser: 401 Unauthorized (must sign in) end end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Enable database-backed fallback session storage when Redis secondary storage is configured in Better Auth. |
  • Set Better Auth session.cookies.storeSessionInDatabase to true so sessions continue to be persisted in the primary database alongside Redis secondary storage.
  • Document the intent via an inline comment explaining the defensive DB-backed fallback when Redis entries are unexpectedly missing.
| `src/libs/better-auth/define-config.ts` | ### Assessment against linked issues | Issue | Objective | Addressed | Explanation | | ------ | ------- | ----- | ----- | | https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/issues/12125 | Ensure Better Auth v2 session persistence so that web users are not unexpectedly logged out shortly after logging in (comparable to v1 behavior), especially in self-hosted Docker deployments. | ✅ | | | https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub/issues/12125 | Provide an explicit 'remember me' / 'auto log in' option (or equivalent longer-lived session behavior) in the Better Auth v2 login flow. | ❌ | The PR only enables `storeSessionInDatabase: true` for secondary-storage sessions to keep a DB-backed fallback when Redis entries are missing. ## Reviewer's Guide Implements editable email support in profile settings, wires it to Better Auth's changeEmail flow with a dedicated verification template, and adds the necessary backend config, client export, and i18n strings. #### Sequence diagram for email change verification flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant EmailRow participant AuthClient participant BetterAuthServer participant EmailService participant Mailbox User->>EmailRow: Click updateEmail EmailRow->>EmailRow: Validate new email with EMAIL_REGEX EmailRow->>AuthClient: changeEmail(callbackURL, newEmail) AuthClient->>BetterAuthServer: HTTP changeEmail request BetterAuthServer->>BetterAuthServer: Detect isChangeEmail from request.url BetterAuthServer->>BetterAuthServer: Select getChangeEmailVerificationTemplate BetterAuthServer->>EmailService: sendMail(to newEmail, subject, html, text) EmailService-->>Mailbox: Deliver verification email BetterAuthServer-->>AuthClient: Response success AuthClient-->>EmailRow: Response { error | success } EmailRow->>EmailRow: Show success or error message User->>Mailbox: Open verification email User->>BetterAuthServer: Click verification link (change-email URL) BetterAuthServer->>BetterAuthServer: Validate token and update user.email ``` #### Class diagram for EmailRow and BetterAuth email change integration ```mermaid classDiagram class EmailRow { -string email -boolean isEditing -string editValue -boolean saving -string error +EmailRow(mobile) +handleStartEdit() +handleCancel() +handleSave() } class AuthClientExports { +changeEmail(callbackURL, newEmail) Promise } class BetterAuthConfigUser { +boolean changeEmail_enabled } class EmailTemplatesModule { +getChangeEmailVerificationTemplate(expiresInSeconds, url, userName) Template +getVerificationEmailTemplate(expiresInSeconds, url, userName) Template } class EmailService { +sendMail(to, subject, html, text) Promise } class VerificationFlowSelector { +selectTemplate(requestUrl, expiresInSeconds, url, userName) Template } EmailRow --> AuthClientExports : uses changeEmail AuthClientExports --> BetterAuthConfigUser : requires changeEmail enabled BetterAuthConfigUser --> VerificationFlowSelector : passes request.url VerificationFlowSelector --> EmailTemplatesModule : chooses template VerificationFlowSelector --> EmailService : sends email via sendMail ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Enable Better Auth change-email flow and use ## Reviewer's Guide Introduces ModelsLab as a new OpenAI-compatible chat provider across model-bank and model-runtime, wiring it into the provider enum, default provider list, UI card, dynamic model fetching, runtime factory, and tests following existing AkashChat/AiHubMix patterns. #### Sequence diagram for ModelsLab chat completion flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant UI as UI_ModelSelector participant Runtime as LobeModelsLabAI participant ModelsLab as ModelsLab_API User->>UI: Select ModelsLab provider UI->>Runtime: Create chat completion request Runtime->>ModelsLab: POST /api/uncensored-chat/v1/chat/completions ModelsLab-->>Runtime: 200 OK with completion Runtime-->>UI: Formatted chat response UI-->>User: Display assistant message ``` #### Class diagram for new ModelsLab provider integration ```mermaid classDiagram class ModelProvider { <> AkashChat AiHubMix ModelsLab Mistral Groq Perplexity ModelScope } class ModelProviderCard { <> +string id +string name +string description +string url +string apiKeyUrl +string modelsUrl +string[] chatModels +string checkModel +Settings settings } class Settings { +string sdkType +boolean showModelFetcher } class ModelsLabProviderCard { +string id = modelslab +string name = ModelsLab +string description +string url = https://modelslab.com +string apiKeyUrl = https://modelslab.com/account/api-key +string modelsUrl = https://docs.modelslab.com +string[] chatModels = [] +string checkModel = meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct +Settings settings } class AIChatModelCard { <> +string id +string name +string description } class modelsLabChatModels { +AIChatModelCard[] value = [] } class OpenAICompatibleFactoryOptions { +string baseURL +ModelProvider provider +DebugConfig debug } class DebugConfig { +function chatCompletion returns boolean } class LobeModelsLabAI { } class OpenAICompatibleRuntimeFactory { +createOpenAICompatibleRuntime(options OpenAICompatibleFactoryOptions) LobeModelsLabAI } ModelProvider <|.. ModelsLabProviderCard : uses_enum_value ModelProviderCard <|.. ModelsLabProviderCard : implements Settings <.. ModelsLabProviderCard : composed_in AIChatModelCard <.. modelsLabChatModels : array_of OpenAICompatibleFactoryOptions <.. LobeModelsLabAI : constructed_with DebugConfig <.. OpenAICompatibleFactoryOptions : has OpenAICompatibleRuntimeFactory ..> LobeModelsLabAI : creates ModelProvider ..> LobeModelsLabAI : ModelsLab_enum_used ``` #### Flow diagram for ModelsLab provider registration in model-bank and model-runtime ```mermaid flowchart TD MP["ModelProvider enum\nadd ModelsLab = modelslab"] --> MPL["DEFAULT_MODEL_PROVIDER_LIST\ninclude ModelsLabProvider"] MP --> RTExport["model-runtime index.ts\nexport LobeModelsLabAI"] subgraph ModelBank MPC["ModelsLabProviderCard\nmodelProviders/modelslab.ts"] MLModels["modelsLabChatModels\naiModels/modelslab.ts"] ProviderIndex["modelProviders/index.ts\nregister ModelsLabProviderCard"] end subgraph ModelRuntime Params["params for ModelsLab\nbaseURL, provider, debug"] RuntimeFactory["createOpenAICompatibleRuntime(params)\nLobeModelsLabAI"] Tests["index.test.ts\nuse testProvider with ModelsLab"] end MPL --> MPC MPC --> ProviderIndex MLModels --> MPC MP --> Params Params --> RuntimeFactory RuntimeFactory --> RTExport Params --> Tests MP --> Tests ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add ModelsLab provider metadata and card to model-bank. |
  • Define ModelsLab provider card with OpenAI SDK configuration, API key URL, docs URL, and enable dynamic model fetching.
  • Introduce ModelProvider.ModelsLab enum value for referencing the provider across the codebase.
  • Register ModelsLab provider and provider card in the central modelProviders index and default provider list.
| `packages/model-bank/src/modelProviders/modelslab.ts`
`packages/model-bank/src/const/modelProvider.ts`
`packages/model-bank/src/modelProviders/index.ts` | | Wire ModelsLab into the runtime as an OpenAI-compatible provider. |
  • Create LobeModelsLabAI runtime using createOpenAICompatibleRuntime with ModelsLab base URL, provider id, and debug flag tied to DEBUG_MODELSLAB_CHAT_COMPLETION.
  • Export LobeModelsLabAI from the main model-runtime index for external consumption.
| `packages/model-runtime/src/providers/modelslab/index.ts`
`packages/model-runtime/src/index.ts` | | Add basic runtime tests for the ModelsLab provider wiring. |
  • Use testProvider helper to validate ModelsLab runtime configuration, including provider id, default base URL, and a sample chat model id.
  • Assert that params exported from the ModelsLab runtime contain the expected provider, baseURL, and debug.chatCompletion function.
| `packages/model-runtime/src/providers/modelslab/index.test.ts` | | Prepare dynamic model list support for ModelsLab chat models. |
  • Introduce an empty modelsLabChatModels array for chat models, consistent with providers that rely on runtime model fetching.

## Reviewer's Guide Introduces a Vite dev-server plugin that disables the default .env file restart behavior and instead restarts only when specified env keys change, wiring it into vite.config.ts and implementing custom env file watching, parsing, snapshotting, and restart logic. #### Sequence diagram for env key based Vite dev server restart ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant FS as FileSystem participant ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin as ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin participant EnvWatcher as EnvDirFSWatcher participant Parser as EnvParser participant Snapshot as SnapshotComparator participant Logger as ViteLogger participant Server as ViteDevServer FS->>EnvWatcher: change event for .env file EnvWatcher->>ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin: onChange(filename) ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin: debounce(100ms) ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>Parser: parseEnvFromDisk(envDir, mode) Parser-->>ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin: currentEnv ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>Snapshot: snapshot(keys, currentEnv) Snapshot-->>ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin: nextSnapshot ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>Snapshot: hasChanges(prevSnapshot, nextSnapshot, keys) Snapshot-->>ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin: changedKeys[] ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin: prevSnapshot = nextSnapshot alt any changedKeys ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>Logger: info(env key changed: changedKeys — restarting server) ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>Server: restart() else no changedKeys ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin-->>Server: no action end Server->>ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin: httpServer close ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>EnvWatcher: close() ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin->>ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin: clear debounce timer ``` #### Class diagram for viteEnvRestartKeys plugin structure ```mermaid classDiagram class ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin { - string mode - string envDir - Record~string, string|undefined~ prevSnapshot - FSWatcher dirWatcher - Timeout debounceTimer - string[] keys + config() Record + configResolved(config) + configureServer(server) } class EnvParser { + parseEnvFromDisk(envDir string, mode string) Record~string, string~ + getEnvFileNames(mode string) Set~string~ } class SnapshotComparator { + snapshot(keys string[], env Record~string, string~) Record~string, string|undefined~ + hasChanges(prevSnapshot Record~string, string|undefined~, nextSnapshot Record~string, string|undefined~, keys string[]) string[] } class ViteDevServer { + restart() void + httpServer + config } class ViteLogger { + info(message string, options) void } class FSWatcher { + close() void } class ViteConfig { + mode string + envDir string + root string } ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin --> EnvParser : uses ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin --> SnapshotComparator : uses ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin --> ViteDevServer : configures ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin --> ViteLogger : logs to ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin --> FSWatcher : manages ViteEnvRestartKeysPlugin --> ViteConfig : reads from ``` #### Flow diagram for selective .env restart decision logic ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Start: .env file change detected] --> B{Is filename in
.env/.env.local/.env.mode/.env.mode.local?} B -->|No| C[Ignore event
Do nothing] B -->|Yes| D[Clear existing debounce timer] D --> E[Set new 100ms debounce timer] E --> F[On debounce timeout] F --> G[Parse all env files from disk
respecting Vite precedence] G --> H[Build snapshot for whitelisted keys] H --> I{Any key value changed
vs previous snapshot?} I -->|No| J[Update prevSnapshot
Keep server running] I -->|Yes| K[Log env key changed and keys list] K --> L[Call server.restart] J --> M[End] L --> M[End] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add and wire up a Vite plugin to restart the dev server only when whitelisted env keys change. |
  • Register the new viteEnvRestartKeys plugin in vite.config.ts with an initial whitelist containing APP_URL.
  • Limit plugin application to dev-server (serve) mode so build behavior is unchanged.
| `vite.config.ts` | | Implement custom .env watching and diffing logic to selectively restart the dev server based on env key changes. |
  • Suppress Vite’s built-in .env watching by configuring server.watch.ignored to ignore .env and .env.* files.
  • Watch the env directory directly with fs.watch, respecting Vite’s env resolution order for .env variants and reading file contents from disk instead of using loadEnv.
  • Parse .env files line-by-line, handling comments, missing equals, and stripping surrounding quotes from values, then build a merged env snapshot with later files overriding earlier ones.
  • Track a snapshot of only whitelisted keys, compare old vs new snapshots on changes, and trigger a debounced server restart (with a log message listing changed keys) when any tracked key value changes.
  • Clean up the directory watcher and debounce timer when the dev server’s HTTP server closes to avoid resource leaks.
| `plugins/vite/envRestartKeys.ts` | ---

## Reviewer's Guide Stubs out the Better Auth client for the Electron desktop renderer using a .desktop.ts noop implementation so the Vite desktop build can evaluate modules safely, adjusts drag regions in the splash and error HTML resources, and adds a convenience dev script for the desktop app. #### Sequence diagram for Electron desktop renderer using auth-client desktop stub ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ElectronApp participant RendererProcess participant ReactApp participant ViteDevServer participant AuthClientDesktopStub User ->> ElectronApp: Launch_app ElectronApp ->> RendererProcess: Load_desktop_renderer RendererProcess ->> ViteDevServer: Request_bundled_assets ViteDevServer ->> ViteDevServer: vitePlatformResolve_for_desktop ViteDevServer ->> AuthClientDesktopStub: Resolve_@_libs_better-auth_auth-client_to_desktop_stub ViteDevServer -->> RendererProcess: Serve_bundle_with_stubbed_auth-client RendererProcess ->> ReactApp: Execute_bundle ReactApp ->> AuthClientDesktopStub: useSession AuthClientDesktopStub -->> ReactApp: {data_null_error_null_isPending_false} ReactApp -->> User: Show_loaded_UI_without_hanging ``` #### Class diagram for auth-client desktop stub module ```mermaid classDiagram class AuthClientDesktopModule { <> +changeEmail() +linkSocial() +oauth2() +accountInfo() +listAccounts() +requestPasswordReset() +resetPassword() +sendVerificationEmail() +signIn() +signOut() +signUp() +unlinkAccount() +useSession() SessionState } class SessionState { +data any +error any +isPending boolean } AuthClientDesktopModule ..> SessionState ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce a desktop-specific noop Better Auth client so Electron renderer builds no longer crash on module evaluation. |
  • Add auth-client.desktop.ts that exports noop implementations for all Better Auth client functions used in the app.

## Reviewer's Guide Adjusts DeepSeek provider payload handling so assistant history messages for the deepseek-reasoner model always include a normalized reasoning_content field, while preserving existing reasoning values and adding regression tests to cover tool-call and history scenarios. #### Sequence diagram for deepseek-reasoner payload normalization ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Client participant ModelRuntime participant DeepSeekProvider participant DeepSeekAPI Client->>ModelRuntime: sendChatCompletion(payload with messages) ModelRuntime->>DeepSeekProvider: call handlePayload(payload) activate DeepSeekProvider Note over DeepSeekProvider: model === deepseek-reasoner DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: iterate messages DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: extract reasoning and rest DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: compute reasoningContent from rest.reasoning_content or reasoning.content alt assistant message for deepseek-reasoner DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: set reasoning_content to reasoningContent or "" else non assistant or other model alt reasoningContent is defined DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: set reasoning_content to reasoningContent else no reasoningContent DeepSeekProvider->>DeepSeekProvider: keep rest without reasoning_content end end DeepSeekProvider-->>ModelRuntime: return normalizedPayload(messages with reasoning_content) deactivate DeepSeekProvider ModelRuntime->>DeepSeekAPI: POST /chat/completions normalizedPayload DeepSeekAPI-->>ModelRuntime: streaming or non streaming response ModelRuntime-->>Client: final response ``` #### Flow diagram for handlePayload reasoning_content normalization ```mermaid flowchart TD Start([Start handlePayload]) A[Read payload.model] --> B{model == deepseek-reasoner} B --> C[Map payload.messages] subgraph PerMessage[Per message transformation] C1[Destructure message into reasoning and rest] C1 --> C2[Compute reasoningContent from rest.reasoning_content or reasoning.content] C2 --> C3{message.role == assistant AND model == deepseek-reasoner} C3 -->|Yes| C4[Return rest with reasoning_content = reasoningContent or empty string] C3 -->|No| C5{reasoningContent is defined} C5 -->|Yes| C6[Return rest with reasoning_content = reasoningContent] C5 -->|No| C7[Return rest without reasoning_content] end C --> PerMessage --> D[Collect transformed messages] D --> E[Build result with messages and stream = false] E --> End([Return normalized payload]) ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Normalize reasoning and reasoning_content fields in DeepSeek chatCompletion payload handling without mutating source messages, and enforce reasoning_content on deepseek-reasoner assistant messages. |
  • Refactor message mapping to destructure reasoning and compute a reasoningContent string from either reasoning_content or reasoning.content when present.
  • For deepseek-reasoner models, always return assistant messages with a reasoning_content field, defaulting to an empty string when no reasoning is available.
  • For non-deepseek-reasoner messages, propagate normalized reasoning_content when present and drop the legacy reasoning object.
  • Avoid mutating the original message objects by returning reconstructed message objects from map instead of modifying in place.
| `packages/model-runtime/src/providers/deepseek/index.ts` | | Add regression tests to validate reasoning_content behavior for deepseek-reasoner assistant messages with tool calls and existing reasoning. |
  • Add a test ensuring deepseek-reasoner assistant messages with tool_calls and no reasoning field get reasoning_content: ''.
  • Add a test ensuring existing reasoning_content on deepseek-reasoner assistant messages is preserved unchanged after payload handling.
| `packages/model-runtime/src/providers/deepseek/index.test.ts` | ### Possibly linked issues - **#11924**: The PR normalizes DeepSeek payloads to always include reasoning_content, directly fixing the missing-field error described in the issue. - **#11924**: The PR normalizes DeepSeek reasoner messages to always include `reasoning_content`, resolving the missing-field error from the issue. - **#11924**: The PR adds/normalizes reasoning_content on deepseek-reasoner assistant messages, directly fixing the tool-call error described in the issue. ---
