Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Refactors convertOpenAIResponseInputs to avoid shared-array side effects by collecting per-message response input items and flattening them, ensuring Responses API inputs preserve original message ordering despite async processing. #### Sequence diagram for convertOpenAIResponseInputs async processing after fix ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Caller participant convertOpenAIResponseInputs participant PromiseAll as Promise_all participant Message as OpenAIChatMessage Caller->>convertOpenAIResponseInputs: messages, options activate convertOpenAIResponseInputs convertOpenAIResponseInputs->>PromiseAll: Promise_all(messages.map(async message => items[])) activate PromiseAll loop for each message PromiseAll->>Message: process message activate Message alt has reasoning Message-->>Message: items.push(reasoning item) end alt assistant with tool_calls Message-->>Message: items.push(function_call items) Message-->>PromiseAll: return items else tool role Message-->>Message: items.push(function_call_output item) Message-->>PromiseAll: return items else system role Message-->>Message: items.push(developer item) Message-->>PromiseAll: return items else default message Message-->>Message: build item from content (may await image processing) Message-->>Message: items.push(default item) Message-->>PromiseAll: return items end deactivate Message end PromiseAll-->>convertOpenAIResponseInputs: inputGroups (OpenAI.Responses.ResponseInputItem[][]) deactivate PromiseAll convertOpenAIResponseInputs-->>convertOpenAIResponseInputs: inputGroups.flat() convertOpenAIResponseInputs-->>Caller: ResponseInputItem[] deactivate convertOpenAIResponseInputs ``` #### Flow diagram for convertOpenAIResponseInputs message handling logic ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Start convertOpenAIResponseInputs] --> B[Receive messages and options] B --> C[Run Promise_all over messages.map] C --> D[For each message create items array] D --> E{message has reasoning content?} E -->|yes| F[Push reasoning item into items] E -->|no| G[Skip reasoning item] F --> H G --> H H{role is assistant and has tool_calls?} -->|yes| I[For each tool_call push function_call item into items] I --> J[Return items for this message] H -->|no| K{role is tool?} K -->|yes| L[Push function_call_output item into items] L --> J K -->|no| M{role is system?} M -->|yes| N[Push developer item into items] N --> J M -->|no| O[Build default message item from content] O --> P[Remove reasoning field from item] P --> Q[Push default item into items] Q --> J J --> R[Promise_all resolves to inputGroups] R --> S[Flatten inputGroups with inputGroups.flat] S --> T[Return flattened ResponseInputItem array] T --> U[End] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Preserve message ordering in convertOpenAIResponseInputs by eliminating shared mutable state during async mapping. |
  • Replaced a shared input array with per-message items arrays collected within the async map callback.
  • Made the async map callback return its per-message items array instead of mutating shared state and early-returning.
  • Captured all per-message item arrays with Promise.all into inputGroups, then flattened them into the final input array.
  • Updated all push sites (reasoning items, assistant tool calls, tool role outputs, system messages, and default items) to write into the local items array and return it.

## Reviewer's Guide Moves changelog generation into the auto-tag release workflow by introducing a custom Git-based changelog generator script, wiring it into the CI pipeline before tagging, and removing the now-broken semantic-release based changelog step from the release workflow. #### Sequence diagram for updated auto-tag release changelog generation ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Dev participant GitHub as GitHub_Actions participant AutoTag as AutoTagReleaseWorkflow participant NodeSetup as Setup_Node participant BunSetup as Setup_Bun participant Deps as Install_Dependencies participant Bump as Bump_Package_Version participant ChangelogGen as Generate_Changelog participant ChangelogStatic as Build_Static_Changelog participant CommitPush as Commit_And_Push participant Tag as Create_Git_Tag Dev->>GitHub: Push to main GitHub->>AutoTag: Trigger auto-tag-release.yml AutoTag->>AutoTag: Determine_should_tag AutoTag->>NodeSetup: Setup Node.js (if SHOULD_TAG) AutoTag->>BunSetup: Install bun (if SHOULD_TAG) AutoTag->>Deps: bun i (if SHOULD_TAG) AutoTag->>Bump: Update package.json version Bump-->>AutoTag: package.json updated AutoTag->>ChangelogGen: bun run workflow:changelog:gen ChangelogGen-->>AutoTag: CHANGELOG.md updated AutoTag->>ChangelogStatic: bun run workflow:changelog ChangelogStatic-->>AutoTag: changelog/*.json updated AutoTag->>CommitPush: git add package.json CHANGELOG.md changelog/ CommitPush->>CommitPush: Commit release changes CommitPush->>CommitPush: Push to main AutoTag->>Tag: Create annotated tag vX.Y.Z Tag-->>GitHub: New release tag exists ``` #### Class diagram for changelog generation module ```mermaid classDiagram class Commit { +string hash +string[] issues +string scope +string subject +string type } class TypeConfig { +string detail +string emoji +string summary } class ChangelogGenerator { -string REPO_URL -string CHANGELOG_TITLE -string BACK_TO_TOP -Record~string,TypeConfig~ TYPE_MAP +string git(cmd string) +string getLastTag() +string getPreviousTag(currentTag string) +Commit[] getCommits(from string) +Record~string,Commit[]~ groupByType(commits Commit[]) +string formatSummarySection(groups Record~string,Commit[]~) +string formatDetailSection(groups Record~string,Commit[]~) +void run() } class Filesystem { +string readFileSync(path string, encoding string) +void writeFileSync(path string, data string) } class GitCli { +string execSync(command string) } class Logger { +void warn(message string) +void success(message string) } ChangelogGenerator --> Commit : uses ChangelogGenerator --> TypeConfig : uses ChangelogGenerator --> Filesystem : reads_writes ChangelogGenerator --> GitCli : executes_git_commands ChangelogGenerator --> Logger : logs_status ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Wire changelog generation into the auto-tag release workflow before tagging and adjust git commit responsibilities. |
  • Set up Node.js and Bun (without caching) in auto-tag-release workflow only when a tag should be created.
  • Install dependencies via Bun prior to version bump and changelog generation.
  • Keep the version bump step but move git user configuration and commit logic into a new dedicated step that also stages changelog files.
  • Stage package.json, CHANGELOG.md, and changelog/ when committing and pushing release changes.
| `.github/workflows/auto-tag-release.yml` | | Remove semantic-release-based changelog and release handling from the release workflow to avoid conflicts with pre-existing tags. |
  • Remove steps that extract the version from the tag and validate package.json against it.
  • Remove the semantic-release execution step and its environment variable wiring so the release job no longer tries to publish or generate changelog there.
| `.github/workflows/release.yml` | | Introduce a custom changelog generation script and associated npm script for use in CI. |
  • Add a new npm script to run the changelog generator entrypoint within the existing changelog workflow directory.
  • Implement generateChangelog.ts to compute the commit range since the previous tag, parse conventional commits (with emoji/gitmoji stripping), and group them by type for summary and detail sections.
  • Use git describe to find tags, build a compare or release URL for the current version, and format a markdown entry that includes summary and detailed sections plus a back-to-top link.
  • Prepend the newly generated changelog entry to CHANGELOG.md while preserving the existing title header, emitting a warning and skipping if no suitable commits are found.

## Reviewer's Guide Adjusts release and desktop S3 publish workflows to fix Electron auto-update URL prefixes and wire in automated changelog generation, while making market API token injection safer and updating tests and scripts accordingly. #### Sequence diagram for updated desktop S3 manifest generation and upload ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Developer participant GitHubActions as GitHub_Actions participant AutoTagWorkflow as auto-tag-release.yml participant DesktopBuild as Desktop_Build_Job participant DesktopPublishAction as desktop-publish-s3_action participant S3 as S3_Bucket Developer->>GitHubActions: Push tag / trigger release GitHubActions->>AutoTagWorkflow: Run tagging and changelog steps AutoTagWorkflow->>DesktopBuild: Trigger desktop build and artifacts DesktopBuild->>DesktopPublishAction: Invoke desktop-publish-s3 with artifacts Note over DesktopPublishAction: 1) Find release/latest*.yml DesktopPublishAction->>DesktopPublishAction: For each latest*.yml, sed URL to add $VERSION/ prefix Note over DesktopPublishAction: 2) Create channel manifests from modified latest*.yml DesktopPublishAction->>DesktopPublishAction: Copy latest*.yml to ${CHANNEL}*.yml Note over DesktopPublishAction: 3) Create renderer manifest (stable only) DesktopPublishAction->>DesktopPublishAction: Generate ${CHANNEL}-renderer.yml when renderer tar exists Note over DesktopPublishAction: 4) Upload manifests DesktopPublishAction->>S3: Upload latest*.yml and ${CHANNEL}*.yml to channel root DesktopPublishAction->>S3: Upload same manifests to channel/$VERSION/ directory ``` #### Sequence diagram for market API calls using safeInjectMPToken ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant UI as Frontend_UI participant Discover as DiscoverService participant MarketApi as MarketApiService participant Lambda as lambdaClient_market participant ConfigStore as global_serverConfigStore User->>UI: Perform market action (e.g., open Assistant list) UI->>Discover: getAssistantList(params) Discover->>Discover: safeInjectMPToken() alt Market trusted client enabled Discover->>ConfigStore: getState() ConfigStore-->>Discover: serverConfig.enableMarketTrustedClient = true Discover-->>Discover: Skip M2M token injection else Trusted client disabled Discover->>Discover: injectMPToken() Discover-->>Discover: MP token injected (or warning logged on failure) end Discover->>Lambda: market.getAssistantList.query(locale, params) Lambda-->>Discover: AssistantListResponse Discover-->>UI: AssistantListResponse Note over MarketApi,Discover: Other calls (getMcpList, reportPluginCall, searchSkill, etc.) MarketApi->>Discover: safeInjectMPToken() Discover-->>MarketApi: (returns after optional injection) MarketApi->>Lambda: Perform market.* request ``` #### Class diagram for updated DiscoverService and related services ```mermaid classDiagram class DiscoverService { - boolean _isRetrying - Promise~void~ _tokenRefreshPromise + boolean isMarketTrustedClientEnabled() + Promise~void~ safeInjectMPToken() + Promise~AssistantListResponse~ getAssistantList(params) + Promise~McpListResponse~ getMcpList(params) + Promise~McpListResponse~ getMCPPluginList(params) + Promise~void~ reportMarketError(success, errorCode, extra) + Promise~void~ reportPluginCall(reportData) + Promise~void~ reportAgentEvent(eventData) + Promise~void~ reportAgentInstall(identifier) + Promise~void~ reportPluginTelemetry(eventData) + Promise~void~ injectMPToken() } class MarketApiService { + Promise~SearchResult~ searchSkill(params) } class MCPService { + Promise~void~ callTool(payload, signal, topicId) } class global_serverConfigStore { + getState() ServerConfigState } class ServerConfigState { + ServerConfig serverConfig } class ServerConfig { + boolean enableMarketTrustedClient } class lambdaClient_market { + getAssistantList_query(params) + getMcpList_query(params) + getMCPPluginList_query(params) + reportCall_mutate(reportData) + reportAgentInstall_mutate(identifier) + reportPluginTelemetry_mutate(eventData) + skill_searchSkill_query(params) } DiscoverService --> global_serverConfigStore : uses DiscoverService --> lambdaClient_market : uses MarketApiService --> DiscoverService : uses safeInjectMPToken MarketApiService --> lambdaClient_market : uses MCPService --> DiscoverService : uses safeInjectMPToken %% Note: tests now mock DiscoverService.safeInjectMPToken instead of injectMPToken ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Ensure S3 desktop release manifests (latest*.yml and {channel}*.yml) reference artifacts under the correct version-prefixed directory to fix Electron auto-update 404s. |
  • Preprocess all release/latest*.yml files in-place with sed to prefix every url: field with $VERSION/ before upload.
  • Generate ${CHANNEL}*.yml files by copying the already-updated latest*.yml instead of re-sed-ing them.
  • Update step comments and numbering in the composite desktop-publish-s3 GitHub Action to reflect the new manifest generation order and semantics.
| `.github/actions/desktop-publish-s3/action.yml` | | Refine the auto-tag-release workflow to bump versions, generate changelogs, and commit all release artifacts in a single step using bun and a new changelog generator. |
  • Add Node.js and bun setup plus dependency installation gated on should_tag conditions.
  • Split version bumping from git configuration/commit logic and add steps to generate and build the changelog via new bun scripts.
  • Create a consolidated commit-and-push step that configures git, stages package.json, CHANGELOG.md, and changelog/ and pushes to main.
  • Wire in new workflow:changelog:gen script into package.json.
| `.github/workflows/auto-tag-release.yml`
`package.json` | | Introduce a script to generate structured changelog entries from conventional commits and insert them into CHANGELOG.md. |
  • Implement scripts/changelogWorkflow/generateChangelog.ts to compute the commit range, parse conventional commit messages (with emoji stripping and type/scope extraction), and group them by type.
  • Format both a summary and detailed section (with issue and commit links) for the current version and prepend it to CHANGELOG.md with consistent headings and navigation anchors.
  • Handle absence of tags or commits gracefully and log via consola.
| `scripts/changelogWorkflow/generateChangelog.ts` | | Make market M2M token injection tolerant of new trusted client mode and non-blocking on failures, updating all call sites and tests. |
  • Add DiscoverService.isMarketTrustedClientEnabled helper that reads enableMarketTrustedClient from global_serverConfigStore when available, defaulting to false on SSR or errors.
  • Introduce DiscoverService.safeInjectMPToken which skips injection when trusted client mode is enabled and wraps injectMPToken in a try/catch that only logs warnings.
  • Replace direct injectMPToken calls in assistant, MCP, telemetry, and agent install/report flows with safeInjectMPToken in discover, marketApi, and mcp services.
  • Update mcp unit test mocks to use safeInjectMPToken instead of injectMPToken.

(no 404) ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Fix URL prefix injection in desktop S3 publish action to operate on channel-specific and fallback manifest files in-place. |

  • Switch from generating new channel-named manifest files to editing the matched manifest files in-place with sed -i to prepend $VERSION/ to url: entries.

## Reviewer's Guide Updates the desktop updater flow to render release notes via a Markdown component instead of raw HTML, introduces a new 'available' updater stage with broadcast handling, and adds a dev-only simulated 'update found' path and menu item for testing the update-available dialog. #### Sequence diagram for simulated update found updater flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor DevUser participant MacOSMenu participant UpdaterManager participant MainWindow participant Renderer_UpdateNotification DevUser->>MacOSMenu: Click dev.simulateUpdateFound menu item MacOSMenu->>UpdaterManager: simulateUpdateFound() UpdaterManager->>UpdaterManager: isDev check UpdaterManager->>UpdaterManager: create mockUpdateInfo UpdaterManager->>UpdaterManager: set downloading = false UpdaterManager->>UpdaterManager: set updateAvailable = true UpdaterManager->>UpdaterManager: setStage(checking) Note over UpdaterManager: internal stage is checking UpdaterManager-->>MainWindow: after 1s setStage(available, { updateInfo }) MainWindow-->>Renderer_UpdateNotification: broadcast updaterStateChanged Renderer_UpdateNotification->>Renderer_UpdateNotification: useWatchBroadcast(updaterStateChanged) Renderer_UpdateNotification->>Renderer_UpdateNotification: state.stage === available Renderer_UpdateNotification->>Renderer_UpdateNotification: setUpdateAvailable(true) Renderer_UpdateNotification->>Renderer_UpdateNotification: setUpdateDownloaded(false) Renderer_UpdateNotification->>Renderer_UpdateNotification: setUpdateInfo(updateInfo) Renderer_UpdateNotification-->>DevUser: Show update notification modal with Markdown release notes DevUser-->>Renderer_UpdateNotification: Click Download or Later buttons Renderer_UpdateNotification->>UpdaterManager: downloadUpdate() when Download clicked ``` #### Updated class diagram for updater manager and notification types ```mermaid classDiagram class UpdaterManager { - boolean downloading - boolean updateAvailable + simulateUpdateFound() + simulateUpdateAvailable() + setStage(stage) } class UpdateInfo { + string releaseDate + string | null | undefined releaseNotes + string version } class UpdaterStage { <> idle checking available downloading downloaded latest error } class UpdaterState { + UpdaterStage stage + string errorMessage + UpdateInfo updateInfo } class UpdateNotification { <> - boolean updateAvailable - boolean updateDownloaded - UpdateInfo updateInfo - boolean detailVisible - boolean isInstalling + useWatchBroadcast(eventName, handler) + renderMarkdownReleaseNotes() } UpdaterManager --> UpdaterState : updates UpdaterState --> UpdaterStage : uses UpdaterState --> UpdateInfo : holds UpdateNotification --> UpdaterState : subscribes via updaterStateChanged UpdateNotification --> UpdateInfo : displays UpdateNotification ..> UpdaterManager : triggers downloadUpdate ``` #### Flow diagram for updater stages including new available stage ```mermaid flowchart LR idle[[idle]] --> checking[[checking]] checking --> available[[available]] checking --> downloading[[downloading]] available --> downloading downloading --> downloaded[[downloaded]] downloaded --> latest[[latest]] checking --> error[[error]] downloading --> error subgraph Renderer_UpdateNotification available --> showPrompt["Show 'new version available' prompt with Markdown release notes"] downloaded --> showInstallPrompt["Show 'ready to install' prompt"] end subgraph DevSimulation simulateUpdateFound["simulateUpdateFound()"] --> checking checking --> delayedAvailable["setStage(available, updateInfo) after 1s"] --> available end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Render update release notes using a Markdown component instead of dangerouslySetInnerHTML. |
  • Replace dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage for release notes with a Markdown component guarded by a string type check.
  • Ensure both the normal update dialog and the dev-only simulated dialog share the same Markdown-based rendering container styling.
| `src/features/Electron/updater/UpdateNotification.tsx` | | Wire updater state broadcasts to show an "update available" dialog and support a new 'available' stage. |
  • Listen to the 'updaterStateChanged' broadcast and, when stage is 'available', mark the update as available, reset downloaded state, and hydrate updateInfo from the broadcast payload.
  • Extend the UpdaterStage union type to include a new 'available' stage used before downloading starts.
| `src/features/Electron/updater/UpdateNotification.tsx`
`packages/electron-client-ipc/src/types/update.ts` | | Add a dev-only simulate-update-found pathway to test the pre-download update-available prompt. |
  • Implement UpdaterManager.simulateUpdateFound() that logs, builds a mock UpdateInfo with Markdown release notes, toggles internal flags, and emits an 'available' stage after a short delay.
  • Expose the simulateUpdateFound() helper through a new macOS dev menu item under the updater simulation submenu with a localized label entry.

## Reviewer's Guide Adds comprehensive unit tests for the gateway service, covering Redis-backed BotConnectQueue behavior (enqueue, dequeue with expiry and error handling, removal) and GatewayManager lifecycle, bot start/stop logic, and singleton helpers using vitest with mocked external dependencies. ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add unit tests for GatewayManager lifecycle, bot management, and singleton helpers using mocked DB, key vault, and provider model. |
  • Mock getServerDB, KeyVaultsGateKeeper.initWithEnvKey, and AgentBotProviderModel to isolate GatewayManager behavior.
  • Verify constructor initializes isRunning=false and supports registry injection.
  • Test start() idempotency and resilience when initial DB sync fails while still marking manager as running.
  • Test stop() behavior when running and non-running, including stopping all active bots.
  • Cover startBot() paths for missing DB provider, unsupported platform, successful bot start and registration, restart semantics, and credentials merging.
  • Cover stopBot() paths for missing bot, successful stop/removal, and isolation between multiple bots.
  • Validate createGatewayManager/getGatewayManager implement a global singleton on globalThis and return consistent instances.
| `src/server/services/gateway/GatewayManager.test.ts` | | Add unit tests for BotConnectQueue Redis queue operations including enqueue, dequeue with expiry and malformed data handling, and removal. |
  • Mock getAgentRuntimeRedisClient to provide a fake Redis client with hset, hgetall, and hdel methods.
  • Test push() enqueues JSON payloads containing userId and timestamp, uses platform:applicationId hash field, and throws when Redis is unavailable.
  • Test popAll() returns empty lists for missing/empty Redis data and when Redis is unavailable.
  • Test popAll() parsing of valid entries into {platform, applicationId, userId} objects, including applicationIds containing colons and keys missing a separator.
  • Verify expired entries are filtered out based on timestamp and are removed via hdel, including batched deletion of multiple expired entries.
  • Ensure malformed JSON entries are treated as expired and cleaned up from Redis.

## Reviewer's Guide Adds the Qwen3.5 series chat models to the SiliconCloud provider with full capabilities metadata and pricing, and wires them into the Chinese models localization file. #### Flow diagram for SiliconCloud routing with new Qwen3_5 series models ```mermaid flowchart TD User[User] --> UI_ModelSelector[App UI model selector] UI_ModelSelector --> ModelBank[ModelBank siliconcloudChatModels] subgraph ModelBank A[qwen qwen3_5_397b_a17b] B[qwen qwen3_5_122b_a10b] C[qwen qwen3_5_35b_a3b] D[qwen qwen3_5_27b] E[qwen qwen3_5_9b] F[qwen qwen3_5_4b] end ModelBank -->|returns_selected_model_card_with_abilities_pricing_settings| UI_ModelSelector UI_ModelSelector --> ChatOrchestration[Chat orchestration layer] ChatOrchestration -->|use_model_id_and_extendParams_enableReasoning_reasoningBudgetToken| SiliconCloudAPI[SiliconCloud provider API] SiliconCloudAPI -->|responses_from_selected_Qwen3_5_model| ChatOrchestration ChatOrchestration --> UI_ModelSelector UI_ModelSelector --> User ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Register Qwen3.5 series multimodal chat models in the SiliconCloud model bank. |

  • Configure each model’s abilities to support function calling, reasoning, vision, and video, with a 256K context window and reasoning-related extendParams.
  • Set tiered CNY pricing for token input/output using lookup strategies for paid models and fixed zero-cost pricing for the 4B variant.
  • Assign release dates and detailed English descriptions for all new models, aligning structure with existing SiliconCloud model cards.

body:
## Reviewer's Guide Improves CLI login robustness and automatic browser launching (especially on Windows) by hardening JSON parsing, making browser invocation observable and reliable across platforms, and ensuring the OIDC device auth endpoint is publicly accessible in the Next proxy config, with accompanying tests for Windows executable resolution. #### Sequence diagram for improved CLI login and browser launch ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CLI as LoginCommand participant Auth as AuthServer participant Browser participant OS User->>CLI: run cli login CLI->>Auth: POST /oidc/device/auth Auth-->>CLI: 200 device_code response CLI->>CLI: parseJsonResponse for DeviceAuthResponse CLI->>Browser: openBrowser(verification_uri) Browser->>OS: request default handler for URL OS-->>Browser: launch system browser Browser-->>User: show verification page loop poll until authorized or timeout CLI->>Auth: POST /oidc/token Auth-->>CLI: JSON or error response CLI->>CLI: parseJsonResponse for TokenResponse alt success CLI-->>User: login successful else error or pending CLI->>CLI: sleep and retry end end ``` #### Sequence diagram for cross-platform browser command resolution ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Login as LoginCommand participant Open as openBrowser participant Resolver as resolveCommandExecutable participant FS as FileSystem participant Child as execFile Login->>Open: openBrowser(url) alt Windows Open->>Resolver: resolveCommandExecutable("rundll32", "win32") else macOS Open->>Resolver: resolveCommandExecutable("open", "darwin") else Linux Open->>Resolver: resolveCommandExecutable("xdg-open", "linux") end Resolver->>FS: existsSync over PATH entries FS-->>Resolver: first matching executable or undefined alt executable found Open->>Child: execFile(executable, [url]) Child-->>Open: success or error callback Open-->>Login: true on success, false on error else not found Open-->>Login: false end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Hardened HTTP JSON response handling in the CLI login flow to surface non-JSON/server-side issues more clearly. |
  • Introduced a reusable parseJsonResponse helper that wraps res.json() and throws a descriptive error when the response is not valid JSON, including status and content-type.
  • Replaced direct res.json() usage for the /oidc/device/auth call with parseJsonResponse.
  • Replaced direct res.json() usage for the /oidc/token polling call with parseJsonResponse to handle malformed responses.
| `apps/cli/src/commands/login.ts` | | Made automatic browser opening during CLI login more robust and testable across platforms, with special handling for Windows command resolution. |
  • Added resolveCommandExecutable to resolve an executable from PATH (and PATHEXT/SystemRoot on Windows), including support for explicit paths and fallback to System32 for built-in tools.
  • Refactored openBrowser into an async function that uses execFile via a shared runCommand helper, returns a boolean indicating success, and logs debug messages on failures or missing commands.
  • Updated the login command to await openBrowser and log a user-visible warning when the browser cannot be opened automatically.
  • Adjusted the browser-launch logic to use rundll32 on Windows and open/xdg-open on macOS/Linux while relying on resolveCommandExecutable for lookup.
| `apps/cli/src/commands/login.ts` | | Extended tests and proxy configuration to support the new behavior and ensure device auth endpoints are reachable. |
  • Added a unit test verifying that resolveCommandExecutable correctly resolves a Windows executable using PATH and PATHEXT, with environment variables stubbed and restored between tests.
  • Ensured test cleanup restores PATH, PATHEXT, and SystemRoot to their original values after each login command test suite run.
  • Updated Next proxy publicPaths to include the /oidc/device/auth endpoint so device authorization can be reached without authentication.
| `apps/cli/src/commands/login.test.ts`

## Reviewer's Guide Refactors the ChatInput zustand provider into a custom context/Provider with optional accessors so consumers like useAgentId can safely read from the store even when rendered outside a ChatInputProvider, and adds tests to cover the new fallback behavior. #### Sequence diagram for resolving agentId with optional ChatInputProvider ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor ReactComponent participant useAgentId participant useOptionalChatInputStore participant useAgentStore participant ChatInputStoreContext participant FALLBACK_STORE ReactComponent->>useAgentId: call useAgentId->>useOptionalChatInputStore: selector s => s.agentId useOptionalChatInputStore->>ChatInputStoreContext: read context value alt ChatInputProvider present ChatInputStoreContext-->>useOptionalChatInputStore: ChatInputStoreApi useOptionalChatInputStore->>ChatInputStoreApi: subscribe with selector ChatInputStoreApi-->>useOptionalChatInputStore: agentId useOptionalChatInputStore-->>useAgentId: agentId else ChatInputProvider missing ChatInputStoreContext-->>useOptionalChatInputStore: undefined useOptionalChatInputStore->>FALLBACK_STORE: subscribe with selector FALLBACK_STORE-->>useOptionalChatInputStore: agentIdFromFallback useOptionalChatInputStore-->>useAgentId: undefined (since no provider) end useAgentId->>useAgentStore: selector s => s.activeAgentId useAgentStore-->>useAgentId: activeAgentId alt agentIdFromChatInput is defined useAgentId-->>ReactComponent: agentIdFromChatInput else agentIdFromChatInput is undefined useAgentId-->>ReactComponent: activeAgentId end ``` #### Class diagram for updated ChatInput store hooks and Provider ```mermaid classDiagram class Store { } class ChatInputStoreApi { } class ChatInputStoreContext { +ChatInputStoreApi_or_undefined value } class FALLBACK_STORE { } class Provider { +props_children +props_createStore() } class useOptionalStoreApi { +invoke() ChatInputStoreApi_or_undefined } class useStoreApi { +invoke() ChatInputStoreApi } class useChatInputStore { +invoke() Store +invoke(selector, equalityFn) any } class useOptionalChatInputStore { +invoke() Store_or_undefined +invoke(selector, equalityFn) any_or_undefined } class useAgentStore { +getState() +setState(partialState) } class useAgentId { +invoke() string_or_undefined } Provider --> ChatInputStoreContext : provides Provider --> ChatInputStoreApi : creates useOptionalStoreApi --> ChatInputStoreContext : reads useStoreApi --> useOptionalStoreApi : uses useChatInputStore --> useStoreApi : uses useChatInputStore --> Store : selects_state useOptionalChatInputStore --> useOptionalStoreApi : uses useOptionalChatInputStore --> FALLBACK_STORE : falls_back_to useOptionalChatInputStore --> Store : selects_state useAgentId --> useOptionalChatInputStore : reads_agentId useAgentId --> useAgentStore : reads_activeAgentId ``` #### Flow diagram for useOptionalChatInputStore fallback behavior ```mermaid flowchart TD A[useOptionalChatInputStore called with selector and equalityFn] --> B[Read ChatInputStoreContext] B --> C{storeApi exists?} C -- Yes --> D[Use storeApi with selector via useStoreWithEqualityFn] C -- No --> E[Use FALLBACK_STORE with selector via useStoreWithEqualityFn] D --> F[Return selected value] E --> G[Return undefined to caller] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce a custom ChatInput store context with strict and optional hooks to avoid crashes when no provider is present. |
  • Replace the generic zustand context helper with an explicit React context for the ChatInput store, initialized as possibly undefined.
  • Define a typed Provider component that lazily creates and memoizes the ChatInput store via a createStore prop and exposes it through the new context.
  • Add useOptionalStoreApi and useStoreApi hooks, where the strict variant throws a clear error if used without a provider.
| `src/features/ChatInput/store/index.ts` | | Add safe selector hooks for accessing the ChatInput store with and without a provider, including a fallback store for the optional variant. |
  • Define UseChatInputStore and UseOptionalChatInputStore types with overloads for full-state and selector-based usage.
  • Implement useChatInputStore using the strict store API and useStoreWithEqualityFn with a default identity selector and shallow equality.
  • Implement useOptionalChatInputStore that reads from the optional store API, falls back to a local store instance when no provider is present, and returns undefined to callers in that case.
| `src/features/ChatInput/store/index.ts` | | Update useAgentId to use the optional ChatInput store so it can fall back to the global agent store when no provider is present. |
  • Switch from useChatInputStore to useOptionalChatInputStore when selecting agentId.
  • Preserve the behavior that an empty string agentId is treated as a valid value and only fall back to activeAgentId when the ChatInput agentId is undefined.
| `src/features/ChatInput/hooks/useAgentId.ts` | | Add regression tests for useAgentId to cover behavior with and without ChatInputProvider and for empty-string agent IDs. |
  • Introduce a test helper wrapper that provides a ChatInput store with a configurable initial agentId via the new Provider API.
  • Reset the global useAgentStore.activeAgentId state after each test to avoid cross-test pollution.
  • Add tests verifying fallback to activeAgentId without a provider, preference for provider agentId when present, and retention of empty-string agentId without fallback.
| `src/features/ChatInput/hooks/useAgentId.test.tsx` | ### Possibly linked issues - **#🐛 fix: ModelSwitchPanel crashes with zustand provider error when scrolling model list**: PR changes ChatInput store and useAgentId to safely handle missing provider, preventing the described ModelSwitchPanel crash. ---

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a full suite of CLI commands to manage LobeHub resources via the `lh` tool (search, knowledge base, memory, agents, sessions, topics, messages, models, providers, plugins, and user/config), centralizes shared formatting/confirmation utilities, and wires everything into the CLI entrypoint with comprehensive Vitest coverage for each new command. #### Sequence diagram for lh memory delete flow with confirmation and TRPC ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CLI as lh_memory_command participant Format as format_confirm participant API as getTrpcClient participant Router as userMemory_router User->>CLI: lh memory delete identity mem_123 CLI->>CLI: validateCategory(identity) alt confirmation_required CLI->>Format: confirm("Delete this identity memory?") Format-->>CLI: confirmed:boolean opt not_confirmed CLI-->>User: print("Cancelled.") CLI->>CLI: process_exit(0) end end CLI->>API: getTrpcClient() API-->>CLI: client CLI->>Router: deleteIdentity.mutate({id:"mem_123"}) Router-->>CLI: mutationResult CLI-->>User: print("✓ Deleted identity memory mem_123") ``` #### Sequence diagram for lh search unified search flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CLI as lh_search_command participant API as getTrpcClient participant Search as search_router participant Format as format_utils User->>CLI: lh search "vector db" --type agent -L 5 CLI->>CLI: validateType(agent) CLI->>API: getTrpcClient() API-->>CLI: client CLI->>Search: query({query:"vector db",type:"agent",limitPerType:5}) Search-->>CLI: results alt json_output CLI->>Format: outputJson(results,fields) Format-->>CLI: jsonPrinted else table_output CLI->>CLI: groupResultsByType(results) loop each_type CLI->>Format: printTable(rows,header) end end CLI-->>User: printed results ``` #### Class diagram for CLI command modules and shared formatting utilities ```mermaid classDiagram class Index { +registerAgentCommand(program) +registerConfigCommand(program) +registerConnectCommand(program) +registerDocCommand(program) +registerKbCommand(program) +registerLoginCommand(program) +registerLogoutCommand(program) +registerMemoryCommand(program) +registerMessageCommand(program) +registerModelCommand(program) +registerPluginCommand(program) +registerProviderCommand(program) +registerSearchCommand(program) +registerSessionCommand(program) +registerStatusCommand(program) +program_parse() } class FormatUtils { +timeAgo(date) +truncate(str,len) +printTable(rows,header) +pickFields(obj,fields) +outputJson(data,fields) +confirm(message) } class AgentCommand { +registerAgentCommand(program) -listAgents(options) -viewAgent(agentId,options) -createAgent(options) -editAgent(agentId,options) -deleteAgent(agentId,options) -duplicateAgent(agentId,options) } class SessionCommand { +registerSessionCommand(program) -listSessions(options) -searchSessions(keywords,options) -createSession(options) -editSession(id,options) -deleteSession(id,options) } class TopicCommand { +registerTopicCommand(program) -listTopics(options) -searchTopics(keywords,options) -createTopic(options) -editTopic(id,options) -deleteTopics(ids,options) -recentTopics(options) } class MessageCommand { +registerMessageCommand(program) -listMessages(options) -searchMessages(keywords,options) -deleteMessages(ids,options) -countMessages(options) -heatmap(options) } class KbCommand { +registerKbCommand(program) -listKnowledgeBases(options) -viewKnowledgeBase(id,options) -createKnowledgeBase(options) -editKnowledgeBase(id,options) -deleteKnowledgeBase(id,options) -addFiles(knowledgeBaseId,options) -removeFiles(knowledgeBaseId,options) -listFiles(options) } class MemoryCommand { +registerMemoryCommand(program) -listMemories(category,options) -createMemory(category,options) -editMemory(category,id,options) -deleteMemory(category,id,options) -viewPersona(options) -extractMemories(options) -extractStatus(options) -fetchCategory(client,category) -buildCategoryInput(category,options) } class ModelCommand { +registerModelCommand(program) -listModels(providerId,options) -viewModel(id,options) -toggleModel(id,options) -deleteModel(id,options) } class ProviderCommand { +registerProviderCommand(program) -listProviders(options) -viewProvider(id,options) -toggleProvider(id,options) -deleteProvider(id,options) } class PluginCommand { +registerPluginCommand(program) -listPlugins(options) -installPlugin(options) -uninstallPlugin(id,options) -updatePlugin(id,options) } class SearchCommand { +registerSearchCommand(program) -search(query,options) -renderResultGroup(type,items) } class ConfigCommand { +registerConfigCommand(program) -whoami(options) -usage(options) } Index --> AgentCommand : uses Index --> SessionCommand : uses Index --> TopicCommand : uses Index --> MessageCommand : uses Index --> KbCommand : uses Index --> MemoryCommand : uses Index --> ModelCommand : uses Index --> ProviderCommand : uses Index --> PluginCommand : uses Index --> SearchCommand : uses Index --> ConfigCommand : uses AgentCommand ..> FormatUtils SessionCommand ..> FormatUtils TopicCommand ..> FormatUtils MessageCommand ..> FormatUtils KbCommand ..> FormatUtils MemoryCommand ..> FormatUtils ModelCommand ..> FormatUtils ProviderCommand ..> FormatUtils PluginCommand ..> FormatUtils SearchCommand ..> FormatUtils ConfigCommand ..> FormatUtils ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Refactor shared CLI formatting and confirmation helpers into a reusable utility module and update existing commands to consume it. |
  • Extract time formatting, string truncation, table-printing, field-picking, JSON output, and confirmation prompt helpers into a dedicated utility file
  • Replace inlined helper implementations in the existing doc command with imports from the new utility module

## Reviewer's Guide Implements a new QQ bot platform with a WebSocket-based gateway, bounded inbound message processing, and integration into the existing agent/gateway/database/UI stack, including QQ-specific credential handling and webhook UI behavior. #### Sequence diagram for QQ inbound C2C message processing with bounded queues ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant QQGateway as QQ_Gateway participant QQBot as QQ participant InboundQueue as InboundQueueScheduler participant AiAgent as AiAgentService participant DB as Database participant QQAPI as QQ_REST_API QQGateway->>QQBot: WebSocket C2C_MESSAGE_CREATE QQBot->>QQBot: handleDispatch(type=C2C_MESSAGE_CREATE) QQBot->>InboundQueue: enqueueInboundTask(threadId="qq:c2c:{openid}") InboundQueue->>InboundQueue: check global/per-thread limits InboundQueue->>InboundQueue: drop oldest if per-thread overflow InboundQueue->>InboundQueue: drop new task if global overflow InboundQueue-->>QQBot: task queued InboundQueue->>InboundQueue: drainInboundQueue(threadId) InboundQueue->>QQBot: processInboundQueue(threadId) loop Serialized per platformThreadId QQBot->>QQBot: handleC2CMessage(event) QQBot->>AiAgent: executeAgent(platformThreadId, prompt) AiAgent->>DB: execAgent(...) DB-->>AiAgent: assistantMessageId, topicId AiAgent-->>QQBot: result(success, assistantMessageId) QQBot->>DB: waitForAssistantReply(assistantMessageId) loop Poll until content ready or timeout DB-->>QQBot: Message(content|error|LOADING_FLAT) end QQBot-->>QQBot: replyText QQBot->>QQAPI: POST /v2/users/{openid}/messages QQAPI-->>QQBot: 200 OK end QQBot-->>InboundQueue: queue empty, release thread slot ``` #### Sequence diagram for QQ gateway close code handling and reconnect ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant QQGateway as QQ_Gateway participant QQBot as QQ participant Timer as ReconnectTimer QQGateway--xQQBot: WebSocket close(code, reason) QQBot->>QQBot: on close QQBot->>QQBot: clearHeartbeatTimer() QQBot->>QQBot: ws = null alt Fatal close codes 4914/4915 QQBot-->>QQBot: stop reconnecting else Token invalid 4004 QQBot->>QQBot: resetTokenCache() QQBot->>Timer: scheduleReconnect() else Rate limited 4008 QQBot->>Timer: scheduleReconnect(delay=60000) else Session not resumable 4006/4007/4009/4900-4913 QQBot->>QQBot: clearSessionState() QQBot->>Timer: scheduleReconnect() else Other codes QQBot->>Timer: scheduleReconnect() end Timer-->>QQBot: reconnect timeout fires QQBot->>QQBot: reconnectAttempts++ QQBot->>QQBot: connectGateway() QQBot->>QQGateway: New WebSocket connection ``` #### Class diagram for QQ platform bot and related models ```mermaid classDiagram class PlatformBot { <> +String platform +String applicationId +start() Promise~void~ +stop() Promise~void~ } class QQBotConfig { +String agentId +String appId +String applicationId +String botToken +String clientSecret +String userId } class QQ { +String platform +String applicationId -Number accessTokenExpiresAt -String cachedAccessToken -Number reconnectAttempts -Number activeThreadCount -Boolean stopped -Map~String, InboundTask[]~ inboundQueues -Set~String~ processingThreads -Map~String, String~ threadTopicMap -Map~String, MessageReplyRecord~ messageReplyTracker -Map~String, MsgSeqRecord~ messageSeqTracker -WebSocket ws -start() Promise~void~ -stop() Promise~void~ -getAccessToken(forceRefresh Boolean) Promise~String~ -connectGateway() Promise~void~ -handleGatewayMessage(raw String) Promise~void~ -handleDispatch(type String, data any) Promise~void~ -enqueueInboundTask(threadId String, task InboundTask) void -processInboundQueue(threadId String) Promise~void~ -executeAgent(platformThreadId String, prompt String) Promise~String~ -sendC2CMessage(openid String, content String, replyToId String) Promise~void~ -sendGroupMessage(groupOpenid String, content String, replyToId String) Promise~void~ -apiRequest(method String, path String, body Record~String, any~, retryOnAuth Boolean) Promise~any~ } class InboundTask { +String eventId +run() Promise~void~ } class MessageReplyRecord { +Number count +Number firstReplyAt } class MsgSeqRecord { +Number seq +Number firstReplyAt } class AiAgentService { +AiAgentService(db any, userId String) +execAgent(params any) Promise~ExecResult~ } class MessageModel { +MessageModel(db any, userId String) +findById(id String) Promise~Message~ } class AgentBotProviderModel { +static findByPlatformAndAppId(db any, platform String, appId String) Promise~AgentBotProvider~ -static hasRequiredCredentials(platform String, credentials Record~String, String~) Boolean } PlatformBot <|.. QQ QQ --> QQBotConfig : uses QQ "1" o--> "*" InboundTask : inboundQueues QQ "1" o--> "*" MessageReplyRecord : messageReplyTracker QQ "1" o--> "*" MsgSeqRecord : messageSeqTracker QQ --> AiAgentService : calls QQ --> MessageModel : polls QQ --> AgentBotProviderModel : resolves context ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce QQ bot platform implementation with WebSocket gateway connection and robust lifecycle management. |
  • Add src/server/services/bot/platforms/qq.ts implementing QQ PlatformBot with token acquisition, gateway connect/resume/heartbeat, and close-code-specific reconnect handling.
  • Implement bounded inbound message queues keyed by platformThreadId with per-thread/global limits, controlled concurrency, and queue cleanup on start/stop.
  • Wire QQ platform into the platform bot registry and export it from the bot service index for use by the gateway.

body:
## Reviewer's Guide Adds a new `lh generate` CLI command group that supports text, image, video, TTS, and ASR generation via webapi and tRPC backends, including streaming SSE support for LLM completions, async task status listing, generation topic listing, and shared HTTP auth helpers, with comprehensive tests for all subcommands. #### Sequence diagram for lh generate text SSE streaming flow ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CLI as lh_generate_text participant Auth as getAuthInfo participant AuthSrv as Auth_backend participant WebAPI as webapi_chat_provider User->>CLI: run lh generate text [--model --system --pipe] CLI->>CLI: build messages, payload (stream=true by default) CLI->>Auth: getAuthInfo() Auth->>AuthSrv: getValidToken() AuthSrv-->>Auth: credentials {serverUrl, accessToken} Auth-->>CLI: {serverUrl, accessToken} CLI->>WebAPI: POST /webapi/chat/{provider} with payload + Oidc-Auth WebAPI-->>CLI: 200 OK, SSE response body alt non_streaming (--no-stream) CLI->>CLI: res.json() CLI->>User: write full completion (or JSON) else streaming loop until [DONE] CLI->>CLI: read chunk from ReadableStream CLI->>CLI: parse SSE line starting with data: alt JSON delta chunk CLI->>User: write delta.choices[0].delta.content else raw text chunk CLI->>User: write data line end end CLI->>User: final newline end ``` #### Sequence diagram for lh generate image/video async generation and status ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CLI as lh_generate_image_or_video participant TRPC as getTrpcClient participant Topic as generationTopic_router participant Media as image_or_video_router participant Status as generation_router User->>CLI: lh generate image [opts] CLI->>TRPC: getTrpcClient() TRPC-->>CLI: trpcClient CLI->>Topic: generationTopic.createTopic({type:image}) Topic-->>CLI: topicId CLI->>Media: image.createImage({generationTopicId, model, params, provider}) Media-->>CLI: {batch, generations[] with asyncTaskId} CLI->>User: print IDs, usage hint for lh generate status User->>CLI: lh generate video --model M --provider P CLI->>CLI: validate model and provider CLI->>TRPC: getTrpcClient() TRPC-->>CLI: trpcClient CLI->>Topic: generationTopic.createTopic({type:video}) Topic-->>CLI: topicId CLI->>Media: video.createVideo({generationTopicId, model, params, provider}) Media-->>CLI: {generationId} CLI->>User: print Generation ID and async notice User->>CLI: lh generate status CLI->>TRPC: getTrpcClient() TRPC-->>CLI: trpcClient CLI->>Status: generation.getGenerationStatus({generationId, asyncTaskId}) Status-->>CLI: {status, error?, generation?} CLI->>User: print colored status, error, asset.url, thumbnailUrl ``` #### Sequence diagram for lh generate tts/asr webapi flows ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CLI as lh_generate_tts_asr participant Auth as getAuthInfo participant AuthSrv as Auth_backend participant TTS as webapi_tts_backend participant STT as webapi_stt_openai User->>CLI: lh generate tts [--backend --output] CLI->>CLI: validate backend in {openai,microsoft,edge} CLI->>Auth: getAuthInfo() Auth->>AuthSrv: getValidToken() AuthSrv-->>Auth: {serverUrl, accessToken} Auth-->>CLI: {serverUrl, accessToken} CLI->>TTS: POST /webapi/tts/{backend} (JSON payload, Oidc-Auth) TTS-->>CLI: 200 OK, audio ArrayBuffer CLI->>CLI: convert to Buffer, writeFileSync(output) CLI->>User: print success with file size User->>CLI: lh generate asr [--model --language] alt file not found CLI->>User: log.error("File not found") CLI->>CLI: process.exit(1) else file exists CLI->>Auth: getAuthInfo() Auth->>AuthSrv: getValidToken() AuthSrv-->>Auth: {serverUrl, accessToken} Auth-->>CLI: {serverUrl, accessToken} CLI->>CLI: readFileAsBlob(audioFile) CLI->>STT: POST /webapi/stt/openai (FormData: speech + options, Oidc-Auth) STT-->>CLI: 200 OK, JSON {text,...} alt --json CLI->>User: print JSON else CLI->>User: write result.text end end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce `generate` CLI command with subcommands for text/image/video/tts/asr generation and task management. |
  • Register `registerGenerateCommand` in the CLI entrypoint to expose `lh generate` and alias `lh gen`.
  • Implement `generate text` to call `/webapi/chat/` using SSE streaming by default, with options for provider/model parsing, system prompt, temperature, max tokens, JSON output, and stdin piping.
  • Implement `generate image` to create a generation topic then call `trpc.image.createImage`, printing batch and async task IDs and supporting basic model/provider and image parametrization options.
  • Implement `generate video` to create a video generation topic then call `trpc.video.createVideo`, requiring explicit model/provider and accepting aspect ratio, duration, resolution, seed, and JSON output.
  • Implement `generate tts` to call `/webapi/tts/` (openai/microsoft/edge) with model/voice/speed parameters and write the audio buffer to a file.
  • Implement `generate asr` to POST multipart form-data with audio file and options to `/webapi/stt/openai` and print either raw JSON or extracted text.
  • Implement `generate status` to query `generation.getGenerationStatus` via tRPC and render colored status plus asset URLs.
  • Implement `generate list` to query `generationTopic.getAllGenerationTopics` and render a table or JSON with optional field selection.
| `apps/cli/src/index.ts`
`apps/cli/src/commands/generate.ts` | | Add shared HTTP authentication helper for CLI webapi calls. |
  • Create `getAuthInfo` helper that fetches a valid token via `getValidToken`, exits with an error if not authenticated, and normalizes the server URL by stripping trailing slashes.
  • Use `getAuthInfo` within text, TTS, and ASR subcommands to centralize retrieval of `serverUrl` and `accessToken` for webapi calls.
| `apps/cli/src/api/http.ts`
`apps/cli/src/commands/generate.ts` | | Add comprehensive tests for the `generate` command behaviors and integrations. |
  • Mock tRPC client routers (generation, generationTopic, image, video), HTTP auth helper, filesystem writes, and logger for isolation.
  • Test text generation subcommand for streaming SSE handling, non-streaming JSON response handling, provider extraction from `provider/model` strings, and error exit behavior.
  • Test image and video generation subcommands for correct tRPC calls, required argument validation, and user-facing output.
  • Test TTS subcommand for backend validation, webapi call, and file writing behavior, including invalid backend error paths.
  • Test ASR subcommand file-not-found behavior, generation status querying, and listing of generation topics including empty-state messaging.
| `apps/cli/src/commands/generate.test.ts` | ---

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a scoped flag to ModelSwitchPanel and its subcomponents to disable the model detail popup when used from the agent header, preventing crashes while keeping basic model switching behavior intact. #### Sequence diagram for header model switcher with disabled detail panel ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant HeaderTags as HeaderTitleTags participant ModelSwitchPanel participant PanelContent participant List participant ListItemRenderer participant MultipleProvidersModelItem participant ModelDetailPanel User->>HeaderTags: Hover ModelTag HeaderTags->>ModelSwitchPanel: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) ModelSwitchPanel->>PanelContent: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) PanelContent->>List: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) List->>ListItemRenderer: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) ListItemRenderer->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) MultipleProvidersModelItem-xModelDetailPanel: do_not_render_panel User->>ListItemRenderer: Click model item ListItemRenderer->>ModelSwitchPanel: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) activate ModelSwitchPanel ModelSwitchPanel-->>ListItemRenderer: onModelChange Promise resolved deactivate ModelSwitchPanel ListItemRenderer->>ListItemRenderer: onClose() ListItemRenderer-->>User: Menu closes, model switched Note over User,ModelDetailPanel: In ChatInput usage showModelDetailPanel=true and ModelDetailPanel renders on hover ``` #### Class diagram for ModelSwitchPanel and related components with showModelDetailPanel flag ```mermaid classDiagram class ModelSwitchPanel { +boolean openOnHover +boolean showModelDetailPanel +string model +string provider +render(children) } class PanelContent { +string model +string provider +boolean showModelDetailPanel +onModelChange(modelId, providerId) +onOpenChange(open) +render() } class List { +string model +string provider +string searchKeyword +boolean showModelDetailPanel +onModelChange(modelId, providerId) +onOpenChange(open) +render() } class ListItemRenderer { +string activeKey +object item +string newLabel +boolean showModelDetailPanel +onModelChange(modelId, providerId) +onClose() +renderMultipleProvidersItem() +renderSingleProviderItem() } class MultipleProvidersModelItem { +string activeKey +object data +string newLabel +boolean showModelDetailPanel +onModelChange(modelId, providerId) +onClose() +render() } class ModelDetailPanel { +string model +string provider +render() } class HeaderTitleTags { +render() } ModelSwitchPanel --> PanelContent : passes_showModelDetailPanel PanelContent --> List : passes_showModelDetailPanel List --> ListItemRenderer : passes_showModelDetailPanel ListItemRenderer --> MultipleProvidersModelItem : passes_showModelDetailPanel MultipleProvidersModelItem --> ModelDetailPanel : conditionally_renders_when_showModelDetailPanel_true HeaderTitleTags --> ModelSwitchPanel : showModelDetailPanel_false_in_header_context ModelSwitchPanel --> ModelSwitchPanel : showModelDetailPanel_true_default_in_ChatInput_context ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce a showModelDetailPanel flag throughout the model switch panel stack to conditionally disable the detail/config popup while preserving model selection behavior. |
  • Extend ListItemRenderer, MultipleProvidersModelItem, List, PanelContent, and ModelSwitchPanel props with an optional showModelDetailPanel boolean defaulting to true
  • Short‑circuit list item rendering when showModelDetailPanel is false to render a simple clickable row that directly triggers onModelChange and closes the panel, without opening submenus or detail panels
  • Guard ModelDetailPanel rendering in MultipleProvidersModelItem with showModelDetailPanel so the detail popup is omitted when disabled
  • Propagate showModelDetailPanel from ModelSwitchPanel down through PanelContent and List to all relevant item renderers
  • Update the agent conversation header TitleTags to render ModelSwitchPanel with showModelDetailPanel set to false
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/ListItemRenderer.tsx`
`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/MultipleProvidersModelItem.tsx`

`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/PanelContent.tsx`
`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/index.tsx`

model switching, and tidies related async handlers. #### Sequence diagram for header ModelSwitchPanel with disabled detail popup ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant HeaderTitleTags participant ModelSwitchPanel participant PanelContent participant List participant ListItemRenderer participant MultipleProvidersModelItem User->>HeaderTitleTags: Open agent conversation HeaderTitleTags->>ModelSwitchPanel: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) ModelSwitchPanel->>PanelContent: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) PanelContent->>List: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) List->>ListItemRenderer: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) ListItemRenderer->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: render(showModelDetailPanel=false) User->>ModelSwitchPanel: hover trigger ModelSwitchPanel->>PanelContent: open panel PanelContent->>List: display model list User->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: hover model item MultipleProvidersModelItem--xMultipleProvidersModelItem: do not render ModelDetailPanel (flag=false) User->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: click provider entry MultipleProvidersModelItem->>ListItemRenderer: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) ListItemRenderer->>List: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) List->>PanelContent: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) PanelContent->>ModelSwitchPanel: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) ModelSwitchPanel-->>HeaderTitleTags: model updated MultipleProvidersModelItem->>ListItemRenderer: onClose() ListItemRenderer->>List: onClose() List->>PanelContent: onOpenChange(false) PanelContent->>ModelSwitchPanel: onOpenChange(false) ``` #### Sequence diagram for ChatInput ModelSwitchPanel with enabled detail popup ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ChatInput participant ModelSwitchPanel participant PanelContent participant List participant ListItemRenderer participant MultipleProvidersModelItem participant ModelDetailPanel User->>ChatInput: Focus chat input ChatInput->>ModelSwitchPanel: render(showModelDetailPanel=true) ModelSwitchPanel->>PanelContent: render(showModelDetailPanel=true) PanelContent->>List: render(showModelDetailPanel=true) List->>ListItemRenderer: render(showModelDetailPanel=true) ListItemRenderer->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: render(showModelDetailPanel=true) User->>ModelSwitchPanel: hover trigger ModelSwitchPanel->>PanelContent: open panel PanelContent->>List: display model list User->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: hover model item MultipleProvidersModelItem->>ModelDetailPanel: render with model, provider User->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: click provider entry MultipleProvidersModelItem->>ListItemRenderer: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) ListItemRenderer->>List: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) List->>PanelContent: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) PanelContent->>ModelSwitchPanel: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) ModelSwitchPanel-->>ChatInput: model updated MultipleProvidersModelItem->>ListItemRenderer: onClose() ListItemRenderer->>List: onClose() List->>PanelContent: onOpenChange(false) PanelContent->>ModelSwitchPanel: onOpenChange(false) ``` #### Class diagram for updated ModelSwitchPanel showModelDetailPanel propagation ```mermaid classDiagram class ModelSwitchPanel { +string model +string provider +boolean openOnHover +boolean showModelDetailPanel } class PanelContent { +string model +string provider +boolean showModelDetailPanel +onModelChange(model, provider) +onOpenChange(open) } class List { +string model +string provider +string searchKeyword +boolean showModelDetailPanel +onModelChange(model, provider) +onOpenChange(open) } class ListItemRenderer { +string activeKey +item item +string newLabel +boolean showModelDetailPanel +onModelChange(model, provider) +onClose() } class MultipleProvidersModelItem { +string activeKey +data data +string newLabel +boolean showModelDetailPanel +onModelChange(model, provider) +onClose() } class ModelDetailPanel { +string model +string provider } class HeaderTitleTags { +render() } ModelSwitchPanel --> PanelContent : passes showModelDetailPanel PanelContent --> List : passes showModelDetailPanel List --> ListItemRenderer : passes showModelDetailPanel ListItemRenderer --> MultipleProvidersModelItem : passes showModelDetailPanel MultipleProvidersModelItem --> ModelDetailPanel : conditionally renders when showModelDetailPanel HeaderTitleTags ..> ModelSwitchPanel : creates with showModelDetailPanel=false ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce a `showModelDetailPanel` flag through ModelSwitchPanel and its list/rendering components to optionally disable the model detail popup, and wire it off for the agent header switcher. |
  • Extend ModelSwitchPanel, PanelContent, List, ListItemRenderer, and MultipleProvidersModelItem props with an optional `showModelDetailPanel` boolean defaulting to true.
  • Guard detail popup/submenu rendering paths in list item components so that when `showModelDetailPanel` is false, items render as simple clickable rows that only switch models and close the menu.
  • Pass `showModelDetailPanel` from the top-level ModelSwitchPanel down to PanelContent and List so different entry points can choose whether to show the detail popup.
  • Update the agent conversation header TitleTags to use ModelSwitchPanel with `showModelDetailPanel={false}` so hovering there no longer opens the detail/config popup.

body:
Thanks for the review! Just to clarify on both points:

1. **Empty `chatModels` in the provider card** — this is intentional and follows the same pattern as OpenRouter, SambaNova, and other OpenAI-compatible providers in the codebase. The provider card sets `chatModels: []` because it relies on the model fetcher (`showModelFetcher: true`) to populate models dynamically. The curated model list in `aiModels/tensorix.ts` provides the defaults that get merged into `LOBE_DEFAULT_MODEL_LIST`, which is how the other providers handle it too.

2. **Base URL in two places** — again this matches the existing pattern (e.g. SambaNova has `placeholder: 'https://api.sambanova.ai/v1'` in the provider card and `baseURL: 'https://api.sambanova.ai/v1'` in the runtime). They serve different purposes — the provider card one is a UI placeholder for the proxy URL field, while the runtime one is the actual default endpoint. Happy to centralize if the team prefers, but wanted to stay consistent with what's already there.

body:
Updated the PR with a more targeted fix that directly addresses the fork failure in the tRPC handlers.

## What Changed

Previously, this PR wrapped telemetry calls in try-catch. The new approach is more surgical:

**Instead of catching all telemetry errors**, we now:
1. Detect when the central marketplace returns 401/403 during fork registration
2. Return a mock success response to allow the local fork to proceed
3. Only affects the fork operation when auth fails (expected in self-hosted mode)

## Why This Approach is Better

1. **Targeted**: Only handles the specific case of auth failure during fork, not all telemetry
2. **Transparent**: Logs clearly state "Fork registration failed due to auth (expected in self-hosted mode)"
3. **Safe**: Doesn't hide other errors — only 401/403 auth failures are handled gracefully
4. **Minimal**: 32 lines added, no deletions, surgical changes to 2 files

## Testing
- Verified TypeScript syntax with `node -c`
- Follows existing error handling patterns in the codebase
- Fork will now work in self-hosted mode even when marketplace auth fails

  • Updated explanatory comments in the OAuth consent interaction page to describe interaction details, supported prompts, client metadata handling, and error handling in English.
  • Rewrote comments in the OIDC catch-all route to explain the response collector, provider initialization, Node request/response adapter, and final response status access.
  • Clarified JSDoc and inline comments in the market OIDC callback page to describe the purpose of the page, how it handles success/error, and how it communicates with the opener window and closes itself.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Updates Next.js Vercel deployment config to explicitly include both the hoisted symlink and the pnpm store path for the ffmpeg-static binary in output file tracing for the video webhook route, preventing ENOENT errors at runtime. #### Sequence diagram for video webhook invoking ffmpeg with correct traced binary ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant VercelEdge participant ApiWebhooksVideo participant NodeSpawn participant FileSystem User->>VercelEdge: HTTP POST /api/webhooks/video VercelEdge->>ApiWebhooksVideo: Invoke lambda ApiWebhooksVideo->>NodeSpawn: spawn ffmpeg NodeSpawn->>FileSystem: resolve ffmpeg-static binary FileSystem-->>NodeSpawn: binary found in traced bundle NodeSpawn-->>ApiWebhooksVideo: child process handle ApiWebhooksVideo-->>VercelEdge: 200 OK (video processing started) VercelEdge-->>User: Response ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Ensure ffmpeg-static binary is correctly bundled for the video webhook serverless function under pnpm on Vercel. |
  • Extended the outputFileTracingIncludes entry for the /api/webhooks/video/* route to include the pnpm virtual store path glob for the ffmpeg-static binary in addition to the existing hoisted symlink path
  • Kept the existing ffmpeg-static symlink path so both the symlink and actual binary are traced and bundled
| `next.config.ts` |
---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adjusts the Docker release GitHub Actions workflow to correctly filter out v-prefixed tags when creating a manifest list, ensuring only non-v-prefixed versions and latest are included. ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Fix jq tag filtering logic in Docker manifest creation step to exclude v-prefixed tags from the manifest list. |
  • Introduce a TAGS variable populated via jq that filters .tags with test(":v\\d") | not to remove v-prefixed tags from full image references.
  • Change the docker buildx imagetools create invocation to use the TAGS variable instead of inlining the jq expression.
  • Add an inline comment (in Chinese) documenting that v-prefixed tags (e.g., lobehub/lobehub:v2.1.29) are filtered out, preserving only non-v-prefixed versions and latest.
| `.github/workflows/release-docker.yml` |
---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Switches the default Grok/XAI chat integration to use the Responses API directly via runtime configuration, simplifies Grok-specific routing logic, and cleans up now-unneeded model metadata flags. #### Sequence diagram for XAI Grok chat using Responses API by default ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Developer participant App as ApplicationCode participant Runtime as LobeXAI participant Core as OpenAICompatibleRuntime participant XAI as XAI_API Developer->>App: callChat(model, messages) App->>Runtime: chatCompletion(payload) Runtime->>Core: chatCompletion({ model, messages, ... }) Note over Core: chatCompletion.useResponse = true Core->>Core: buildResponsesRequest(payload) Core->>XAI: POST /v1/responses XAI-->>Core: responses stream Core-->>Runtime: normalizedResponseStream Runtime-->>App: ChatCompletionResult App-->>Developer: renderAssistantReply ``` #### Updated class diagram for XAI runtime and provider configuration ```mermaid classDiagram class OpenAICompatibleRuntimeConfig { +string baseURL +ChatCompletionConfig chatCompletion +ImageConfig createImage +DebugConfig debug +function models(options) } class ChatCompletionConfig { +bool useResponse } class DebugConfig { +function responses() } class LobeXAI { <> } class ModelProviderCard { +string id +string name +string url +Config config } class Config { +string apiKey +string baseURL +string sdkType +bool showModelFetcher } class XAIProviderCard { <> } OpenAICompatibleRuntimeConfig --> ChatCompletionConfig : has OpenAICompatibleRuntimeConfig --> DebugConfig : has LobeXAI --> OpenAICompatibleRuntimeConfig : createdWith ModelProviderCard --> Config : has XAIProviderCard --|> ModelProviderCard : extends ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Configure LobeXAI to always use the Responses API for chat completions instead of dynamically switching between streaming chat completions and Responses based on model and flags. |

  • Remove Grok-specific branching that previously toggled between streaming chat completions and the Responses API based on model capabilities and enabledSearch flag.
  • Retain image creation support and centralize it alongside the chatCompletion configuration.
  • Simplify debug configuration to only expose the responses debug flag.

body:
Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adjusts ffmpeg binary resolution and Next.js output file tracing configuration so that on Vercel with pnpm the runtime ffmpeg path matches the hoisted binary path, avoiding ENOENT errors for video webhooks. #### Sequence diagram for ffmpeg path resolution with pnpm on Vercel ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor VercelRuntime participant ApiRoute as Api_route_video_provider participant VideoService as video_service participant FfmpegPath as getFfmpegPath participant NodeFS as fs VercelRuntime->>ApiRoute: HTTP request to /api/webhooks/video/provider ApiRoute->>VideoService: processVideo() VideoService->>FfmpegPath: getFfmpegPath() alt cached path FfmpegPath-->>VideoService: _ffmpegPath else resolve path FfmpegPath->>NodeFS: require(ffmpeg_static) NodeFS-->>FfmpegPath: resolved_virtual_store_path FfmpegPath->>NodeFS: existsSync(resolved_virtual_store_path) alt virtual store path exists FfmpegPath-->>VideoService: resolved_virtual_store_path else fallback to hoisted path FfmpegPath->>FfmpegPath: join(cwd, node_modules, ffmpeg_static, ffmpeg) FfmpegPath-->>VideoService: hoisted_ffmpeg_path end end VideoService->>NodeFS: spawn(ffmpeg, args) using resolved path NodeFS-->>VideoService: ffmpeg execution VideoService-->>ApiRoute: processing result ApiRoute-->>VercelRuntime: HTTP response ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Harden ffmpeg binary path resolution at runtime to handle pnpm/Vercel virtual store vs hoisted path mismatch. |
  • Introduce a cached local variable to store the resolved ffmpeg path while keeping the memoization behavior.
  • Resolve ffmpeg-static via require, then verify the returned path with existsSync before using it.
  • If the resolved path does not exist (pnpm virtual store case), fall back to constructing the hoisted path under process.cwd()/node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg.
  • Document the Vercel ffmpeg-on-vercel reference and the pnpm-specific behavior in comments for future maintainers.
| `src/server/services/generation/video.ts` | | Align Next.js output file tracing configuration with the hoisted ffmpeg-static binary path only. |
  • Simplify outputFileTracingIncludes for the video webhook API route to include only the hoisted ffmpeg-static binary path.
  • Remove the explicit inclusion of the pnpm virtual store ffmpeg-static path, relying on the runtime fallback logic instead.
  • Add a reference comment to the vercel-labs/ffmpeg-on-vercel example for the updated tracing configuration.

  • Remove the explicit inclusion of the pnpm virtual store ffmpeg-static path, relying on the runtime fallback logic instead.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adds a new SQL migration to enable the PostgreSQL pg_search extension and registers it in the migrations journal, preparing the database for future search-related features. #### Sequence diagram for enabling pg_search extension during app startup ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Operator participant Application participant MigrationRunner participant PostgreSQL Operator->>Application: start Application->>MigrationRunner: run_pending_migrations() MigrationRunner->>PostgreSQL: check_applied_migrations() PostgreSQL-->>MigrationRunner: list_of_migrations MigrationRunner->>PostgreSQL: execute 0089_enable_pg_search.sql PostgreSQL-->>MigrationRunner: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_search MigrationRunner->>PostgreSQL: record_migration_in_journal(0089_enable_pg_search) PostgreSQL-->>MigrationRunner: ok MigrationRunner-->>Application: migrations_complete Application-->>Operator: ready_with_pg_search_enabled ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Introduce a migration that enables the pg_search PostgreSQL extension if it is available. |
  • Create a new custom SQL migration that runs CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_search
  • Ensure the migration is idempotent so it can safely run on databases where the extension is already installed
| `packages/database/migrations/0089_enable_pg_search.sql` | | Register the new migration in the migration journal so it is executed in sequence with existing migrations. |
  • Append the new migration entry to the migration metadata journal to maintain correct migration ordering and tracking
| `packages/database/migrations/meta/_journal.json` |
