## Reviewer's Guide Adds a comprehensive Vitest unit test suite for ServerSandboxService, covering callTool and exportAndUploadFile behavior across success paths, error handling, and edge cases with mocked external dependencies. #### Sequence diagram for ServerSandboxService.exportAndUploadFile interaction ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant ServerSandboxService participant FileS3 participant MarketService participant FileService participant Caller ServerSandboxService->>FileS3: new FileS3() ServerSandboxService->>FileS3: createPreSignedUrl(s3Key) alt S3 URL created FileS3-->>ServerSandboxService: uploadUrl ServerSandboxService->>FileS3: getFileMetadata(s3Key) FileS3-->>ServerSandboxService: { contentLength, contentType } ServerSandboxService->>MarketService: exportFile({ path, topicId, uploadUrl, userId }) alt exportFile returns success MarketService-->>ServerSandboxService: { success: true, data: { result } } alt sandbox upload success ServerSandboxService-->>ServerSandboxService: choose mimeType(result.mimeType, metadata.contentType, application/octet-stream) ServerSandboxService->>FileService: createFileRecord({ name, url: s3Key, size: contentLength, fileType: mimeType }) FileService-->>ServerSandboxService: { fileId, url } ServerSandboxService-->>Caller: { success: true, fileId, filename, url, size, mimeType } else sandbox upload failed ServerSandboxService-->>ServerSandboxService: derive message (default Failed to upload file from sandbox) ServerSandboxService-->>Caller: { success: false, filename, error: { message } } end else exportFile returns failure MarketService-->>ServerSandboxService: { success: false, error } ServerSandboxService-->>ServerSandboxService: derive message (default Failed to export file from sandbox) ServerSandboxService-->>Caller: { success: false, filename, error: { message } } end else createPreSignedUrl throws FileS3--xServerSandboxService: throws Error ServerSandboxService-->>ServerSandboxService: catch error ServerSandboxService-->>Caller: { success: false, filename, error: { message } } end ``` #### Class diagram for ServerSandboxService and collaborators under test ```mermaid classDiagram class ServerSandboxService { - fileService FileService - marketService MarketService - topicId string - userId string + ServerSandboxService(fileService FileService, marketService MarketService, topicId string, userId string) + callTool(toolName string, params any) SandboxToolCallResult + exportAndUploadFile(path string, filename string) SandboxExportUploadResult } class FileService { + createFileRecord(params FileRecordParams) FileRecordResult } class MarketService { + getSDK() MarketSDK + exportFile(params ExportFileParams) ExportFileResponse } class MarketSDK { + plugins Plugins } class Plugins { + runBuildInTool(toolName string, params any, context ToolContext) ToolResponse } class FileS3 { + FileS3() + createPreSignedUrl(key string) string + getFileMetadata(key string) FileMetadata } class FileMetadata { + contentLength number + contentType string } class FileRecordParams { + name string + url string + size number + fileType string } class FileRecordResult { + fileId string + url string } class SandboxToolCallResult { + success boolean + result any + sessionExpiredAndRecreated boolean + error SandboxError } class SandboxExportUploadResult { + success boolean + filename string + fileId string + url string + size number + mimeType string + error SandboxError } class SandboxError { + name string + message string } class ExportFileParams { + path string + topicId string + uploadUrl string + userId string } class ExportFileResponse { + success boolean + data ExportFileData + error SandboxError } class ExportFileData { + result ExportFileResult } class ExportFileResult { + success boolean + mimeType string + error string } class ToolContext { + topicId string + userId string } class ToolResponse { + success boolean + data ToolData + error SandboxError } class ToolData { + result any + sessionExpiredAndRecreated boolean } ServerSandboxService --> FileService ServerSandboxService --> MarketService ServerSandboxService --> FileS3 MarketService --> MarketSDK MarketSDK --> Plugins Plugins --> ToolResponse MarketService --> ExportFileResponse FileS3 --> FileMetadata FileService --> FileRecordResult ExportFileResponse --> ExportFileData ExportFileData --> ExportFileResult ToolResponse --> ToolData SandboxToolCallResult --> SandboxError SandboxExportUploadResult --> SandboxError ExportFileResponse --> SandboxError ToolResponse --> SandboxError ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add unit tests for ServerSandboxService callTool behavior, including success, failure, and error edge cases. |
  • Instantiate ServerSandboxService with mocked marketService and fileService dependencies in a node Vitest environment.
  • Mock marketService.getSDK().plugins.runBuildInTool to return various success and failure payloads, including session recreation flags and missing error fields.
  • Verify that callTool forwards tool name, payload, and topic/user context correctly to runBuildInTool.
  • Assert normalized success responses including sessionExpiredAndRecreated defaulting behavior when missing from data.
  • Assert normalized failure responses for API-indicated errors and for thrown/rejected errors, including defaulting error messages when absent.
| `src/server/services/sandbox/index.test.ts` | | Add unit tests for exportAndUploadFile behavior, including S3 integration, mime-type resolution, and error handling. |
  • Mock debug, js-sha256, and FileS3 to control side effects and S3 behavior, including pre-signed URL generation and metadata lookup.
  • Test happy path where exportFile succeeds, sandbox upload succeeds, S3 metadata is read, and fileService.createFileRecord returns a fileId/url, asserting the full success payload shape.
  • Verify exportFile is called with the expected path, topicId, userId, and S3 uploadUrl derived from createPreSignedUrl.
  • Cover mimeType resolution precedence (result.mimeType, metadata contentType, and application/octet-stream fallback).
  • Cover error paths for exportFile failure, sandbox upload failure (result.success=false), thrown errors (e.g., S3 failure), and missing error messages with appropriate default messages.
  • Verify S3 key generation format (date-based sharding with topicId and filename) and that createFileRecord receives the correct URL, name, fileType, and size metadata.

## Reviewer's Guide Propagates activated skill context from chat messages through step context into the skills execution pipeline so execScript can automatically receive all activated skills, deprecating the old single-skill config parameter and updating manifests and runtime wiring accordingly. #### Sequence diagram for activated skill propagation into execScript ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant StreamingExecutorActionImpl as StreamingExecutor participant DbMessageSelectors as DbSelectors participant StepContextComputer as StepContext participant SkillsExecutor as SkillsExec participant SkillsExecutionRuntime as SkillsRuntime participant SkillRuntimeService as SkillService participant CloudSandboxService as CloudSandbox StreamingExecutor->>DbSelectors: selectActivatedSkillsFromMessages(currentDBMessages) DbSelectors-->>StreamingExecutor: StepActivatedSkill[] activatedSkills StreamingExecutor->>StepContext: computeStepContext(activatedSkills, activatedToolIds, todos) StepContext-->>StreamingExecutor: RuntimeStepContext stepContext StreamingExecutor->>SkillsExec: execute(params, ctx(stepContext)) SkillsExec->>SkillsRuntime: execScript(ExecScriptParams with activatedSkills from ctx.stepContext) SkillsRuntime->>SkillService: execScript(command, options(activatedSkills, config, description)) SkillService->>CloudSandbox: callTool(execScript, {activatedSkills, command, config, description}) CloudSandbox-->>SkillService: BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput result SkillService-->>SkillsRuntime: BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput result SkillsRuntime-->>SkillsExec: BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput result SkillsExec-->>StreamingExecutor: ExecuteResult with content and state ``` #### Class diagram for updated skill context and execScript types ```mermaid classDiagram class StepActivatedSkill { +string id +string name +string description } class RuntimeStepContext { +StepActivatedSkill[] activatedSkills +string[] activatedToolIds +StepContextTodos todos } class ExecScriptActivatedSkill { +string id +string name +string description } class ExecScriptParams { +ExecScriptActivatedSkill[] activatedSkills +string command +string description +ExecScriptConfig config } class ExecScriptConfig { +string id +string name +string description } class ComputeStepContextParams { +StepActivatedSkill[] activatedSkills +string[] activatedToolIds +StepContextTodos todos } class SkillsExecutionRuntime { +SkillRuntimeService service +execScript(args ExecScriptParams) BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput } class SkillRuntimeService { +execScript(command string, options SkillExecScriptOptions) Promise~BuiltinServerRuntimeOutput~ } class SkillExecScriptOptions { +ExecScriptActivatedSkill[] activatedSkills +ExecScriptConfig config +string description } class SkillsExecutor { +runtime SkillsExecutionRuntime +execute(params ExecScriptParams, ctx SkillsExecutorContext) Promise~ExecuteResult~ } class SkillsExecutorContext { +RuntimeStepContext stepContext } class DbMessageSelectors { +selectActivatedSkillsFromMessages(messages UIChatMessage[]) StepActivatedSkill[] } class StreamingExecutorActionImpl { +buildStepContext(messages UIChatMessage[]) RuntimeStepContext } StepActivatedSkill <|-- ExecScriptActivatedSkill ExecScriptParams o-- ExecScriptActivatedSkill ExecScriptParams o-- ExecScriptConfig ComputeStepContextParams o-- StepActivatedSkill RuntimeStepContext o-- StepActivatedSkill SkillsExecutionRuntime o-- SkillRuntimeService SkillRuntimeService o-- SkillExecScriptOptions SkillExecScriptOptions o-- ExecScriptActivatedSkill SkillsExecutor o-- SkillsExecutionRuntime SkillsExecutorContext o-- RuntimeStepContext StreamingExecutorActionImpl ..> DbMessageSelectors StreamingExecutorActionImpl ..> ComputeStepContextParams StreamingExecutorActionImpl ..> RuntimeStepContext DbMessageSelectors ..> StepActivatedSkill SkillsExecutor ..> ExecScriptParams SkillsExecutionRuntime ..> ExecScriptParams ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Accumulate activated skills from chat messages and expose them via the step context. |

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a regression test to ensure convertOpenAIResponseInputs preserves message/content ordering when async image URL-to-base64 conversion completes out of order. #### Sequence diagram for async image handling in convertOpenAIResponseInputs ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Tester participant TestCase as OpenAIOrderRegressionTest participant Converter as convertOpenAIResponseInputs participant ImageConv as imageUrlToBase64 Tester->>TestCase: run TestCase->>Converter: convertOpenAIResponseInputs(messages) note over Converter: Build per_message_items for message[0] Converter->>ImageConv: imageUrlToBase64(slow_image_url) note over ImageConv: Simulated delay note over Converter: Build per_message_items for message[1] Converter-->>Converter: add assistant text item ImageConv-->>Converter: base64String Converter-->>Converter: replace image_url with input_image Converter-->>Converter: Promise.all on per_message_items Converter-->>TestCase: flattened inputs TestCase-->>Tester: verify order preserved ``` #### Class diagram for OpenAI message conversion ordering ```mermaid classDiagram class OpenAIChatMessage { <> string role any content } class ConvertOpenAIResponseInputsModule { +convertOpenAIResponseInputs(messages) } class ImageConversionModule { +imageUrlToBase64(url) +parseDataUri(dataUri) } OpenAIChatMessage "*" --> ConvertOpenAIResponseInputsModule : input ConvertOpenAIResponseInputsModule --> ImageConversionModule : uses ConvertOpenAIResponseInputsModule ..> OpenAIChatMessage : produces ordered inputs ``` #### Flow diagram for stabilized Responses API input construction ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Start convertOpenAIResponseInputs] --> B[Initialize per_message_items as empty array] B --> C[For each message in messages] C --> D[Initialize items_for_message as empty array] D --> E[For each content part in message] E --> F{content type?} F --> G[Text part: push input_text to items_for_message] F --> H[Image part: enqueue async imageUrlToBase64 and push promise to items_for_message] F --> I[Other part: push mapped item to items_for_message] G --> J[Finish content loop] H --> J I --> J J --> K[Append items_for_message to per_message_items] K --> L{More messages?} L --> C L --> M[Await Promise.all over all async image conversions] M --> N[Flatten per_message_items preserving original message/content order] N --> O[Return final inputs] O --> P[End] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add regression test covering async image conversion and input ordering preservation. |
  • Mocks parseDataUri to force URL-based handling without embedded base64 data.

  • Asserts that the converted Responses API input preserves the original per-message content ordering (text then image, and message order) and restores related environment variable after the test.

## Reviewer's Guide Preloads cloned bundled i18n resources synchronously for the default and initial languages, configures React/i18next to avoid Suspense while still re-rendering when backend translations arrive, and adds a unit test to verify synchronous init with subsequent background reload of the target language namespaces. #### Sequence diagram for synchronous i18n init and background language reload ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ReactComponent participant I18nFactory as createI18nNext participant I18nInstance as i18next_instance participant Loader as loadI18nNamespaceModule participant Backend as translation_backend User->>ReactComponent: open_app_with_lang_zh_CN ReactComponent->>I18nFactory: createI18nNext("zh-CN") I18nFactory-->>ReactComponent: { instance, init } ReactComponent->>I18nFactory: init({ initAsync: false }) I18nFactory->>I18nInstance: init({ resources: { en_US: cloned_bundled_resources, zh_CN: cloned_bundled_resources }, lng: zh_CN, ns: [], react: { bindI18nStore: added, useSuspense: false }, partialBundledLanguages: true }) I18nInstance-->>I18nFactory: initPromise (sync_init_complete) I18nFactory-->>ReactComponent: initPromise Note over ReactComponent,I18nInstance: React renders immediately using cloned bundled zh_CN resources I18nFactory->>I18nInstance: reloadResources([zh_CN], [chat, common, error]) loop for_each_namespace in [chat, common, error] I18nInstance->>Loader: loadI18nNamespaceModule({ lng: zh_CN, ns: namespace }) Loader->>Backend: fetch_translation_bundle(zh_CN, namespace) Backend-->>Loader: translation_json Loader-->>I18nInstance: { default: translation_json } I18nInstance-->>I18nInstance: update_resource_bundle(zh_CN, namespace) end I18nInstance-->>ReactComponent: i18nStore_changed_event ReactComponent-->>User: rerender_with_real_zh_CN_translations ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Preload cloned bundled resources for default and non-default languages during i18n initialization and trigger background reload of the target language. |
  • Introduce a factory to create fresh copies of bundled namespaces to prevent shared mutation across languages.
  • Build a resources map that always includes the default language and conditionally includes the initial language with cloned bundles.
  • Initialize i18next with these resources, an explicit empty namespace list, and a normalized initial language value.
  • After init completes for non-default languages, call reloadResources for the initial language and all bundled namespaces so backend translations overwrite the bundled fallbacks.
| `src/locales/create.ts` | | Configure React/i18next integration to avoid Suspense and re-render components when backend resources are added. |
  • Set react.bindI18nStore to listen for added resources so components update when backend translations load.
  • Disable useSuspense in the React i18next configuration to allow rendering with fallback resources without Suspense.
  • Document the intent in comments so future changes preserve the fallback-and-reload behavior.
| `src/locales/create.ts` | | Add a unit test ensuring synchronous init with bundled fallbacks and subsequent background reload for non-default languages. |
  • Mock the namespace loader used by the backend loading logic to track which language/namespace pairs are requested.
  • Import createI18nNext dynamically and initialize it with a non-default language and synchronous init.
  • Assert that the i18n instance is initialized immediately and has fallback resources for the target language.
  • Await the init promise and subsequent microtasks, then assert that reloadResources is called with the initial language and bundled namespaces and that the mocked loader is invoked for each namespace.

## Reviewer's Guide Adds support for deleting topics by reading IDs from a file in the CLI, including JSON-array and line-per-ID formats, with ID deduplication and improved validation for the `lh topic delete` command. #### Sequence diagram for lh topic delete with file-based ID loading ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CLI participant FS participant JSONParser participant ConfirmPrompt participant TrpcClient User->>CLI: lh topic delete [ids...] --file path --yes? alt file option provided CLI->>FS: readFileSync(path, utf8) FS-->>CLI: fileContent CLI->>JSONParser: parse(fileContent) alt content is valid JSON array JSONParser-->>CLI: idArray CLI->>CLI: normalize_to_strings(idArray) else JSON parse fails JSONParser-->>CLI: error CLI->>CLI: split_by_newline_and_trim(fileContent) end CLI->>CLI: merge ids and fileIds into allIds else no file option CLI->>CLI: allIds = ids_from_args end CLI->>CLI: if allIds.length === 0 alt no IDs provided CLI->>CLI: log error and exit else IDs present CLI->>CLI: deduplicate allIds with Set alt --yes not provided CLI->>ConfirmPrompt: confirm(delete allIds.length topics?) ConfirmPrompt-->>CLI: confirmed? alt not confirmed CLI->>CLI: print Cancelled and return end end alt allIds.length === 1 CLI->>TrpcClient: getTrpcClient() TrpcClient-->>CLI: client CLI->>TrpcClient: topic.removeTopic.mutate({ id: allIds[0] }) else allIds.length > 1 CLI->>TrpcClient: getTrpcClient() TrpcClient-->>CLI: client CLI->>TrpcClient: topic.batchDelete.mutate({ ids: allIds }) end CLI->>User: print Deleted allIds.length topic(s) end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Extend `lh topic delete` to accept IDs from a file, merge them with CLI args, validate, deduplicate, and use the combined list for confirmation, mutation calls, and logging. |
  • Change the topic delete command signature from required variadic `ids` to optional variadic `[ids...]` to allow file-only usage.
  • Add `-f, --file ` option to read topic IDs from a file, updating the action handler options type to include `file?: string`.
  • Read the file contents synchronously, first attempting to parse as JSON and, if it is an array, normalizing entries to strings and filtering out falsy values.
  • On JSON parse failure, treat the file as plain text, splitting by newline, trimming each line, and filtering out empty lines to build the file ID list.
  • Merge IDs from CLI args and file into `allIds`, and error out with a clear message if the resulting list is empty, exiting with non-zero status.
  • Deduplicate the combined ID list using a `Set` before performing any operations, and use the deduplicated count in the confirmation prompt.
  • Update the delete logic to use `allIds` for both single delete (`removeTopic`) and batch delete (`batchDelete`) mutations, and adjust the success log message to report the number of IDs in `allIds`.
  • Add validation for JSON files to ensure the top-level value is an array, logging an error and exiting if it is not.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adds a nullable text `description` column to the `topics` table, wires it into the Drizzle schema, and introduces a corresponding SQL migration and metadata snapshots using idempotent ALTER TABLE syntax. #### Entity relationship diagram for updated topics table ```mermaid erDiagram users { uuid id PK } topics { uuid id PK text name uuid userId FK text clientId text description text historySummary jsonb metadata text trigger } users ||--o{ topics : has_topics ``` #### Class diagram for updated topics schema in Drizzle ```mermaid classDiagram class topics { uuid id text name uuid userId text clientId text description text historySummary jsonb metadata text trigger } class users { uuid id } topics --> users : references_userId ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Extend topics table schema with a nullable description field. |
  • Add `description` text column to the Drizzle `topics` table schema
  • Keep column nullable to avoid backfill requirements and allow incremental adoption
| `packages/database/src/schemas/topic.ts`
`docs/development/database-schema.dbml` | | Add forward-only migration to create the description column in the database. |
  • Introduce migration `0091_topics_add_description.sql` that uses `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` to add the `description` column
  • Ensure migration is idempotent so it can safely run in environments where the column might already exist
| `packages/database/migrations/0091_topics_add_description.sql` | | Update migration metadata to track the new migration and schema snapshot. |
  • Append new migration entry to `_journal.json` for `0091_topics_add_description`
  • Add `0091_snapshot.json` to capture the updated schema state including the new `description` column
| `packages/database/migrations/meta/_journal.json`
`packages/database/migrations/meta/0091_snapshot.json` |

## Reviewer's Guide Centralizes tool availability logic into a shared helper and updates plugin tags, selectors, and engineering code to consistently filter tools/skills/plugins based on the current environment (desktop/web, stdio MCP) and installed plugins, fixing incorrect deprecation display in web. #### Sequence diagram for PluginTag rendering with centralized availability filtering ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant PluginTag participant ToolStore participant ToolAvailabilityHelpers User->>PluginTag: render with plugins[] PluginTag->>ToolStore: toolSelectors.metaList ToolStore-->>PluginTag: list PluginTag->>ToolStore: pluginSelectors.installedPlugins ToolStore-->>PluginTag: installedPlugins PluginTag->>ToolAvailabilityHelpers: filterToolIdsByCurrentEnv(plugins, installedPlugins, isDesktop, isWindows) ToolAvailabilityHelpers-->>PluginTag: visiblePlugins[] PluginTag->>ToolStore: toolSelectors.getMetaById(visiblePlugins[0]) ToolStore-->>PluginTag: displayPlugin PluginTag->>PluginTag: build menu items from visiblePlugins PluginTag-->>User: render DropdownMenu and Tag ``` #### Class diagram for centralized tool availability helpers ```mermaid classDiagram class ToolAvailabilityInstalledPlugin { string identifier object customParams } class ToolAvailabilityContext { ToolAvailabilityInstalledPlugin[] installedPlugins bool isDesktop bool isWindows } class ToolAvailabilityHelpers { +bool isBuiltinToolAvailableInCurrentEnv(string id) +bool isBuiltinSkillAvailableInCurrentEnv(string id, bool isDesktop, bool isWindows) +bool isInstalledPluginAvailableInCurrentEnv(ToolAvailabilityInstalledPlugin plugin, bool isDesktop) +bool isToolAvailableInCurrentEnv(string id, ToolAvailabilityInstalledPlugin[] installedPlugins, bool isDesktop, bool isWindows) +string[] filterToolIdsByCurrentEnv(string[] ids, ToolAvailabilityInstalledPlugin[] installedPlugins, bool isDesktop, bool isWindows) } class SkillFilters { +bool shouldEnableBuiltinSkill(string id, bool isDesktop, bool isWindows) } class ToolFilters { +bool shouldEnableTool(string id) } ToolAvailabilityHelpers ..> ToolAvailabilityContext : uses ToolAvailabilityHelpers ..> ToolAvailabilityInstalledPlugin : uses ToolAvailabilityHelpers ..> SkillFilters : delegates_to ToolAvailabilityHelpers ..> ToolFilters : delegates_to ``` #### Flow diagram for isToolAvailableInCurrentEnv decision logic ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Start isToolAvailableInCurrentEnv"] --> B["Check isBuiltinToolAvailableInCurrentEnv(id)"] B -->|false| Z["Return false"] B -->|true| C["Check isBuiltinSkillAvailableInCurrentEnv(id, context)"] C -->|false| Z C -->|true| D["Find plugin in context.installedPlugins by identifier"] D -->|not found| E["Return true"] D -->|found| F["Check isInstalledPluginAvailableInCurrentEnv(plugin, context)"] F -->|true| G["Return true"] F -->|false| Z Z --> H["End"] G --> H["End"] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Centralize environment-based tool/skill/plugin availability into shared helper utilities. |
  • Introduce toolAvailability helper module with context types for environment and installed plugins.
  • Implement isBuiltinToolAvailableInCurrentEnv, isBuiltinSkillAvailableInCurrentEnv, isInstalledPluginAvailableInCurrentEnv, isToolAvailableInCurrentEnv, and filterToolIdsByCurrentEnv.
  • Base builtin tool availability on shouldEnableTool and builtin skill availability on shouldEnableBuiltinSkill while respecting desktop/windows context and stdio MCP plugin constraints.
| `src/helpers/toolAvailability.ts`
`src/helpers/skillFilters.ts`
`src/helpers/toolFilters.ts` | | Update PluginTag UI component to use centralized availability filtering for displayed plugin IDs. |
  • Select installedPlugins from the tool store alongside metaList.
  • Compute visiblePlugins via filterToolIdsByCurrentEnv using installedPlugins as context.
  • Use visiblePlugins instead of raw plugins for determining displayPlugin, dropdown items, count, and the primary label, and early-return when there are no visible plugins.
| `src/features/PluginTag/index.tsx` | | Align tool engineering and selectors to use the shared availability helpers instead of ad-hoc platform checks. |
  • In tool engineering, replace manual shouldEnableTool + stdio MCP checks with isToolAvailableInCurrentEnv using installedPlugins from the tool store state.
  • In builtin selectors, replace shouldEnableTool/shouldEnableBuiltinSkill checks with isBuiltinToolAvailableInCurrentEnv/isBuiltinSkillAvailableInCurrentEnv for meta lists and installed skill filtering.
  • In generic tool selectors, use isToolAvailableInCurrentEnv for builtin tools and isInstalledPluginAvailableInCurrentEnv for installed plugins when computing availableToolsForDiscovery.
  • In plugin selectors, use isInstalledPluginAvailableInCurrentEnv instead of direct isDesktop/stdio checks for installedPluginMetaList.
  • In skillEngineering, use isBuiltinSkillAvailableInCurrentEnv for builtin skill filtering in the skill engine.
| `src/helpers/toolEngineering/index.ts`
`src/store/tool/slices/builtin/selectors.ts`
`src/store/tool/selectors/tool.ts`
`src/store/tool/slices/plugin/selectors.ts`
`src/services/chat/mecha/skillEngineering.ts` | ---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Adds a nullable text `description` column to the `topics` table, wires it into the ORM schema, and updates topic creation tests and migration metadata to align with the new database schema. #### Entity relationship diagram for topics table with new description column ```mermaid erDiagram users ||--o{ topics : owns users { uuid id PK } topics { uuid id PK text name text clientId text description "NEW nullable" text historySummary jsonb metadata text trigger uuid ownerId FK } ``` #### Class diagram for topics ORM schema with description field ```mermaid classDiagram class Topics { +uuid id +text name +uuid ownerId +text clientId +text description +text historySummary +ChatTopicMetadata metadata +text trigger } class Users { +uuid id } class ChatTopicMetadata { <> } Users "1" --> "*" Topics : owns ChatTopicMetadata <.. Topics : metadataType ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add nullable text `description` column to topics table schema and migrations. |
  • Extend topics table schema with a nullable text description field in the ORM definition.
  • Introduce SQL migration adding description column using idempotent ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS.
  • Update migration snapshot and journal metadata to register the new migration and schema state.
  • Update DBML documentation to reflect the new description column on the topics table.
| `packages/database/src/schemas/topic.ts`
`packages/database/migrations/0091_topics_add_description.sql`
`packages/database/migrations/meta/0091_snapshot.json`
`packages/database/migrations/meta/_journal.json`
`docs/development/database-schema.dbml` | | Align tests and model expectations with new description column. |
  • Update topic creation tests to include description: null in expected payloads so they match the new schema.
  • Ensure default handling of description remains nullable and optional in test fixtures.
| `packages/database/src/models/__tests__/topics/topic.create.test.ts` |
---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

## Reviewer's Guide Updates API key format to use a new `sk-lh-` prefix, fixes and extends `lh` command preprocessing to handle chained shell commands and dev mode behavior, and introduces UI/locale support for a new `runCommand` built-in skill including inspector and renderer components plus tests for the lh command preprocessing. #### Sequence diagram for updated lh command preprocessing ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant Shell participant ToolExecutionService participant JwtService participant CommandExecutor User->>Shell: type command with lh Shell->>ToolExecutionService: preprocessLhCommand(command, userId) ToolExecutionService->>ToolExecutionService: detect lhPattern in command alt command contains lh ToolExecutionService->>JwtService: generateJwtForUser(userId) JwtService-->>ToolExecutionService: jwt ToolExecutionService->>ToolExecutionService: build envPrefix ToolExecutionService->>ToolExecutionService: replaceAll lh with envPrefix npx -y @lobehub/cli ToolExecutionService-->>Shell: { command: rewritten, isLhCommand: true, skipSkillLookup: true } Shell->>CommandExecutor: execute rewritten command else command has no lh ToolExecutionService-->>Shell: { command, isLhCommand: false, skipSkillLookup: false } end ``` #### Class diagram for API key utilities and auth middleware ```mermaid classDiagram class ApiKeyUtils { - apiKeyCounter number + generateApiKey() string + isApiKeyExpired(expiresAt Date) boolean + validateApiKeyFormat(key string) boolean } class UserAuthMiddleware { + userAuthMiddleware(c Context, next Next) Promise } UserAuthMiddleware ..> ApiKeyUtils : uses validateApiKeyFormat ``` #### Class diagram for runCommand skill inspector and renderer ```mermaid classDiagram class SkillsApiName { <> + execScript + readReference + runCommand + activateSkill } class SkillsInspectors { + execScript ExecScriptInspector + readReference ReadReferenceInspector + runCommand RunCommandInspector + activateSkill RunSkillInspector } class SkillsRenders { + execScript ExecScript + readReference ReadReference + runCommand RunCommand + activateSkill RunSkill } class RunCommandInspector { + props BuiltinInspectorProps } class RunCommand { + props BuiltinRenderProps } SkillsInspectors --> RunCommandInspector SkillsRenders --> RunCommand SkillsInspectors ..> SkillsApiName SkillsRenders ..> SkillsApiName ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Switch API key format from `lb-` to `sk-lh-` and align validation/tests and auth middleware accordingly. |
  • Update `generateApiKey` to emit keys with `sk-lh-` prefix and adjust length assumptions.
  • Change `validateApiKeyFormat` regex to match `sk-lh-`-prefixed lowercase alphanumeric keys.

body:
## Reviewer's Guide Adjusts model switch panel behavior and styling to fix popup issues, including closing detail panels on scroll, deferring model updates for smoother animations, tightening dropdown trigger behavior, and simplifying panel rendering constants. #### Sequence diagram for model change selection and deferred update ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant DropdownTrigger as DropdownMenuTrigger participant List as ModelList participant Item as ListItemRenderer participant Handlers as usePanelHandlers_handleModelChange participant Store as AgentStore User->>DropdownTrigger: click model switch trigger DropdownTrigger->>List: open model switch panel User->>Item: click model option Item->>Item: onClick handler Item->>Item: setDetailOpen(false) alt model is restricted Item->>List: onRestrictedModelClick Item->>List: onClose (close panel) else model is allowed Item->>List: onClose (start close animation) Item->>Handlers: onModelChange(modelId, providerId) Handlers->>Handlers: setTimeout(150ms) Note over Handlers,Store: Deferred to allow close animation to complete Handlers->>Handlers: timeout fires alt external onModelChangeProp provided Handlers->>Store: onModelChangeProp({ model, provider }) else no external handler Handlers->>Store: updateAgentConfig({ model, provider }) end end ``` #### Sequence diagram for closing model detail popup on list scroll ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant List as ModelList participant Item as ListItemRenderer User->>List: scroll list List->>List: handleListScroll List->>List: setScrollCount(scrollCount + 1) List->>Item: re-render with scrollCount Item->>Item: useEffect on scrollCount Item->>Item: setDetailOpen(false) Item->>User: detail popup closed while scrolling ``` #### Class diagram for updated model switch panel components and handlers ```mermaid classDiagram class List { +number panelHeight +number listHeight +number scrollCount +listItems +handleClose() +handleListScroll() } class ListItemRenderer { +item +string newLabel +string proLabel +number scrollCount +boolean detailOpen +onClose() +onModelChange(modelId, providerId) +onRestrictedModelClick() } class MultipleProvidersModelItem { +data +providers +string newLabel +string proLabel +boolean submenuOpen +isModelRestricted(modelId, providerId) +onClose() +onModelChange(modelId, providerId) +onRestrictedModelClick() } class usePanelHandlers { +onModelChangeProp(params) +updateAgentConfig(params) +handleModelChange(modelId, providerId) } List "1" o-- "*" ListItemRenderer : renders ListItemRenderer --> usePanelHandlers : calls handleModelChange MultipleProvidersModelItem --> usePanelHandlers : calls handleModelChange class ModelSwitchPanelStyles { +detailPopup +dropdownMenu +list +trigger } class ActionDropdownStyles { +trigger } ModelSwitchPanelStyles <.. List : uses styles ModelSwitchPanelStyles <.. ListItemRenderer : uses styles ActionDropdownStyles <.. List : used by dropdown triggers ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Ensure model detail popups close correctly on scroll and item selection without interfering with dropdown behavior. |
  • Added optional scrollCount prop to list item renderer and reset detailOpen state when scrollCount changes using useEffect.
  • Wired a scroll handler in the list component to increment scrollCount on scroll and passed it down to ListItemRenderer instances.
  • Updated click handlers on dropdown submenu triggers to prevent default, close detail panels before handling restrictions, and then invoke onModelChange after closing the panel.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/ListItemRenderer.tsx`
`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/index.tsx` | | Defer model change handling to avoid panel flashing and remove unnecessary async/await usage. |
  • Changed onModelChange signature from returning a Promise to a synchronous function in list item and multiple provider model item components.
  • Wrapped agent config updates and onModelChangeProp calls in a setTimeout with a small delay so the close animation can complete before re-rendering.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/ListItemRenderer.tsx`
`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/MultipleProvidersModelItem.tsx`
`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/hooks/usePanelHandlers.ts` | | Improve dropdown and panel UX by adjusting scroll/overscroll behavior and trigger focus styles. |
  • Added overscroll-behavior and user-select rules to the detail popup, dropdown menu, and list to contain scrolling and avoid background scroll or text selection while interacting with the panel.
  • Introduced a shared trigger style that removes outline from dropdown triggers and applied it to the model switch panel trigger and chat action dropdown trigger.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/styles.ts`
`src/features/ChatInput/ActionBar/components/ActionDropdown.tsx`
`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/index.tsx` | | Simplify model switch panel rendering configuration. |
  • Removed unused constants related to delayed rendering and deleted the associated useDelayedRender hook implementation.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/const.ts`
`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/hooks/useDelayedRender.ts` | ---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. ## Reviewer's Guide Adds comprehensive Vitest unit test suites for the Brave, Exa, and Tavily search provider implementations, covering request construction, environment/config handling, response mapping, defaults, and error handling for their query methods. #### Sequence diagram for search provider query flow and error handling ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor TestSuite participant ProviderImpl participant GlobalFetch as fetch participant RemoteAPI TestSuite->>ProviderImpl: query(query, options) activate ProviderImpl ProviderImpl->>ProviderImpl: buildRequest(query, options) ProviderImpl->>GlobalFetch: fetch(url, requestInit) alt Network error GlobalFetch--xProviderImpl: throws Error ProviderImpl-->>TestSuite: throws SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE else HTTP response received GlobalFetch-->>ProviderImpl: Response alt response.ok is false ProviderImpl-->>TestSuite: throws SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE else response.ok is true ProviderImpl->>ProviderImpl: parseJson(response) alt JSON parse fails ProviderImpl-->>TestSuite: throws INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR else JSON parse succeeds ProviderImpl->>ProviderImpl: mapResultsToSearchResult(json) ProviderImpl-->>TestSuite: SearchResult end end end deactivate ProviderImpl ``` #### Class diagram for BraveImpl, ExaImpl, and TavilyImpl query behavior ```mermaid classDiagram class SearchQueryOptions { +string searchTimeRange +string[] searchCategories } class SearchResultItem { +string title +string url +string content +string[] engines +string category +number score +string parsedUrl } class SearchResult { +string query +number resultNumbers +SearchResultItem[] results +number costTime } class SearchProviderImpl { <> +query(query, options) SearchResult } class BraveImpl { +query(query, options) SearchResult -buildUrl(query, options) string -mapResponse(json) SearchResult } class ExaImpl { +query(query, options) SearchResult -buildBody(query, options) object -mapResponse(json) SearchResult } class TavilyImpl { +query(query, options) SearchResult -buildBody(query, options) object -mapResponse(json) SearchResult } SearchProviderImpl <|.. BraveImpl SearchProviderImpl <|.. ExaImpl SearchProviderImpl <|.. TavilyImpl SearchResult o-- SearchResultItem class BraveHttpRequest { +string method +string url +object headers } class ExaHttpRequest { +string method +string url +object headers +object body } class TavilyHttpRequest { +string method +string url +object headers +object body } BraveImpl --> BraveHttpRequest : builds ExaImpl --> ExaHttpRequest : builds TavilyImpl --> TavilyHttpRequest : builds class BraveEnvConfig { +string BRAVE_API_KEY } class ExaEnvConfig { +string EXA_API_KEY } class TavilyEnvConfig { +string TAVILY_API_KEY +string TAVILY_SEARCH_DEPTH } BraveImpl --> BraveEnvConfig ExaImpl --> ExaEnvConfig TavilyImpl --> TavilyEnvConfig ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add unit tests for Brave search implementation (query behavior, request construction, response mapping, and error handling). |
  • Stub global fetch and BRAVE_API_KEY env var per test to isolate HTTP behavior
  • Assert query string, HTTP method (GET), headers (X-Subscription-Token), and freshness parameter mapping from searchTimeRange
  • Verify response mapping from Brave web.results into internal result objects including parsedUrl, score, category, and content defaults
  • Test behavior when no results, network failures, non-ok HTTP responses, and JSON parsing errors, including error codes and messages
  • Check handling of invalid URLs for parsedUrl and inclusion of costTime in the final result
| `src/server/services/search/impls/brave/index.test.ts` | | Add unit tests for Exa search implementation (query behavior, POST body construction, response mapping, and error handling). |
  • Stub global fetch and EXA_API_KEY env var per test to isolate HTTP behavior
  • Assert POST usage with JSON body containing query, numResults, type, and conditional date range fields derived from searchTimeRange
  • Verify category handling from searchCategories (news vs non-news) and propagation into mapped results
  • Test response mapping from Exa results into internal result objects including parsedUrl, default score, and content fallback when text is empty
  • Cover edge cases including missing results field, empty results, network failures, non-ok HTTP responses, JSON parse failures, and presence of costTime
| `src/server/services/search/impls/exa/index.test.ts` | | Add unit tests for Tavily search implementation (query behavior, POST body construction with time/topic/depth, response mapping, and error handling). |
  • Stub global fetch and TAVILY_API_KEY/TAVILY_SEARCH_DEPTH env vars per test to isolate HTTP behavior and depth configuration
  • Assert POST usage with JSON body containing query, max_results, search_depth (default vs env override), and time_range/topic derived from searchTimeRange and searchCategories
  • Verify Bearer authorization header construction and behavior when API key is missing
  • Test response mapping from Tavily results into internal result objects including parsedUrl, default score, and category derivation from topic or default general
  • Cover empty results, network failures, non-ok HTTP responses, JSON parse failures, and inclusion of costTime in the final result
| `src/server/services/search/impls/tavily/index.test.ts` | ---
Tips and commands #### Interacting with Sourcery - **Trigger a new review:** Comment `@sourcery-ai review` on the pull request. - **Continue discussions:** Reply directly to Sourcery's review comments. - **Generate a GitHub issue from a review comment:** Ask Sourcery to create an issue from a review comment by replying to it. You can also reply to a review comment with `@sourcery-ai issue` to create an issue from it. - **Generate a pull request title:** Write `@sourcery-ai` anywhere in the pull request title to generate a title at any time. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai title` on the pull request to (re-)generate the title at any time. - **Generate a pull request summary:** Write `@sourcery-ai summary` anywhere in the pull request body to generate a PR summary at any time exactly where you want it. You can also comment `@sourcery-ai summary` on the pull request to (re-)generate the summary at any time. - **Generate reviewer's guide:** Comment `@sourcery-ai guide` on the pull request to (re-)generate the reviewer's guide at any time. - **Resolve all Sourcery comments:** Comment `@sourcery-ai resolve` on the pull request to resolve all Sourcery comments. Useful if you've already addressed all the comments and don't want to see them anymore. - **Dismiss all Sourcery reviews:** Comment `@sourcery-ai dismiss` on the pull request to dismiss all existing Sourcery reviews. Especially useful if you want to start fresh with a new review - don't forget to comment `@sourcery-ai review` to trigger a new review! #### Customizing Your Experience Access your [dashboard](https://app.sourcery.ai) to: - Enable or disable review features such as the Sourcery-generated pull request summary, the reviewer's guide, and others. - Change the review language. - Add, remove or edit custom review instructions. - Adjust other review settings. #### Getting Help - [Contact our support team](mailto:support@sourcery.ai) for questions or feedback. - Visit our [documentation](https://docs.sourcery.ai) for detailed guides and information. - Keep in touch with the Sourcery team by following us on [X/Twitter](https://x.com/SourceryAI), [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sourcery-ai/) or [GitHub](https://github.com/sourcery-ai).

## Reviewer's Guide This PR simplifies and declutters the UI by tightening the navigation and settings information architecture, hiding advanced/dev-only functionality behind a Dev Mode flag, reducing visual noise in chat and model controls, and adding friendlier onboarding content (starter prompts and suggested questions) while renaming and regrouping subscription/credits terminology. #### Sequence diagram for agent publish flow from profile header ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant Header as Header participant AgentStore as AgentStore participant MarketAuth as MarketAuth participant MarketPublish as useMarketPublish participant Modal as AntdModal participant Message as AntdMessage User->>Header: Click publish menu item Header->>AgentStore: Get currentAgentMeta, currentAgentSystemRole AgentStore-->>Header: meta, systemRole Header->>Header: Validate underReview, title, systemRole alt isUnderReview Header->>Message: warning(underReview) Message-->>User: Show under-review warning else invalidTitleOrSystemRole Header->>Message: error(validationError) Message-->>User: Show validation error else valid Header->>Modal: Modal.confirm(onOk) Modal-->>User: Show confirm dialog User->>Modal: Confirm Modal->>Header: onOk() alt notAuthenticated Header->>MarketAuth: signIn() alt signInSuccess MarketAuth-->>Header: ok Header->>MarketPublish: checkOwnership() MarketPublish-->>Header: {needsForkConfirm,originalAgent} alt needsForkConfirm Header->>Header: set showForkModal, originalAgentInfo User->>Header: Confirm fork Header->>MarketPublish: publish() MarketPublish-->>Header: onSuccess(identifier) else noForkNeeded Header->>MarketPublish: publish() MarketPublish-->>Header: onSuccess(identifier) end else signInError MarketAuth-->>Header: error Header->>Message: error(marketAuthError) end else alreadyAuthenticated Header->>MarketPublish: checkOwnership() MarketPublish-->>Header: {needsForkConfirm,originalAgent} alt needsForkConfirm Header->>Header: set showForkModal, originalAgentInfo User->>Header: Confirm fork Header->>MarketPublish: publish() MarketPublish-->>Header: onSuccess(identifier) else noForkNeeded Header->>MarketPublish: publish() MarketPublish-->>Header: onSuccess(identifier) end end Header->>Header: handlePublishSuccess(identifier) Header->>Header: set publishedIdentifier, showResultModal end Header-->>User: Show PublishResultModal / ForkConfirmModal ``` #### Class diagram for SettingsTabs enum and related pages ```mermaid classDiagram class SettingsTabs { <> About Advanced Agent APIKey Appearance Beta Billing ChatAppearance Common Credits Hotkey Image LLM Memory Provider Proxy Referral Security ServiceModel Skill Stats Storage SystemTools TTS Usage } class SettingsGroupKey { <> Agent General Subscription System } class SettingsContent { +renderComponent(tab) } class componentMap { +Appearance +ServiceModel +Credits +Usage +Provider +Memory +APIKey +Plans +Billing +Referral +About +Advanced +Hotkey +Proxy +SystemTools +Storage +Profile +Security +Skill } class AppearancePage { +Common +AppearanceSection +ChatAppearance } class ServiceModelPage { +DefaultAgentForm +SystemAgentForm_topic +SystemAgentForm_generationTopic +SystemAgentForm_translation +SystemAgentForm_historyCompress +SystemAgentForm_agentMeta +SystemAgentForm_queryRewrite +STT +OpenAI +Image } class CreditsPage { +SubscriptionIframeWrapper(page~credits~) } class UsagePage { +SubscriptionIframeWrapper(page~usage~) } SettingsContent --> SettingsTabs : uses SettingsContent --> componentMap : selects componentMap --> AppearancePage : maps Appearance componentMap --> ServiceModelPage : maps ServiceModel componentMap --> CreditsPage : maps Credits componentMap --> UsagePage : maps Usage SettingsGroupKey --> SettingsTabs : groups note for SettingsTabs "Agent, Common, ChatAppearance, Image, TTS, Stats are marked deprecated in code and redirected to Appearance, ServiceModel, or Usage" ``` #### Flow diagram for updated settings information architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph SettingsLayout direction LR CategoryList["Sidebar categories"] SettingsContentNode["SettingsContent(activeTab)"] end CategoryList -->|click General group item| GeneralTabs CategoryList -->|click Agent group item| AgentTabs CategoryList -->|click Subscription group item| SubscriptionTabs CategoryList -->|click System group item| SystemTabs subgraph GeneralTabs[General group] direction TB ProfileTab["SettingsTabs.Profile\nMy Account"] AppearanceTab["SettingsTabs.Appearance\nAppearance"] HotkeyTab["SettingsTabs.Hotkey\nHotkeys"] end subgraph AgentTabs[Agent group] direction TB ProviderTab["SettingsTabs.Provider\nProvider"] ServiceModelTab["SettingsTabs.ServiceModel\nService Model"] MemoryTab["SettingsTabs.Memory\nMemory"] APIKeyTab["SettingsTabs.APIKey\nAPI Keys"] end subgraph SubscriptionTabs[Subscription group] direction TB PlansTab["SettingsTabs.Plans\nSubscription"] CreditsTab["SettingsTabs.Credits\nCredits"] BillingTab["SettingsTabs.Billing\nBilling"] ReferralTab["SettingsTabs.Referral\nReferral"] UsageTab["SettingsTabs.Usage\nUsage"] end subgraph SystemTabs[System group] direction TB SystemToolsTab["SettingsTabs.SystemTools"] StorageTab["SettingsTabs.Storage\nStorage"] ProxyTab["SettingsTabs.Proxy\nProxy"] AboutTab["SettingsTabs.About\nAbout"] AdvancedTab["SettingsTabs.Advanced\nAdvanced"] end subgraph TabRouting[SettingsContent routing] direction TB ActiveTabParam["activeTab query or path"] RedirectMap["REDIRECT_MAP\nCommon->Appearance\nChatAppearance->Appearance\nAgent->ServiceModel\nTTS->ServiceModel\nImage->ServiceModel\nStats->Usage"] ResolvedTab["Resolved tab key"] end ActiveTabParam --> RedirectMap RedirectMap -->|deprecated key| ResolvedTab ActiveTabParam -->|modern key| ResolvedTab ResolvedTab --> SettingsContentNode subgraph TabComponents[componentMap] direction TB AppearancePage["/settings/appearance\nAppearance page"] ServiceModelPage["/settings/service-model\nService Model page"] CreditsPage["Credits iframe"] UsagePage["Usage iframe"] end SettingsContentNode -->|SettingsTabs.Appearance| AppearancePage SettingsContentNode -->|SettingsTabs.ServiceModel| ServiceModelPage SettingsContentNode -->|SettingsTabs.Credits| CreditsPage SettingsContentNode -->|SettingsTabs.Usage| UsagePage ``` #### Flow diagram for ModelSwitchPanel behavior with Dev Mode ```mermaid flowchart TD User["User opens ModelSwitchPanel"] --> Init Init["Read isDevMode from user settings"] -->|true| DevPanel Init -->|false| NormalPanel subgraph DevPanel[Dev Mode enabled] direction TB RndPanel["Resizable Rnd container\nwidth from panel size hooks"] ToolbarDev["Toolbar\nsearch + group mode switch"] ListDev["List\nuses groupMode state"] ItemDev["Model items\nsubmenu with ModelDetailPanel"] RndPanel --> ToolbarDev ToolbarDev --> ListDev ListDev --> ItemDev end subgraph NormalPanel[Dev Mode disabled] direction TB FixedPanel["Flexbox container\nwidth DEFAULT_WIDTH=320"] ToolbarNormal["Toolbar\nsearch only"] ListNormal["List\nforce groupMode='byModel'"] ItemNormal["Model items\nno inline detail popup"] FixedPanel --> ToolbarNormal ToolbarNormal --> ListNormal ListNormal --> ItemNormal end subgraph ItemClickBehavior[onModelChange handler] direction TB ClickItem["Click model item"] --> RestrictedCheck["Check restricted"] RestrictedCheck -->|restricted| RestrictedFlow RestrictedCheck -->|allowed| AllowedFlow subgraph RestrictedFlow direction TB CallRestrictedHandler["onRestrictedModelClick"] --> ClosePanelRestricted["onClose()"] end subgraph AllowedFlow direction TB CallOnModelChange["onModelChange(modelId,providerId)\nasync"] --> ClosePanelAllowed["onClose()"] ClosePanelAllowed --> UpdateAgentConfig["usePanelHandlers\nupdateAgentConfig after timeout"] end end ItemDev --> ClickItem ItemNormal --> ClickItem ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Agent profile & conversation headers now centralize publishing, advanced settings, and topic display while removing secondary controls from the editor. |
  • Extend agent profile Header to include a dropdown with advanced settings and community publish actions, wired to market auth, ownership checks, fork confirmation, and publish result modals.
  • Move publish and cron-job / start-conversation actions out of ProfileEditor so it only manages model selection, tools, and editor canvas.
  • Simplify agent conversation header tags to show only group member count or the current topic title instead of model/plugins/knowledge badges, and trim header right-side actions (remove notebook button).

`src/routes/(main)/agent/features/Conversation/Header/index.tsx` | | Model switcher UI is simplified for normal users and made more compact while keeping detailed controls available only in Dev Mode. |
  • Change ModelSwitchPanel list items and toolbar to hide provider settings icons, reduce popup width, and use simple clickable Blocks instead of nested detail submenus for non-dev users.
  • Gate detail popups, info tags, extra controls, and group mode switching behind Dev Mode; Dev Mode keeps the resizable Rnd panel and by-provider grouping, while normal mode uses a fixed-width Flexbox panel grouped by model.
  • Make onModelChange async-aware, adjust handler types, remove scroll-driven submenu state, and clean up styles (overscroll, selection, trigger layout).

`src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/hooks/useBuildListItems.ts` | | Dev Mode now gates advanced/debug functionality (branching, usage metrics, token breakdowns, extra controls) across chat, tasks, and model UI to keep the default experience cleaner. |

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Prevents the LoginStep self-host endpoint input from submitting on Enter while an IME composition (e.g., Chinese input) is in progress by tracking composition state with a ref and gating the Enter key handler. #### Sequence diagram for IME-safe Enter key handling in LoginStep ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant LoginStep participant EndpointInput participant IME participant ServerConnection User->>EndpointInput: Start typing address EndpointInput->>IME: compositionstart IME-->>LoginStep: onCompositionStart LoginStep->>LoginStep: isChineseInput.current = true User->>EndpointInput: Press Enter to confirm candidate EndpointInput-->>LoginStep: onKeyDown key Enter LoginStep->>LoginStep: Check isChineseInput.current alt isChineseInput.current is true LoginStep-->>EndpointInput: Ignore Enter (no submit) end IME-->>EndpointInput: compositionend EndpointInput-->>LoginStep: onCompositionEnd LoginStep->>LoginStep: isChineseInput.current = false User->>EndpointInput: Press Enter to submit EndpointInput-->>LoginStep: onKeyDown key Enter LoginStep->>LoginStep: Check isChineseInput.current alt isChineseInput.current is false LoginStep->>ServerConnection: handleSelfhostConnect end ``` #### Flow diagram for Enter key handling in endpoint input ```mermaid flowchart TD A_onKeyDown_Enter[onKeyDown Enter pressed] --> B{isChineseInput.current?} B -- true --> C[Ignore key do not call handleSelfhostConnect] B -- false --> D[Call handleSelfhostConnect trigger server connection] ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Track IME composition state for the self-host endpoint input to avoid accidental submission when confirming candidates with Enter. |
  • Introduce an isChineseInput useRef flag to record whether text composition is active.
  • Wire onCompositionStart to set the composition flag to true and onCompositionEnd to reset it to false on the endpoint input.
  • Update the onKeyDown Enter handler to call handleSelfhostConnect only when no composition is active.

## Reviewer's Guide Adds SSE-compatible subscription support to the in‑memory stream event manager, wires agent streaming to use a factory that selects the proper backend (in‑memory vs Redis), exports typed execAgent request/response contracts, and introduces regression tests to ensure tool enablement defaults to disabling unknown tools. #### Sequence diagram for SSE agent stream using subscribeStreamEvents ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Client participant NextRoute as AgentStreamRoute participant Factory as createStreamEventManager participant Manager as IStreamEventManager Client->>NextRoute: GET /api/agent/stream?operationId, lastEventId NextRoute->>Factory: createStreamEventManager() Factory-->>NextRoute: streamManager (InMemoryStreamEventManager or RedisStreamEventManager) NextRoute->>Manager: subscribeStreamEvents(operationId, lastEventId, onEvents, signal) activate Manager loop until agent_runtime_end or abort Manager-->>NextRoute: onEvents(StreamEvent[]) NextRoute-->>Client: SSE events end Manager-->>NextRoute: Promise resolved deactivate Manager NextRoute-->>Client: SSE stream closed ``` #### Class diagram for stream event management and execAgent types ```mermaid classDiagram class IStreamEventManager { <> +subscribe(operationId string, handler function) function +unsubscribe(operationId string, handler function) function +publish(operationId string, event StreamEvent) Promise~string~ +subscribeStreamEvents(operationId string, lastEventId string, onEvents function, signal AbortSignal) Promise~void~ } class InMemoryStreamEventManager { +subscribe(operationId string, handler function) function +unsubscribe(operationId string, handler function) function +publish(operationId string, event StreamEvent) Promise~string~ +subscribeStreamEvents(operationId string, lastEventId string, onEvents function, signal AbortSignal) Promise~void~ } class RedisStreamEventManager { +subscribe(operationId string, handler function) function +unsubscribe(operationId string, handler function) function +publish(operationId string, event StreamEvent) Promise~string~ +subscribeStreamEvents(operationId string, lastEventId string, onEvents function, signal AbortSignal) Promise~void~ } IStreamEventManager <|.. InMemoryStreamEventManager IStreamEventManager <|.. RedisStreamEventManager class ExecAgentAppContext { +groupId string +scope string +sessionId string +threadId string +topicId string } class ExecAgentParams { +agentId string +appContext ExecAgentAppContext +autoStart boolean +existingMessageIds string[] +fileIds string[] +newThread object +newTopic object +pageSelections PageSelection[] +prompt string +slug string } class PageSelection { +content string +title string +url string } class ExecAgentResult { +agentId string +assistantMessageId string +autoStarted boolean +createdAt string +createdThreadId string +error string +isCreateNewTopic boolean +message string +messageId string +operationId string +status string +success boolean +timestamp string +topicId string +userMessageId string } ExecAgentParams --> ExecAgentAppContext ExecAgentParams --> PageSelection ExecAgentParams ..> ExecAgentResult ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add SSE-compatible subscribeStreamEvents implementation to the in-memory stream manager and expose it through the stream manager interface. |
  • Implement subscribeStreamEvents on the in-memory manager using the existing subscribe mechanism, resolving on agent_runtime_end or abort.
  • Ensure abort signals cleanly unsubscribe and resolve the subscription promise.
  • Extend the stream event manager interface with a subscribeStreamEvents method signature compatible with the Redis implementation.
| `src/server/modules/AgentRuntime/InMemoryStreamEventManager.ts`
`src/server/modules/AgentRuntime/types.ts` | | Update the agent stream API route to construct the appropriate stream event manager via a factory. |
  • Replace direct StreamEventManager instantiation with createStreamEventManager in the agent stream route.
  • Document that the factory chooses an in-memory singleton for local development and Redis in production.
| `src/app/(backend)/api/agent/stream/route.ts` | | Export strongly-typed execAgent input/output contracts from the shared types package. |
  • Introduce ExecAgentAppContext, ExecAgentParams, and ExecAgentResult interfaces for agent execution.
  • Re-export the new agentExecution types from the root types index for package consumers.

`packages/types/src/index.ts` | | Add regression tests to lock in default tool enablement behavior, especially for unknown tools and user-selected plugins. |
  • Add tests confirming tools not present in rules are disabled by default to avoid unintended activation.
  • Add tests verifying that only user-selected tools plus explicitly-enabled defaults are active when rules are provided.

Reviewer's guide (collapsed on small PRs) ## Reviewer's Guide Implements a bug fix so that clicking a multi-provider model item in group-by-model mode immediately selects the model using its first provider instead of just opening the provider submenu, while preserving the restricted-model behavior and submenu access via hover. #### Sequence diagram for multi-provider model item click behavior ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant MultipleProvidersModelItem participant RestrictionChecker as RestrictionChecker participant onRestrictedModelClick participant setSubmenuOpen participant onModelChange participant onClose User->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: click() MultipleProvidersModelItem->>RestrictionChecker: checkAllProvidersRestricted(data.providers) alt all providers restricted RestrictionChecker-->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: true MultipleProvidersModelItem->>onRestrictedModelClick: invoke() MultipleProvidersModelItem->>onClose: invoke() else at least one provider allowed RestrictionChecker-->>MultipleProvidersModelItem: false MultipleProvidersModelItem->>setSubmenuOpen: false MultipleProvidersModelItem->>onModelChange: data.model.id, data.providers[0].id MultipleProvidersModelItem->>onClose: invoke() end ``` #### Class diagram for MultipleProvidersModelItem click handling changes ```mermaid classDiagram class MultipleProvidersModelItemProps { +ModelWithProviders data +function onModelChange(modelId, providerId) +function onRestrictedModelClick() +function onClose() +function setSubmenuOpen(isOpen) } class ModelWithProviders { +Model model +Provider[] providers } class Model { +string id +string name } class Provider { +string id +string name +bool restricted } class MultipleProvidersModelItem { +props MultipleProvidersModelItemProps +handleClick() } MultipleProvidersModelItem --> MultipleProvidersModelItemProps : uses MultipleProvidersModelItemProps --> ModelWithProviders : contains ModelWithProviders --> Model : contains ModelWithProviders --> Provider : contains MultipleProvidersModelItem ..> Provider : checks restricted MultipleProvidersModelItem ..> MultipleProvidersModelItemProps : calls onModelChange MultipleProvidersModelItem ..> MultipleProvidersModelItemProps : calls onRestrictedModelClick MultipleProvidersModelItem ..> MultipleProvidersModelItemProps : calls onClose MultipleProvidersModelItem ..> MultipleProvidersModelItemProps : calls setSubmenuOpen(false) ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Change click handling on multi-provider model items to directly select the first provider when the model is not restricted. |
  • Return early after handling restricted models to avoid running normal click logic when all providers are restricted.
  • Close the providers submenu before handling a non-restricted click.
  • Trigger model change using the first provider in the providers list when a non-restricted multi-provider model item is clicked.
  • Close the model switch panel after applying the model change to keep UX consistent with single-provider items.
| `src/features/ModelSwitchPanel/components/List/MultipleProvidersModelItem.tsx` |

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a per-agent skill activation mode (auto/manual) toggle and a tools search bar in the chat tools popover, wiring the new mode into agent chat config, selectors, server/tooling engines, and i18n strings so that manual mode disables default tools and only uses user-selected skills. #### Sequence diagram for tool selection with skillActivateMode in streaming executor ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant ChatUI participant StreamingExecutorActionImpl as StreamingExecutor participant AgentStore participant ToolsEngine User->>ChatUI: SendMessage ChatUI->>StreamingExecutor: executeChat(agentId, message) StreamingExecutor->>AgentStore: getAgentConfig(agentId) AgentStore-->>StreamingExecutor: agentConfig(chatConfig.skillActivateMode) alt skillActivateMode is manual StreamingExecutor->>StreamingExecutor: isManualMode = true else skillActivateMode is auto or undefined StreamingExecutor->>StreamingExecutor: isManualMode = false end StreamingExecutor->>ToolsEngine: createAgentToolsEngine(model, provider, uiConfigs) StreamingExecutor->>ToolsEngine: generateToolsDetailed(model, provider, skipDefaultTools, toolIds) note over StreamingExecutor,ToolsEngine: skipDefaultTools = disableTools OR isManualMode ToolsEngine-->>StreamingExecutor: toolsDetailed StreamingExecutor-->>ChatUI: streamAiResponse(toolsDetailed) ChatUI-->>User: Display AI response with tools usage ``` #### Sequence diagram for tool selection with skillActivateMode in server AiAgentService ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Client participant AiAgentService participant AgentStore participant ToolsEngine Client->>AiAgentService: execAgent(agentId, payload) AiAgentService->>AgentStore: getAgentConfig(agentId) AgentStore-->>AiAgentService: agentConfig(chatConfig.skillActivateMode) alt skillActivateMode is manual AiAgentService->>AiAgentService: isManualMode = true else skillActivateMode is auto or undefined AiAgentService->>AiAgentService: isManualMode = false end AiAgentService->>ToolsEngine: createAgentToolsEngine(model, provider) AiAgentService->>ToolsEngine: generateToolsDetailed(model, provider, skipDefaultTools, toolIds) note over AiAgentService,ToolsEngine: skipDefaultTools = isManualMode ToolsEngine-->>AiAgentService: toolsResult AiAgentService-->>Client: agentExecutionResult(toolsResult) ``` #### Class diagram for updated agent chat config and selectors ```mermaid classDiagram class LobeAgentChatConfig { +searchFCModel WorkingModel +searchMode SearchMode +skillActivateMode string +textVerbosity string +thinking string +thinkingBudget number } class AgentChatConfigSchema { +searchMode enum +skillActivateMode enum +textVerbosity enum +thinking enum +thinkingBudget number } class chatConfigByIdSelectors { +getChatConfigById(agentId) +getSkillActivateModeById(agentId) } class agentChatConfigSelectors { +currentChatConfig() +skillActivateMode() } LobeAgentChatConfig <|-- AgentChatConfigSchema chatConfigByIdSelectors --> LobeAgentChatConfig agentChatConfigSelectors --> chatConfigByIdSelectors ``` #### Class diagram for tools popover and SkillActivateMode component ```mermaid classDiagram class PopoverContentProps { +items ItemType[] +onOpenStore() } class PopoverContent { -items ItemType[] -searchKeyword string +filterItems(items, keyword) ItemType[] +render() } class SkillActivateMode { -agentId string -currentMode string +render() } class ToolsList { +items ItemType[] +render() } class AgentStore { +getState() +updateAgentChatConfig(config) } PopoverContent --> PopoverContentProps PopoverContent --> ToolsList PopoverContent --> SkillActivateMode SkillActivateMode --> AgentStore ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Add skill activation mode (auto/manual) to the tools popover UI and filterable tools list. |
  • Extend PopoverContent header to include a SearchBar and new SkillActivateMode control
  • Introduce local searchKeyword state and filterItems helper to filter ItemType groups/children by key while preserving dividers
  • Constrain tools list container to fixed height and pass filteredItems into ToolsList instead of the raw items
| `src/features/ChatInput/ActionBar/Tools/PopoverContent.tsx` | | Introduce SkillActivateMode segmented control component wired to agent chat config. |
  • Create SkillActivateMode segmented control with icons and localized descriptions for auto/manual modes
  • Read the current skillActivateMode from agent store via chatConfigByIdSelectors.getSkillActivateModeById and useAgentId
  • On change, update agent chat config via useUpdateAgentConfig with the selected mode
| `src/features/ChatInput/ActionBar/Tools/SkillActivateMode.tsx` | | Extend agent chat configuration schema to support skillActivateMode and expose it via selectors. |
  • Add optional skillActivateMode field ('auto' | 'manual') with documentation to LobeAgentChatConfig
  • Update AgentChatConfigSchema to include skillActivateMode enum
  • Add getSkillActivateModeById selector with default 'auto' and expose it in agentChatConfigSelectors
| `packages/types/src/agent/chatConfig.ts`
`src/store/agent/selectors/chatConfigByIdSelectors.ts`
`src/store/agent/selectors/chatConfigSelectors.ts` | | Wire skillActivateMode into tools engine behavior so manual mode skips default tools in both streaming and server execution paths. |
  • In StreamingExecutorActionImpl, compute isManualMode from agentConfig.chatConfig.skillActivateMode and OR it into skipDefaultTools when generating tools
  • In AiAgentService.execAgent, compute isManualMode from agentConfig.chatConfig.skillActivateMode and pass it as skipDefaultTools to toolsEngine.generateToolsDetailed
| `src/store/chat/slices/aiChat/actions/streamingExecutor.ts`
`src/server/services/aiAgent/index.ts` | | Update i18n strings for tools UI, including labels and descriptions for skill activation modes and tools search. |
  • Add tools.search placeholder and skillActivateMode title/description strings to default settings locale
  • Rename tools.title from "Extension Tools" to "Skills" and propagate locale updates across multiple languages

## Reviewer's Guide Adds a new ParadeDB/pg_search BM25 full-text index migration using ICU tokenizer for 14 user-scoped tables to optimize Cmd+K search, replacing any existing BM25 indexes with consistently configured key/text/json/fast fields and recording the migration metadata snapshot. #### Sequence diagram for CmdK search using BM25 ICU indexes ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant CmdKUI participant Backend participant Postgres participant PgSearchBM25 User->>CmdKUI: Open_CmdK_and_type_query CmdKUI->>Backend: searchCmdK(query, user_id) Backend->>Postgres: SELECT ... WHERE user_id = user_id AND to_bm25_query(query) Postgres->>PgSearchBM25: Execute_BM25_index_scan_with_ICU_tokenizer PgSearchBM25-->>Postgres: Ranked_results_for_user Postgres-->>Backend: Rows_from_14_indexed_tables Backend-->>CmdKUI: Consolidated_search_results CmdKUI-->>User: Render_ranked_results_faster ``` #### ER diagram for tables with new BM25 ICU indexes ```mermaid erDiagram AGENTS { uuid id text title text description text slug jsonb tags text system_role uuid user_id } TOPICS { uuid id text title text content text description uuid user_id } MESSAGES { uuid id text content uuid user_id text role } FILES { uuid id text name uuid user_id text file_type } DOCUMENTS { uuid id text title text description text content text slug uuid user_id text file_type }
